reviews.author: Julianna M
reviews.title: Views
reviews.content: Beautiful and unique journey.

reviews.author: Zak H
reviews.title: We had the best guide
reviews.content: We really enjoyed our Trang An boat tour. Our guide, Lien, was absolutely lovely. She took the time to introduce herself properly and even pointed out where King Kong was filmed, which was a great added touch.We chose Option 2, which is the shortest route. It took us through three caves and three pagodas. At each pagoda, we had around 10 minutes to get off the boat, explore the area, take photos, and purchase a drink if needed. The boat seats were comfortable, although be prepared for sitting for quite a long period of time. You can help out by choosing to row yourself. The scenery was the real highlight. The mountains and surrounding landscape were absolutely beautiful, with plenty of opportunities to stop and take photos. Inside some of the caves, the ceilings can be quite low, so you occasionally need to duck to avoid hitting your head!There were quite a few crowds, but surprisingly, everything seemed to work well and it didn't take away from the experience. Overall, a beautiful and relaxing way to experience Trang An, with stunning scenery and a lovely guide who made the trip even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Pffff it is a long sit in a boat
reviews.content: It is worth it, but do not choose the full or long package from the offered options. We had #3 for 300,000 pp.The rowers have a tough job, it's almost 3 hours of sailing. The longest cave is 1.5 km. But watch out, it's very low!Along the way, you stop at various temples.Is it worth it? Yes and no! It takes a long time and can be extremely hot. On the other hand, the landscape is beautiful and varied.

reviews.author: Andrea L
reviews.title: Unmissable experience
reviews.content: One of the absolute must-do experiences in Ninh Binh. The boat trip lasts about two hours and covers a route of about 10 km, so consider the timing carefully before leaving.The boats are small, generally with four passengers plus the person rowing, and the route crosses a spectacular landscape made of rivers, karst mountains, vegetation, and caves.The only real difficulty, at least in summer, is the truly scorching heat. On the boats there are umbrellas to protect yourself from the sun, but you will have to hold them yourselves during the trip. Furthermore, it is mandatory to wear a life jacket, which is noticeable in the heat and humidity. Absolutely bring water, sunscreen, and a hat.There are so many people and during peak times a procession of boats almost forms, making you lose a bit of the magic of the place. Despite this, it is definitely worth it.Trang An is one of the most spectacular places in the region and, in my opinion, one of the must-see attractions in northern Vietnam.

reviews.author: essentialism
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape! But…
reviews.content: We bought tickets for 2 adults and 1 child, and were told it would be 4 people per boat. However, at the pier, the dispatcher didn't count our child as a seat and forced us to share with 2 strangers (5 people total). When we declined, they acted very rudely, and the rower even shouted at our child. We tried to stay polite and treat it as a language barrier, but they just left us waiting on the side. The issue was only resolved after we reported it to the manager, who agreed to send us off after a 20-minute wait.

reviews.author: jh0rnsey
reviews.title: Highly recommend this trip.
reviews.content: To be clear this review is for the No.2 Trang An shared 4 person boat trip (not tour) which takes you through 4 caves and to 3 temples and lasted nearly 3 hours. Our lady boat rower was excellent and made our trip very special.  This experience was like nothing that we had ever experienced before in our 2 visits to Vietnam. We would highly recommend this trip.

reviews.author: Jean-Emmanuel R
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.content: A place of great beauty where the film King Kong was notably filmed. A walk of a little less than 1 hour 30 minutes in an idyllic setting. Despite a large number of tourists, the place remains peaceful. All around the site, you will find places to eat and numerous souvenir shops are available.Special mention to the rowers, sometimes elderly people who probably make the trip several times a day by the sole strength of their arms. Giving them a tip at the end of the activity is the least one can do.

reviews.author: Edward N
reviews.title: A Beautiful and Seamless Experience at Trang An
reviews.content: Once we entered the grounds of Trang An, we found it easy to move around, with clear signage, very friendly staff, and a very efficient ticket office. The highlight of the complex, though, was the boat trip. The boat trip was peaceful, beautiful, and relaxing. The views were stunning. Towering limestone mountains covered in lush greenery surrounded us. The water was crystal clear and seemed to reflect everything. We went through many caves, each of different shapes and sizes. Some were very tall, while others were much lower. Each cave had its own special atmosphere. Our boat rowers were very skilled at their job and very gentle with the oars on the water. They were also very knowledgeable about everything we were seeing. They made us feel very safe and were always willing to answer any questions that we had.The area has been preserved so well and must be a huge task to keep it so clean with so many visitors, but it never felt overcrowded, and you can really tell that everyone respects the environment. The whole area has a very peaceful, calm feeling, and every moment we were there was perfect for taking in the views and the fresh air.In summary, Trang An gave us a flawless experience: beautiful natural landscapes, perfect organization, very friendly people, and lots of peace. We can highly recommend it to all travelers visiting Ninh Binh. A wonderful day!

reviews.author: mvanroy
reviews.title: Beautiful rowing between limestone rocks and through caves!
reviews.content: Yes, this is a very tourist activity. Yes, there are many people and there are many boats (boat 1382 was the highest number we have seen). Yes, it is commercially exploited (but also just well organized). Yes, it is not cheap by Vietnamese standards (300,000 months, but 3 hours of fun). But all this doesn't make it any less special and beautiful!We had chosen route 3 because it seemed to give us the most variety with the combination of 3 temple stops and 3 caves. The temples are authentic and are still used (these are stops of about 10 minutes). The caves are very special, especially the dot cave because you sail through the cave for a kilometer in twilight, where you occasionally have to bend down to avoid hitting your head.For the rest, between the caves and temples it is mainly enjoying nature and karst peaks. Our captain was very friendly and patient. Her English was not so good but chapeau to do this daily.

reviews.author: Naks B
reviews.title: Memorable must -do activity in Vietnam
reviews.content: We had a wonderful multi- generational family experience. There are 3 options for the boat rides. We did no 2, lasting for 2.5 hrs, costing 300,000 VD per person. The management is fantastic inspite of it being crowded with locals and tourists alike. Our boat was rowed by a lady with super powers😃. She made the experience more meaningful for us, guiding us where to take pictures etc, assuring our safety inside the caves. The scenic ride is awesome. Has to be in your to-do list if u visit Vietnam.

reviews.author: Jeneva S
reviews.title: Beautiful boat ride, but very crowded
reviews.content: I did the Trang An boat tour on a hot morning and honestly the scenery was stunning. The limestone cliffs rising out of the water, the little caves, and the quiet stretches between the rows of paddling boats felt pretty special. I loved drifting through the grottoes and seeing the green water and all the old temples tucked away in there. That said, it was more crowded and a bit more organized/touristy than I expected, so it didn’t always feel peaceful. The boat ride can also be a little repetitive if you’ve already done other river tours in Vietnam. Still, it’s absolutely worth seeing once, and I’d recommend it with a bit of patience.

reviews.author: Cathi R
reviews.title: Pretty scenery, but the crowds wore me down
reviews.content: I went to Trang An on a cloudy morning and the karst scenery really is beautiful. The boat ride through the caves was calm at first, and I liked the cool air inside the tunnels and the sound of the oars hitting the water. The temples along the way were fine, though nothing that really stood out to me. My main issue was how crowded and organized it felt — lots of waiting, lots of boats, and it moved a bit too much like a process. I also found the whole outing a little long by the end. Glad I saw it, but for me it was more pleasant than memorable.

reviews.author: S G
reviews.title: Family fun and best cave experience.
reviews.content: Forget Ha Long bay - this is so much better with kids!

reviews.author: SALA TAM COC HOTEL & SPA
reviews.title: Trang An , a must do in Ninh Binh!
reviews.content: Nice , Clearn nature but very crowded of tourist.

reviews.author: TIẾN NAM Đ
reviews.title: Page and
reviews.content: I went alone on a day with a little rain, but in general TRANG AN is very nice to go by boat.

reviews.author: fujiiko
reviews.title: Ninh Binh.
reviews.content: Jade green rivers cutting through rice paddies as far as the eye can see, and all around karst mountains popping up everywhere. The boat ride is the experience to have, with low caves and hidden lakes. Total silence and beautiful temples everywhere emerging from the rocks. Afternoons by bike, rice paddies, and mysticism; this is where Vietnam begins to change.

reviews.author: Explorer11280645473
reviews.title: Trang An eco
reviews.content: We had experience very relaxing in Trang An. The river was clean and fresh. Peaceful and happy

reviews.author: Amy T
reviews.title: Beautiful and Relaxing - Go Early to Avoid Crowds
reviews.content: I didn't expect to enjoy this experience as much as I did. I went earlier in the day to try to avoid the crowds which was the right call as we could see the increased traffic on our way back. We did Route 1 because were interested in seeing the caves more than the pagodas and it was fantastic. It was majestic and relaxing. Would recommend for sure if you're visiting the Ninh Binh area. We even saw some monkeys high up in a tree near the end of our trip.

reviews.author: Marc B
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.content: Nice to sail through this beautiful nature reserve in a rowing boat. Personally, I liked this better than Ha Long Bay. Also busy but much less noise.

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: A magical experience
reviews.content: This is a big operation (2000 boats, I was told) so it has to be well organised, and it is. Each boat takes 3 or 4 people plus the oars(wo)man. The tourists are required to wear life jackets. The rowers don't - are they good swimmers or are they expendable? The cost (300K dong) per adult is expensive for Vietnam but a comparable experience elsewhere would cost far more.There is a choice of three routes, all taking ~3 hours. Route 1 which I took passes through the most caves, each one opening into a new steep sided basin with towering jungle clad slopes and sheer limestone crags. The cave ceilings can be low, so sometimes you need to duck. Stops are made to visit three temples. The second one (Tran temple) is for the fit and strong. It involves a long steep climb to a saddle, then down the other side to a most unimpressive shrine, and return the same way. If I had known what I was in for I would have stayed with the boat. Not much wildlife to be seen; look out for little grebes popping up all over the waters.All in all, a wonderful experience and well worth the money.

reviews.author: bbrady962
reviews.title: Underrated and as impressive as the Grand Canyon
reviews.content: Having been to Halong bay as well, this place is more spectacular and a better experience overall. The scenery is breathtaking and the water in the rivers are pristine as no tourist motor boats are allowed. There is always lots of space between the constant flow of paddle boats so you still get that peaceful experience. You can also join in and paddle with the guide which is fun.  The stops along the way are really interesting surrounded by these steep green mountains like nothing we have seen before.Exceeded our expectations and for us as impressive as the grand canyon or Yosemite. Only advice would be to go early

reviews.author: AlexSwallow
reviews.title: Fantastic- and unique!
reviews.content: This was a unique experience, at least for me.So many amazing things:- being piloted around in such a small boat- going through caves on the water- being dropped off at beautiful temples (at one we saw perhaps the most amazing butterfly we've ever seen) and then picked up again- the general scenery and setting- being out in natureI think what was most clever for me was that despite the fact there were so many people, the fact each boat was small made it feel such a private experience. On our boat there was us and one other couple. We were lucky that they were friendly and considerate (by considerate I mean that despite the fact that they were in the front seats, first, we regularly swapped throughout the experience). We didn't have to queue for long at all- either to buy tickets or to actually get on the boats.An absolute must do in my opinion.

reviews.author: Anna Z
reviews.title: Trang An vs Halong Bay: pick Trang An
reviews.content: An honest review of someone who did both Halong and Trang An: Trang An/Ninh Binh experience is the best. You can scrape Halong.Advantage 1: shorter trip from Hanoi. If you leave at 7, at 9-9:30 you can already be on a boat - unlike with Halong tours, you leave at 7 and get to the boat at 12:15. Less time transferring and waiting. Advantage 2: not so crowded. At Halong, you queue at every attraction,  and spend the night with 20 other boats nearby. At Trang An, there is a constant flow of boats but it still feels peaceful and serene, no generators running at night, no soapy water dumped from boats, no waiting in line for 30 minutes to enter a cave. Advantage 3: extend your experience by staying in a countryside homestay. This is the best part - you can choose your adventure,  your accommodation and your food when you are on land. You can go on a bike or plunge into a pool or get a grab/cheap beer from a local store. When on boat, your options are limited and you have to stay with the tour.Overall, we found the Ninh Binh scenery very similar to Halong bay, except offering a better experience - as you are constantly moving through the mesmerising landscape in your personal boat - the Halong bay tours go for 2 hours, then stop, and then go back the next day...I wish we had spent more time in Ninh Binh and did not go to Halong bay overnight  cruise - Ninh Binh and Trang An are a better experience.

reviews.author: TRẦN SƠN
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: The landscape is wonderful and together with it the temples, temples, spiritual points in this place have created a place of nature with culture in harmony. World Cultural Heritage and Nature

reviews.author: Sightseer34284038841
reviews.title: Must do in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Got to the centre about 8:30am, no queues and picked boat tour 2. Length of tour was perfect, about 2 hours. We were lucky enough to see some monkeys and overall the trip was excellent. We alternated with another couple on the boat for the front position. Take water and sunscreen. Highly recommended this trip and go early .

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Worthwhile but busy
reviews.content: Very busy- boats and life jackets everywhere but overall it was worth it to see the UNESCO heritage site. We took route 3 to see the 1000m cave which was awesome! Our rower was lovely and took photos of us on the boat. Each boat takes 4 people, so we were asked to join another Vietnamese couple. We agreed to switch front/ back seats for every stop which worked really well. Overall, the tour took us the full 3 hours. Make sure you bring lots of water and sunscreen as it gets very hot. Fans and UV reflective umbrellas would also be a great idea.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Beautiful boat tour in the karst rocks with caves and temples
reviews.content: There are three different tours to choose from. We chose Tour No. 2.The price is the same for all tours, it is300000 VND, card payment possible.After deciding on one of the three tours, you will be assigned a maximum of four on a rowing boat.The approximately 3 h tour (No. 2) led through several caves to various temple complexes. This means that you can get out of the boat at the temples and stay there (toilet facilities are available).I highly recommend the tour. The whole area is beautiful with the karst rocks and the lush plant life.I can also recommend the boat tour in Tam Coc (Tam Cốc - Bích Động), where the water runs through the middle of the rice fields, lined with the high and steep karst rocks.

reviews.author: Mai Mai
reviews.title: COLLECTOR TICKETS
reviews.content: Woman searching for MONV 839 STATE ticket scanned her ticket for someone else, leaving her crew waiting between 15:25 and 16:30 to check orange. Our team bought 6 onl tickets, which are 6 QR codes to scan, standing in the middle of our group, there were others, so the first friend asked to get back the bill for each person to scan one, but Dung's sister refused and said, "If you have 6 people right, please go through" to the turn of strangers who passed by, not only said that it was not a team member but she did not listen and let people pass, and as a result, our group was kept one person waiting for the check-in. It’s worth mentioning that for more than three years I’ve been in a service profession and never seen anyone whisper to a customer like you (even if it’s a customer’s fault) but this was your fault, which made our crew have to ask the driver for the fastest route possible and not stop at any spiritual point to catch up with the pre-booked 7pm ride back to HN. We went on March 10 for five days, but the heritage manager of Zhang An still bothered my friend with the desire to remove review 1* on google, though I lazyly wrote more reviews but the party called too much so I decided to rewrite my experience. The attitude of the staff on this side was really bad, even the first-timer management asked us to delete the review and there was no apologies kindly, I always said if my friend got another disturbing call to delete it, I would have another review 1 *, I'm not missing gmail :)))

reviews.author: Ria1104
reviews.title: Boating Through the Unesco World Heritage Site
reviews.content: Trang An complex is listed as a Unesco World Heritage Site and riding a boat is the best way to explore the place. The tickets would cost you around 250k per person for a 2.5 to 3 hour boat ride. If a person wants he can get tickets for a private boat as well. We got tickets for 2, so we had to share our boat with a family from China. We chose Route 3 option and passed 3 caves and few temples on our way. All the caves were breathtaking and the idea of passing through limestone caves on a boat was truly adventurous. The route 3 also happens to have the longest cave of 1km length, in Trang An and this cave had some amazing landscapes. We literally had to bend down properly to avoid our heads getting hit over here.  Other than the caves, the scenery around with the river water flowing, the huge limestone mountains standing at the banks, and little temples situated at the foothills created a magical atmosphere. We also saw the place where Kong: Skull island movie was shot. Basically, there were a few huts in the backdrop of the forest which were used as sets for the movie. We also got few stops to explore the temples where we got time to click nice photos. Overall we had a nice time. If in Nihn Bin, I would strongly recommend this boating experience in Trang An.

reviews.author: Luca Magnanensi
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.content: Those passing through Vietnam will hardly miss one of the boat tours in the rivers and canals and caves and undoubtedly those proposed at the site of Trang An are among the most popular. You will have to choose from 3 options, tours 1, 2 or 3, they all last about 2/3 hours more or less, we were told that the best tours were the 2 and 3 and we opted for the 2. Superlative views, you stop to visit several pagodas independently. Bring something for your butt because 3 hours on a bench is a lot

reviews.author: caroleen78
reviews.title: Amazing UNESCO Heritage Class
reviews.content: We arrived very late after a long bike ride from our hotel 15 kms We started the cruise at 3:30 pm The advantage c is that there are few people The scenery is just amazing and the temples Of all beauty The downside c is that it is getting cooler and the last temple was closed On the boats 4 people better be in front but frankly it is to do

reviews.author: Cowmiami
reviews.title: The Great Satisfaction Tour
reviews.content: The facilities are clean and I feel safe and secure. The tour continues with one staff member rowing a boat through beautiful scenery. It was a great satisfaction.

reviews.author: Timea B
reviews.title: Animal mistreat
reviews.content: Hey everyone, we have just visited Trang An. At Khong Temple we have seen 3 little kittens locked in a very small cage without any water, covered by a board. I have attached a photo.We have asked several people about the reason why they are kept like this. We do not think this is the right way, so we have reported this at the information desk, but we did not get any reassuring answer😔.Whoever goes there please check on the kittens.❤

reviews.author: Matthew C
reviews.title: Ruined by others
reviews.content: We were desperately unlucky. The Vietnamese couple we were paired with on our route decided to play loud music on their phones for the entire 3 hours, they put the umbrella up at the front of the boat completely blocking our view, refused to share sitting in the front and back of the boat with us and when I spoke to the boatman using google translate he said something to the couple, they laughed and nothing changed. This completely spoilt our trip, I would advise to either pay more to have a private boat or try to be paired with couples that appear to have genuine interest in seeing the scenery and sharing the experience with you,

reviews.author: Unikuorn
reviews.title: Worth the drive from Hanoi
reviews.content: We decided to visit Ninh Binh instead of Ha Long Bay during our stay in Hanoi, and while it was an hour+ drive in morning rush traffic, our 2+ hour Trang An sampan boat ride was breathtaking, serene, and well worth the drive. We shared our sampan with another couple, rowed by a mighty single woman who expertly navigated us around the river, through the caves, and up to each of the temples. We arrived early and while there were others on the river, it didn’t feel crowded or chaotic. The area is beautifully maintained and well organized.

reviews.author: nami0209
reviews.title: Magnificent Nature
reviews.content: Moved by nature.It was more than I could have imagined.We spent an hour and a half on a rowboat, visiting the shores of lakes, mysterious caves and temples in the mountains, and were very healed.A place worth coming to.It just feels like there are too many tourists.

reviews.author: Patricia
reviews.title: Nice but crowded
reviews.content: The tour is not bad but we liked Tam Coc's better, although they are different. This one is more complete, you visit many more things and make stops. But we found it much more touristy and very long (2h 30 min or so). It is quite crowded, at times the only thing you saw around were boats everywhere (I know you can not be alone, and I am aware that we were also in one of those boats). When we did that there was only one route available which was a mixture of route 2 and route 3, because it had rained a lot and there were things that you couldn't visit. In some caves you couldn't enter. The boatmen row with their hands. Ours was very friendly, took many pictures and was watching all the time. The setting is nice and the places you visit too, but well, for me it is more worth the Tam Coc.

reviews.author: OUFS1990
reviews.title: It's a really good time.
reviews.content: Be sure to bring a raincoat as it will get wet. The weather changes rapidly, with sunny spells and thunderstorms, so it can get hot and cold, so think about what to wear.

reviews.author: MM0980
reviews.title: Beautiful tour with Kong Island
reviews.content: I went there by bike. I had to pay 5,000 or 10,000 VND for the bicycle parking. I booked the shortest tour (route 4): 250,000 VND (all tours cost 250,000). At the jetty you wait until enough participants are in a boat and then the tour begins. Most of them book one of the extended routes, so I had to wait forever. After no one booked Route 4, I was allowed to sit alone in a boat on request (after 40 minutes). Finally, the tour lasted 1 hour: Kong Island, Pavilion, 4 caves and 2 temples. Nice tour. It was also fun to drive through the illuminated caves and explore the temples.

reviews.author: みるく
reviews.title: Enjoy a relaxing time
reviews.content: Like Ha Long Bay, it is registered as a World Heritage Site, so I went there. We spent two hours relaxing on a boat cruise. He lent me an umbrella to replace my parasol. It was full of nature and we enjoyed a relaxing time.

reviews.author: Mike X
reviews.title: Only one route
reviews.content: Normally 3 routes but due to high water only one route available. The long cave is flooded so you won't be able to see it. All boats have umbrellas for shade. You can take turns with others for front of the boat or back of the boat at each stop if you want to. Super slow boat ride and this route is actually not super memorable.

reviews.author: Adventure05703998509
reviews.title: Have a nice boat ride despite the world
reviews.content: We did route 3 during our visit. We hesitated with the route 1 but too few people selected it during our day to fill a boat with other people.The part in the cave of 1 km is really nice, just be ready to be in Indian line behind other boats as in an attraction. The scenery was beautiful and pleasant. I can understand that these caves do not please people allergic to crowds but if not you, they are worth it.

reviews.author: lilybt
reviews.title: Highlights of the Ninh Binh Tour
reviews.content: Now, here is the highlight of the Ninh Binh tour, a boat cruise in Trang An. We choose the Chan An side with advance information that the river is wide and tastes like a pond or a lake, and that merchandisers don't follow like Tam Kok. Get into a rowboat from the dock. The rowers have two aunties who take pictures of us on the way and encourage us to come ashore and visit the temple, but basically the back and forth between us, forbidding commission, is completely non-persistent. I was concerned that the two-hour cruise would be boring, but the landscape changed, so it was over very quickly. Things continued to happen, with squalls towards the end and the disembarkation location being changed so that the guide wouldn't pick me up, but it was a satisfying tour that was acceptable as a memory

reviews.author: Giacinta A
reviews.title: A boat trip through nature's wonders
reviews.content: The boat ride through the caves and past the stunning limestone karsts was truly breathtaking. The kids were fascinated by the natural beauty, though the two-hour journey was a bit long for the younger ones. A beautiful and memorable experience for the whole family!

reviews.author: Milka Gordon
reviews.title: A hidden world!
reviews.content: We felt like we had drifted into another realm while our guide rowed us through the stunning caves and serene waterways of Trang An. The sheer scale of the limestone karsts and the tranquility of the landscape was pure magic. It was the most romantic and peaceful adventure.

reviews.author: Rachel H
reviews.title: Great experience to see beautiful Ninh Binh
reviews.content: We were recommended Trang A for the boat cruise as when we visited in April we were told Tam Coc would be busier. The place is well set up with food options, toilets, shaded seating areas and we only had to wait a couple of minutes for someone else to join on the same route as us before we could depart. We chose route 2 which had a good mix of temples, caves, and stunning views along the river. It was very hot when we visited so definitely need caps, water and sunscreen but umbrellas are also provided on the boat for extra shade. We enjoyed both the boat journey and being able to get off a few times to have a wander round and found the length of the tour just right. Special mention to our boat guide who manually paddles at the rear of the boat and worked tirelessly in the heat to get us round the route. A couple extra paddles are provided so please do help out where you can as the staff work so hard. Definitely recommend this experience whilst in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Stormydog_7
reviews.title: Floating through a magical landscape
reviews.content: Rather than take a tour from Hanoi we took the train to Nihn Binh and organised a driver to pick us up. The train was a great experience (and you get to see the famous Train Street from the train point of view). At Trang An you get to choose what kind of trip you take - one is about wildlife, another about temples and culture, and one takes you to the set of the movie Kong: Skull Island, which was filmed here. You get in a sampan (four people plus a boatman) and paddle slowly through the amazing karst limestone landscape. Someone told us it was like Ha Long but less touristy. You’ll be glad to get off to view the temples - Sampans are not built for 6’3” New Zealanders, and it does feel a bit cramped. But the trip is peaceful and the landscape and caves you go through are magical. It was a long day but absolutely worth it.

reviews.author: Ell Belllll
reviews.title: Must do
reviews.content: Highly recommend. There are four people to a boat, you pick the route you want to take and what you want to see, and then your boat rower will take you throughout. We did route 3 and it was very scenic. The caves were very cool-the first one on route 3 was long (1000 meters). I loved the entire ride. It just gets hot on the boat but there are umbrellas for your use.

reviews.author: Trúc Phan
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: Awesome 2.5 hr trip through the rivers and temples4 people to a boat so you might want to share.I think if you want a private boat you'll need to buy 4 tickets to get it to yourself.Seems quieter in the morning and more busy in the afternoon.Recommended and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Greg R
reviews.title: Boat tour
reviews.content: Great experience.  Caves were fascinating.  The attraction is well managed and excellent value.Highly recommended in this region.

reviews.author: Harirajan Varatharajan
reviews.title: For nature lovers
reviews.content: Visiting Tràng An was an unforgettable experience, offering a perfect mix of natural beauty and cultural heritage. The boat ride through the limestone karst landscape was breathtaking, with each cave and waterway revealing something new. The serene atmosphere, combined with the gentle rowing through emerald-green waters, made for a peaceful escape. Stopping at ancient temples along the way added a fascinating historical touch. The entire experience felt like stepping into a hidden world, and it’s easy to see why Tràng An is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It’s a must-visit for anyone looking to explore Vietnam’s stunning landscapes in a unique and tranquil way.

reviews.author: Claudia B
reviews.title: Poor management
reviews.content: The place is really magical and spectacular. Due to the short time we had chosen to do the 1.5h tour which included 3 stops to visit the temples on the various islands. Unfortunately, the staff at the ticket office can’t speak English, so they sold us a combo ticket explaining maccheronically that with the same, once the boat tour was over, we could visit a village of huts recreated nearby. Actually, once we got to the second stop there were directions to visit the famous village included in the combo ticket, we followed them and reached the village, at which point we would have liked to go back to the boat to complete the tour, surprise: they did not allow us to go back they did not give us any explanation, none of the staff spoke in English, and moreover they all had a rude and rude attitude. When we pointed out that there was nowhere written that we could not go back and that the guide of the boat was waiting for us at the pier to leave they only managed to tell us to call the hotline for information, which we tried to do, but even then the telephone operators did not speak English and as soon as they heard a voice in English they knocked down the phone, this for 3 times! Bitter about throwing money at a tour that was supposed to last 1.5h but lasted only 30 minutes we had to walk out of this village. Scandalous!

reviews.author: Satish P
reviews.title: Wonderful boat ride thru natural caves in waters
reviews.content: This was the highlight of our Ninh Binh visit. We had a nice boat ride thru a wonderful lake with scenic beauty all around. It's quite a refreshing experience.We stopped in between at a very nice temple with good carvings and statues.Then we proceed to the natural caves consisting of stalegmites and stalactites in the waters. We sailed thru them to observe them from very close.

reviews.author: NickGi
reviews.title: If you are in north Vietnam don’t miss this fantastic place!!! It is so beautiful and one of the nicest places in Asia.
reviews.content: Amazing place to visit. Try to get there as early as possible but before 9:00am. It’s very nice to take a 3 or 4 hour trip before it starts getting full in the afternoon. The views are stunning and the peaceful. There a 3 routs you can choose from - Nr 1 ist the best one because it goes through the 1km longe cave.

reviews.author: Janis B
reviews.title: Little overpriced and depend on person who will ride you
reviews.content: Was too long 1.4h.Scam on pictures what they try to sell 200k you can buy same for 90k in shop cross the road.Demanding a tip :(

reviews.author: akio9jp
reviews.title: Explore caves in a rowboat
reviews.content: The river cruise in Changan takes about an hour and a half downriver, passing several large and small caves along the way. It's thrilling as you slither overhead through a cave with a low ceiling.The interior of the cave had a variety of landscapes, including rounded stalactites and rugged rocks, with cool air that was blocked from sunlight.

reviews.author: Consalve
reviews.title: Magical Cave Journey
reviews.content: Gliding through limestone caves with just the sound of water dripping was INCREDIBLE. Our guide was hilarious despite the language barrier. We held hands as we ducked through low cave entrances and gasped at each new vista. Absolute highlight of our Vietnam adventure!

reviews.author: S&O
reviews.title: Boat tour worthwhile
reviews.content: Very worth seeing boat trip to the river caves by boat. Green fields around it - spray well with mosquito repellent beforehand;-). The caves are really incredibly beautiful and huge.

reviews.author: Nick Y
reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.content: This was a really worthwhile experience. The area if full of surprises, from the many caves and grottoes that connect the waterways to the temples and pagodas along the route. One of my favorite activities to do in Vietnam. The surrounding areas are also worth a visit including Hoa Lu ancient capital

reviews.author: Juliette D
reviews.title: Great but go really early
reviews.content: 2 hours without moving in the middle of a friendly Vietnamese crowd and 1 hour of lambda queue allowed us to access the grail: a boat.When you read “go early”, go super early. We were there at 9:00. The experience remains total, the Vietnamese are friendly and smiling despite the fatigue of the wait. Otherwise on the boat side, we took Route 1, we were very pleasantly surprised to find that we were leaving the hundreds of other boats. We were alone for the rest of the walk. A few stops at temples. Lots of caves. Monkeys (macaws and gibbons). Great scenery. Bird song. Nice break in our trip.The best route if you want to take a break with the excitement of the Vietnamese.

reviews.author: Joe R
reviews.title: Nice scenery and boat ride.
reviews.content: One of the highlight of my trip in Ninh Binh and in Tam Coc. It was nice and peaceful boat ride with the lady rowing the boat as we watched on and the caves was cool. We went on a day tour that included Trang An. We went on the longest boat ride to the three caves. Lime stones were nice. Totally recommend to go here and on a boat tour.

reviews.author: Shadow
reviews.title: Avoid on a Sunday morning
reviews.content: Avoid on a Sunday morning !!! The worst line up / crowd I have ever experienced !!!! All our research told us to get there early - bad mistake. We arrived around 8am at people / buses / cars everywhere. It took 2.5 hours from when we arrived to get on a boat. Then when we got off the lines going in where flowing . We have been told that’s very busy as it’s a Sunday - very much local tourists. I would aim to get there after lunch and take advantage of the much smaller lines. Having said all that - I really enjoyed the boat ride. We shared the boat with a lovely couple from Belgium. We stopped at the last temple to have quick, other than that we opted to just keep rowing as we were there for the scenery. We took Route 3 ( est time is 3 hrs, our group took just over 2 hrs) . The river was packed with other boats but that really wasn’t an issue. Beautiful scenery and worth the visit if you don’t have to line up like we did

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.title: Very very busy and confused! Nice but not as good as Tam Coc.
reviews.content: Really really busy and we went in February.  Confusing itinerary and ticket office was on the other side of the road to the boats.  We had to go in a boat of 5 (4 plus the rower) and the 2 others were Vietnamese so chattered loudly and incessantly with the rower all the way through the trip.  Because we’d used the free bikes from our homestay we decided to do Tour 3 which was 1.5 hours as were worried about cycling back in the dark with no lights.  We needn’t have worried as no-one cared!  Anyway, the trip was absolutely jam packed with people, boats and it was a bit of a bun fight to be frank.  Scenery was beautiful but lessened with the constant noise from our companions.  No tip was given on this occasion.  Tam Coc boat trip was far superior - go for that instead!

reviews.author: Mork001
reviews.title: Relaxing and wonderful
reviews.content: What a way to see this wonder.The hoards of people and you can just immerse yourself.Found the grottoes so peaceful.Stopping at the pagodas broke up the cruise around.Very touristy but still a wonderful place to visit

reviews.author: Pier F
reviews.title: Hidden gem!
reviews.content: The tranquil atmosphere of the limestone caves and gentle boat rides through emerald waters left us in awe. It’s a must-visit in Ninh Binh, offering both natural beauty and historical depth. We felt a deep connection to the serene landscapes, making it an unforgettable romantic escape.

reviews.author: Elene Gordon
reviews.title: Nature’s Masterpiece !!!
reviews.content: Gliding through Trang An Grottoes, we were mesmerized by the tranquil waters and towering limestone cliffs. It felt like stepping into an ancient painting. The quiet beauty of the caves left us speechless yet deeply connected. It’s a magical escape where time slows down, perfect for reflection and romance.

reviews.author: chloe h
reviews.title: Some hard work but worth it!
reviews.content: Great morning out.Would recommend getting there early before the busses arrive and before the sun gets going, as it will be cool and peaceful.Only downside was having to wait for someone else to join us in our boat, but we were lucky and it didn't take too long.One pagoda is a lot of steps, towing is fun but tiring and sitting on the boat can hurt your back, so be prepared for some activity.But as long as you're happy with all that you will have a great day.Please do tip your person, they work super hard rowing for 3 hours and don't get paid much.Even was lucky and saw monkeys, kingfishers and fish.

reviews.author: Lynea Wingate
reviews.title: Exploring the Hidden Gem
reviews.content: We paddled through serene waters, surrounded by lush greenery, feeling like explorers in a hidden paradise. This off-the-beaten-path destination offered a perfect escape from the usual tourist spots. Each cave we entered revealed breathtaking formations and tranquil vibes, making it an unforgettable experience for us. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Arlen Lorde
reviews.title: Nature's Masterpiece
reviews.content: The serene boat ride through lush landscapes and stunning limestone formations felt like a scene from a dream. It’s perfect for nature lovers like us, offering a peaceful ambiance that makes you forget the hustle of everyday life. We shared quiet moments, soaking in the beauty around us.

reviews.author: Eddi O
reviews.title: A natural symphony in the heart of Vietnam
reviews.content: The picturesque landscapes of Trang An literally took our breath away. The boat ride through the mysterious caves and karst formations was magical. The tranquil atmosphere, only disturbed by the lapping of water and the singing of birds, transported us to another world. Our local guide was adorable and very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Tootsie O
reviews.title: Rowing at the view, a little dizzy.
reviews.content: The scenery in Chang'an, fantastic! The water was calm as a mirror as we sailed through the boat. The view is picturesque, really! I rowed with objects and felt like I was in wonderland. It's been a long row, but it's beautiful and worth it! Next time, bring the seasickness medicine!

reviews.author: Henry Jackson
reviews.title: Trang An Caves
reviews.content: The tour to Trang An Caves was great! Breathtaking landscapes with limestone mountains and crystal clear rivers crossing spectacular caves. The boat ride was very relaxing and quiet, ideal for enjoying nature. The guide was very knowledgeable and shared interesting information about the history and culture of the area. I highly recommend this tour to those looking for an experience immersed in natural beauty and serenity.

reviews.author: James O
reviews.title: Best of the boat tours by far
reviews.content: This is without question the best boat trip of the numerous available within  Tam Coc, with 4 differing routes on offer with a differing number of pagodas, temples, and caves on each. Routes 1 to 3 are circa 3 hours. I believe  Route 4 is much shorter to tie in with other tours.You do not need a guide or a pre booked ticked, save your money, get a grab, and buy a ticket on arrival.I found route number 1 to be the best choice for me, 3 temples and 9 caves, maybe it's just ignorance, but for me, one temple is like another. However, the caves were very individual, and the formations were stunningly impressive. It is a super regenerating 3 hours immersed among beautiful towering landscape and calm tranquil waters.We went about 11.00 and don't be put off by the crowds at the dock, there are a huge number of boats and it is super efficient at the loading point. However, avoid just after lunch, on our return at 14.00, it was charge of the light brigade down the river.We got a boat for just us two and soon after heading off the differing routes diverge into differing routes, hence  we were off times on our own or at least such a distance from the next boat so as for it to be irrelevant. We had a lovely lady oars woman, and although she had no english, we communicated perfectly well through made-up sign language. There are paddles for you to help propultion should you wish.A discrete tip before reaching the disembarking point is greatly appreciated.I thought it was superb and loved the caves that were lite but were restrictive in parts with just enough room for the boat and us huddled over to pass through.Highly recommend and a vote for route 1.

reviews.author: Dee_Mc04
reviews.title: Trang An boat trip & most do & such a relaxing few hours to spend enjoying the amazing location.
reviews.content: We got a grab out & went out early morning around 8.30am to try to avoid the crowds which we did, still busy at that hour. We took route 2 & it’s 2.5hrs. From start to finish what amazing trip, it’s so peaceful, tranquil & stunning. The lady who took us out was so nice offered to take group photos of of us a certain spots, when we stopped at a temple left us to wonder around & come back in our own time. This is a most do & well worth it. It’s so well organised & the main area is lovely too with plenty of amenities & nice place to eat. We had something small to eat in the May cafe & it was delicious. No hassle either getting a taxi from here back into Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Karuna K
reviews.title: Tranquility in a crazy world
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed our visit - we have a 2 year old so we decided not to go on a boat trip - though they looked wonderful! But we enjoyed a walk along the river and the building had a lot of interesting information and cafe and restaurants and you could buy fish food to feed the fish. Definitely worth a visit

reviews.author: Georgina Pep
reviews.title: hidden gem!
reviews.content: Gliding through the serene waterways of Trang An, we couldn't stop gawking at the towering karst formations. The biodiversity here is mind-boggling - from rare birds to lush vegetation. Our boat lady's singing echoed magically through the caves, adding to the mystical vibe.

reviews.author: Clare F
reviews.title: Trang An is beautiful and a priority when in Tam Coc
reviews.content: We hired bicycles from our Home astray and cycled the 10km from Tam Coc to Trang An. Then we bought tickets to Tour 1 on the boat. It was an incredible 3 hours! So peaceful and truly beautiful. Definitely worth it.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Trang An spectacular
reviews.content: For the Trang An Boat Tour you do not need to contact a tour operator or a guide, you go directly to Trang An at the ticket office and at a cost of about € 9 per person you can take a 3 hour tour, you will board a rowing boat with 4 seats and a boatman will transport you all the way. along the river you will pass some wonderful karst caves, and you will have the opportunity to stop at points of interest where there are Vietnamese temples of rare beauty, maintained with great care. It is one of the most impressive and exciting excursions I have done in Vietnam. Avoid the Tam Coc tour, it's shorter and much less beautiful. Upon returning from the boat tour I recommend visiting Mua Cave, it is really worth it!

reviews.author: Annalise W
reviews.title: Paddles & Pure Zen
reviews.content: The boat ride was so peaceful, a truly tranquil atmosphere.  We felt like we were in a movie!  Seriously,  a place of tranquility and wonder.  The caves were kinda spooky but also super cool.  We even saw a goat!  Random, but amazing.  Definitely recommend, even if you're not normally into "nature stuff."

reviews.author: Daisey Lee
reviews.title: A Hidden Gem in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: This UNESCO World Heritage Site is a place of tranquility and wonder, where we paddled through breathtaking caves and lush greenery. Although we weren't alone in our exploration, the beauty of the landscape made it feel special. We loved every moment in this true hidden gem 💗

reviews.author: 佐藤 健
reviews.title: Romantic adventure in nature
reviews.content: The boat ride around the limestone caves of Trang An was like being in a dream. Surrounded by lush mountains, time passed to deepen our love in silence. I was captivated by the beauty of nature, and the bond between them became even stronger.

reviews.author: Carlos D
reviews.title: Beautiful and unique nature in Vietnam
reviews.content: Beautiful place, with beautiful caves and mountains, which you enjoy calmly on a boat with reels, which you can sail along with the boatman. Tranquil and transparent waters. A paradise on earth that was used as scenarios for the films Godzilla and Avatar.

reviews.author: Kyrstin Alice
reviews.title: A magical journey through caves and time
reviews.content: The serene waterways, hidden temples, and awe-inspiring caves felt like something out of an Indiana Jones film. A must-do for any visitor to Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Elle Cicilia
reviews.title: off-the-beaten-path destination
reviews.content: The gentle sounds of water and birdsong created a soothing backdrop for our exploration. This hidden gem in Ninh Binh offered us a perfect escape from the bustling tourist spots, making it an unforgettable part of our journey.

reviews.author: Sunny
reviews.title: Attractive destination
reviews.content: At the moment I came here, the weather was not good, it rained a lot. But I really enjoy 3 hour on boat riding through this incredible scenery It’s worth to experience when you come here definitely

reviews.author: RitaJG
reviews.title: Amazing experience, stunning nature
reviews.content: Amazing experience. Stunning nature scenery. Must see in Ninh Binh. Going by small boat with 4 people, visiting caves and temples.

reviews.author: 黃貴生
reviews.title: Explore the mysterious caves of Chang'an
reviews.content: Adventure in Chang'an Cave gives us an unparalleled sense of mystery and tranquillity. Rowing a canoe through the magnificent landscape and listening to the stories told by our guides, we felt as if we were back in time. Surprises at every turn, it's a couple's time to treasure!

reviews.author: 시연 안
reviews.title: Mysterious cavern exploration in Chengdu
reviews.content: The experience of passing the caves by boat was really special. The scenery between the limestone cliffs was so beautiful, and the guide's interesting explanation was good. We took a three-hour course, and I didn't know the time was going. A hidden jewel of Vietnam. Make sure to visit!

reviews.author: Pierre K
reviews.title: Remarkable caves
reviews.content: Beautiful caves. We were able to take our time at the individual stops and enjoyed it very much. It is very touristy, yet it is definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Burgess D
reviews.title: Vietnam's hidden gem
reviews.content: We were mesmerized by the boat ride through the caves! Our local rower was skilled and entertaining. The limestone formations and crystal-clear water were spectacular. It felt like being transported to another world entirely.

reviews.author: Germaine Kope
reviews.title: Absolutely magical
reviews.content: The limestone caves and emerald waters created an otherworldly experience. Our local rower skillfully guided us through narrow grottos while sharing fascinating stories. The combination of natural beauty and ancient temples made this a highlight of our Vietnam adventure. The peacefulness was simply enchanting.

reviews.author: Lynn W
reviews.title: Stunning caves
reviews.content: Option 3 boat trip has the biggest & best caves. One cave being 1km long (so not for you if you are claustrophobic).Thought I wouldn't like the fact that there is a constant stream of boats & people - but once on our boat & quietly being rowed along, it was very peaceful.The long cave is stunning. Some low areas that you have to duck low.It is a long trip on a little low boat, so not easy if you have back or leg issues. Which I do! But it was worth it.

reviews.author: Trevor
reviews.title: Our boat trip through Trang An!
reviews.content: The limestone caves and emerald waters created such a mystical atmosphere. Our local rower skillfully guided us through narrow grottoes while sharing fascinating stories. The ancient temples and lush landscapes made this experience unforgettable.

reviews.author: 우진 진
reviews.title: The mysterious nature exploration of Tranan
reviews.content: On a boat, we passed through countless caves and beautiful landscapes, smiling at each other. Listening to the sounds of nature and completely immersed in the peaceful atmosphere of this place. The meal together was an opportunity to taste the essence of local food, and all these moments made our love deeper. I want to go back!

reviews.author: Joel T
reviews.country: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
reviews.title: Boat trip on the Trang An
reviews.content: A 3-hour boat ride on Route 1. A spectacular landscape that made us feel in a movie. The amazing grottos and the very stable boat. A highly recommended and safe experience, I would repeat again.

reviews.author: Adriana
reviews.title: Adventure and tranquility
reviews.content: The local rowers skillfully guided us through narrow grottoes, where ancient temples and lush greenery created picture-perfect scenes. The 2-3 hour tour felt like stepping into a natural masterpiece. A must-visit

reviews.author: Blondell C
reviews.title: The Magic of the Caves
reviews.content: What a magical experience! Our boat ride through the Trang An caves transported us to another world. Our rower was adorable, and the karst landscapes breathtaking. Tip: leave early in the morning to avoid the crowds and enjoy the freshness.

reviews.author: Pierre Lefèvre
reviews.title: A hidden gem in the heart of the majestic cliffs
reviews.content: The majestic limestone cliffs stood around us, creating a breathtakingly picturesque landscape. Sailing through the serene waters, each cave crossed revealed natural wonders. This enchanting site, still preserved from mass tourism, offers an authentic and unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Carolyn L
reviews.title: Very nice but a little too long
reviews.content: This was one of the highlights on an otherwise very ordinary trip by TripaDeal!We found that sitting on those hard seats for 1  3/4 hours was a bit too long.

reviews.author: RafiMom
reviews.title: Interesting outing.
reviews.content: We were on route 1 and it was absolutely torrential rain and thunderstorms for most of our trip. In a weird way it was more interesting and cool because we were almost alone out there. Even in the Sun, it’s not the most beautiful place but it’s definitely worth seeing. As we were heading back and the sun came out, dozens and dozens of boats headed out so were actually glad to not be in the crowds. We helped row on the way back and the lady absolutely refused a tip from us.

reviews.author: Fehrenbach R
reviews.title: Exploring Trang An Grottoes
reviews.content: As an off the beaten path destination, it offered us a serene escape from the usual tourist trails. We navigated the peaceful waterways, surrounded by lush landscapes and towering limestone karsts. Along the way, we encountered ancient temples and pagodas, each steeped in history and culture. This hidden gem in Ninh Binh provided us with a unique glimpse into Vietnam's rich heritage and natural beauty.

reviews.author: Karoly G
reviews.title: Row, row, row your boat (gently down the grotto)
reviews.content: Breathtaking scenery at every turn - we're talking Avatar-level gorgeous.  Paddling through caves with stalactites nearly kissing our heads was... an experience.  😬  Historical significance? Check.  Romantic boat ride for two? Double check! 😉 Ninh Binh surprised us, and Trang An was the crown jewel.

reviews.author: Cruiser13V
reviews.title: Even with the continuous rain, this row boat excursion was a lot of fun.
reviews.content: It's quite a show to watch since the rowers, who are primarily women, utilize their legs most of the time. This was a fantastic experience made much better by the pleasant river and caverns. It requires many hours.

reviews.author: Billy H
reviews.title: 3-hour boat ride
reviews.content: This place was so wonderful. We did a 3-hour boat ride with multiple stops and visits to caves. The view here is amazing. Loved it! But once again, remember to bring water and a fan. It's still very hot in Vietnam during this month!

reviews.author: Trystan Wiza
reviews.title: A Hidden Wonder in the Heart of Vietnam
reviews.content: This off-the-beaten-track destination offers a unique experience. Sailing in a traditional boat, we were amazed by the majestic limestone cliffs that rise above the crystal clear waters. Trang An is truly a haven of tranquility and wonder, away from the tourist hustle and bustle. The caves crossed by boat add a touch of adventure to this peaceful excursion. For nature and history lovers, this UNESCO World Heritage Site is a must-see in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Jonathan Phan
reviews.title: Trang An Evaluation
reviews.content: Visited Trang An during the second week of June, just before the weekend. The guided tour was respectful and informative. The overall experience was phenomenal. Definitely worth it and highly recommended for tourists.

reviews.author: Devid P.
reviews.title: Quiet and relaxing nature
reviews.content: We spent a full day in this natural paradise. The quiet of the nature and the beautiful, fascinating caves makes this part of Vietnam one of the most beautiful to visit

reviews.author: Russ Lacuata
reviews.title: Magical
reviews.content: Trang An is my favorite place in Vietnam. It is renowned for taking visitors on tranquil boat tours through emerald waters along limestone landscapes and ancient pagodas. During your boat ride, you'll see limestone cave system. Historic pagodas are scattered throughout the site.  Trang An landscape played a major role in the movie: Kong: Skull Island.

reviews.author: Coyote-Travelerz
reviews.title: River Ride with Crowds
reviews.content: This is a very popular attraction. Arrive in the early morning or late afternoon to avoid or limit exposure to the crowds. Our tour tried to visit in the late morning but it was so busy we came back 6-7 hours later when it was less busy. Expect to wait at least 20-30 minutes in line to get on a boat. The boat trip is very pleasant and provides a unique view of the valley walls in a mostly quiet setting. Traveling through the caves on the is a unique experience to be enjoyed.

reviews.author: Will C
reviews.title: Defo worth a visit!
reviews.content: Incredible scenery, super friendly guide, so pretty your eyes can’t comprehend what you’re seeing, it’s like you’re in a painting. At the stops around the tour you can buy drinks and ice creams to cool down (it was 40*C the day we did it), they also provided umbrellas to shade from the sun. Very good boat drivers, the row the whole way and navigate the caves expertly. Café and food at the start/finish point is good aswell!

reviews.author: Bronzebuddha
reviews.title: Route 3 was incredible!
reviews.content: Trang an is such a special experience with the most gorgeous temples. We did route 3 and I’m so glad we chose this option as we got to see everything.

reviews.author: SHAHIDA
reviews.title: Nice and peaceful place
reviews.content: Gliding through the serene waterways, surrounded by towering limestone cliffs and lush greenery, was pure magic.  We loved spotting the diverse wildlife and exploring the hidden caves.  A relaxing and unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Bagley Crump
reviews.title: Row, row, row your boat 🛶
reviews.content: This place ins STUNNING. Picture perfect scenery everywhere you look. We opt for the rowboat 🚣‍♀️ (pro tip: bring cash to tip your rower!) and it was so serene and peaceful. Just be ready to squat for those boat pics!

reviews.author: Emacado
reviews.title: Amazing place - friendly people
reviews.content: Had an amazing time here! The lady in the boat was very kind and friendly. It was very hot today and we helped her paddle which made us get out of the heat very fast. She didn’t beg for a tip on the tour and we always felt comfortable. Of course, in the end we gave her a tip voluntarily because it was a lovely experience.

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.title: Definitely worth it
reviews.content: During this boat tour, you can explore the magnificent landscape, caves and pagodas. There are multiple tours available, all for the same price of 250.000 dong. We chose tour 3, since it has only three caves and shows a lot of the scenic landscape. Tipping the drivers is welcomed.

reviews.author: Getaway11842841363
reviews.title: Unforgettable experience!
reviews.content: Excellent afternoon was spent doing this wonderful trip.We chose to do route 3 and felt it was the best route by far. Saw pretty much everything and the long cave is worth choosing this route for as well as the mind blowing temples you stop at.Exceeded our expectations so much. Highly recommend this amazing experience. Halong Bay on land ♥️

reviews.author: leen V
reviews.title: Most beautiful activity in Vietnam
reviews.content: This was the most beautiful thing we have done in Vietnam. There was only one route closed so not too busy and we had a very friendly lady. The scenery is absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Mgh070
reviews.title: Way too busy
reviews.content: The setting is really beautiful! However, the crowds made it a tourist circus. Because of flooding, two of the three routes were closed so all boats also went the same route. The dozens (if not hundreds) of other boats really ruined it. Everywhere you look you see only bright orange life jackets.Maybe we were there at a bad time or we were unlucky but if I had known this I wouldn't have gone. Again; that is not the environment and I am sure we would have had a very different experience if there had been (far) fewer others.

reviews.author: Vischio
reviews.title: Beautiful caves, breathtaking nature
reviews.content: I never imagined that Vietnam was so beautiful, that people were so welcoming.the Hike made in this lovely place was a real discovery because actually in the cities Hanoi, Ho chi Min and Dangan you can not enjoy the intact nature as here. The caves are really beautiful.

reviews.author: Veba1980
reviews.title: Wonderful rowing boat ride
reviews.content: The scenery is unmatched and even though we had a rainy day we were lucky enough to at least be able to do half the route, an hour and a half instead of the planned three hours. We pass through beautiful caves, it is not a walk suitable for claustrophobics, quite an adventure with or without rain. I recommend donning rain ponchos, jackets are not enough. The boats have super umbrellas available, our rower took pictures of us, you can see temples on the tour a pagoda and the island where a part of the Kong film was filmed.

reviews.author: Axbridgemum
reviews.title: Busy but better late afternoon
reviews.content: Amazing experience just be prepared to wait a little for a boat if you are travelling alone. Dont forget to tip your (usually lady) boat rower. Working so hard for two or more hours. I was told by a local 50k is usual.

reviews.author: Efaw Plagens
reviews.title: Fantastic tour!
reviews.content: Spending the day with her was an absolute delight, making the experience even more memorable. Highly recommend for everyone!!!

reviews.author: Tourist292129
reviews.title: Nice but lots of tourists
reviews.content: Nice but super crowded. If you like crowds then go if not  we’ll be prepared. Wear comfy shoes / hat / sun block / sunglasses

reviews.author: Vũ Hải Nam
reviews.title: Majestic and beautiful natural scenery.
reviews.content: Trang An is like Ha Long Bay on land. Experience scenic boating through primeval swamps and caves. We can perform ceremonies at spiritual temples. Besides, the service is highly appreciated with the enthusiastic guidance and kindness of the boat driver.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Great boat trip
reviews.content: We came here after being on the boat in Tam Coc, we felt this was better. It takes nearly three hours and on tour 3 you go through about 6 caves ( one is a km long ) and have to duck your head. The scenery is beautiful and you stop  three times at different pagodas and temples. The lady rows with her hands ( she used her feet in Tam Coc ) and she works very hard. There are oars in the boat so the passengers can help out, I think this was appreciated. Definitely a must do experience.

reviews.author: tessybear97
reviews.title: Magical place
reviews.content: Well organised operation, very professional. We arrived at the ticket counter,  and then directed to boats, of which there seemed to be about 1,500! You can choose 1 of 5 routes, due to high water levels we could only choose 2, and we still had to duck right down through the caves! It's a magical place! The boat ride lasts about 2.5hrs (4 to a boat). Usually stops at a few temples to walk about (so cover up) and a few caves (depending on the route chosen). It's nice to tip the rower, but not compulsory.

reviews.author: Minu J
reviews.title: Our best experience in Vietnam.
reviews.content: We travelled with our extended family this April and found this to be the highlight of our trip. The boat ride was so picturesque and relaxing. We took the route that goes through the Kong mountains which didnt have too many caves. The largest cave we went in was around 340 m or so,but still worth every bit. The boat drivers do not understand much of English, but that was never a problem. They were able to communicate effectively. The pagoda's in between were amazing. Couple of points to note:1.Wear a sunscreen and goggles because it can get very sunny and hot. Boats do have umbrellas ,so incase needed you can always use that.2.Try to reach Ninn Binh earlier,because I found it too crowded in the afternoon.3.some of stops in between have bathroom facilities as well .So no need to worry incase you are travelling with kids.So to sum up, I would say this is a must visit spot for anyone travelling to Ninn Binh.

reviews.author: Hal
reviews.title: Nature's jaw-dropping wonders & sore butts
reviews.content: Majestic limestone cliffs, enchanting caves, and scenery so magnificent we almost forgot about the epic soreness in our rear ends. Those boat seats are no joke!  A word to the wise: bring a cushion. Trust us. But seriously, this place is a must-see.  The views were worth every numb-bum moment.  Just imagine paddling through narrow caves, ducking under low ceilings, and feeling like tiny explorers in a massive, awe-inspiring world. If you're up for a little adventure (and can handle a sore backside), Trang An Grottoes won't disappoint.

reviews.author: Ivan M
reviews.title: Trip
reviews.content: The beauty of this place cannot be expressed in words!! I definitely recommend everyone to visit. Allow at least half a day for the trip. By boat you sail between beautiful mountains through magical caves. All surrounded by beautiful nature and temples. On the way, we were accompanied by a famous lady with ship number 777, who brightened up our whole day. She explained everything to us beautifully, for which I thank her ♡

reviews.author: Lan P
reviews.title: Great facility !!! And the river tour is fantastic .
reviews.content: This was an amazing experience. We were expected to row (not a big deal to me) and the couple in the boat with us were taking photos rather than helping to row for large parts of the tour. They also used umbrellas a good deal so just note your view could be partially obscured at some points. None of this detracted from the tour. I’ve never seen a place so beautiful. Try to go at a time when it it less busy. We went very early before the tourists were bussed in.

reviews.author: Voyageur
reviews.title: Extraordinary
reviews.content: Incredible boat trip to admire extraordinary landscapesYou will be led by a rower who rows with his feet, incredible and breathtaking tranquility1h15 visit

reviews.author: Kraka S
reviews.title: A Must Do!
reviews.content: Cannot Miss This! A Must Do! Cannot say any more. Just do it! What a once in a lifetime experience. Very unique and can be done all times of the day.

reviews.author: joegnaniah
reviews.title: Unique experience not to be missed
reviews.content: A unique experience travelling on small row boats (sampan). The ride which takes you past interesting buildings, through long caves is definitely a must do.

reviews.author: Souhenambaye
reviews.title: A must-see natural wonder
reviews.content: Forget the crowds of Ha Long Bay – Trang An Grottoes is all about that tranquil, otherworldly beauty. We got a small boat that took us winding through lush valleys and straight into majestic caves. The scenery was honestly breathtaking – huge cliffs, little temples hidden in the greenery... definitely felt like we were in a movie! Even with other tourists, it never felt busy. Perfect spot for a relaxed day trip and gorgeous photos.

reviews.author: RFK
reviews.title: A glimpse at another world
reviews.content: Gliding by Sanpan through the wetlands and through the grotto was a delightful experience. It’s a tad touristy at the start and end with hawkers and cheap souvenir vendors but if you look past all that it’s a glimpse into another world. Once through the grotto you’re immersed in verdant green rice fields with white cranes, flowering trees and dramatic limestone cliffs. Our rower snapped off a plant stalk to show us a large cluster of brilliant pink eggs that we’d noticed throughout the ride. She did not speak English so we could not understand what it was and what she was telling us. Once back at the dock our guide explained that they were the eggs of American apple snails, a pest that the Chinese had planted there specifically to destroy the rice crops in Viet Nam.  This was another instance of seeing the best and worst in a land replete with both.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: Gets very busy on a Sunday in March. Time your visit carefully to avoid disappointment.
reviews.content: We made the mistake of trying to go on a Sunday in March. Arrived at 9am figuring it might get busy to find approx 2000 people in the queue - quite possibly more. Turns out it is traditional for the Vietnamese to visit the Trang An caves at arround this time on a Sunday at this time of year. The boats carry no more than 6 each and so there was no possibility of for us getting out on the water without a very long wait indeed so we were forced to abandon our plans for the day:(

reviews.author: Hydro Lawn Solu... F
reviews.title: Brilliant tour three. Awesome caves.
reviews.content: Definitely do trang am rather than tam coc! Beautiful caves, great temples and gardens. Yes it is a bit busier but there is a reason for that. It's way better.

reviews.author: Fatimata
reviews.title: A majestic and historic adventure
reviews.content: Navigating through its intricate canals surrounded by lush vegetation transported us to another world. The history impregnated in every corner of these caves left us breathless. A truly majestic experience that we recommend to all couples looking for a romantic getaway full of history and nature. Do not miss it!

reviews.author: Ricardo
reviews.title: Greate boat trip to sightsee this beautiful complex
reviews.content: Beautiful rivers and mountains. Our boat trip was nothing but amazing. The day we visited the place was not every busy, so the sencery was tranquil and we had a goof talk with the boatmen. Quite surprise to know that they are paid by trip, not a fixed salary. Really recommend this activity for sighseeing, and for supporting the locals

reviews.author: Phuong Mr.
reviews.title: Nice boat ride and island visit
reviews.content: I always recommend this rather than Tam Coc. And You' d better choose 1.5 hour route   and Khe Coc island instead of choosing long route 2.5 hour or 3 hour

reviews.author: Calum
reviews.title: Fab!!!
reviews.content: Great time! 3 different options of route, but basically just pick one and hope for the best  (I imagine they're all fab). I went solo, but boats have to be a minimum of 4, so you just wait for a sutlitable number of boat buddies & hope you're lucky!

reviews.author: Angie H
reviews.title: Overcrowded, not serene/tranquil at all
reviews.content: Not sure if it's just because we were there the last weekend of the Lunar New Year holiday for Vietnemese, but this place was instanely crowded. We arrived in the morning and left because we could see huge lines. We came back at the end of the day, around 4pm, and we were one of the last groups let onto boats. Even though there were no lines to get on, we could see that the line infrastructure was like Disneyland with rows and rows of lines setup. We got in our boat and ran into two massive jam ups of boats waiting to go single file through the grotto (cave tunnels). The scenery is beautiful but I wish we could've experienced it without the crowds.

reviews.author: prince
reviews.title: Insane boat journey!
reviews.content: Loved the 3 hour boat journeyGo for the ROUTE 3 which is the best!It is serene and divineThe whole journey and visiting temples The cherry on cake was boating under the cavesMust do in Ninh Binh and Tam Coc

reviews.author: Marie-Claude G
reviews.title: Unsuspected
reviews.content: Surprising landscapes, I loved crossing Dot's cave. I didn't expect to be so impressed by crossing the caves.

reviews.author: luonghongtrung
reviews.title: Parking ticket prices are too expensive.
reviews.content: The organization is quite methodical. The tour guide is friendly and gentle. The scene is beautiful, both majestic and lyrical. The cave is clean, long and has many exploration options.The downside is that parking tickets are too expensive.

reviews.author: Rosemary C
reviews.title: A must do trip in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: The boat trip, caves, grottos and temples were amazing particularly the Torii gate in the water and the last temple. One cave is 1 kilometre to go through and that was equally such an experience! The lady who rowed the boat had very little English and was lovely all the trip. I understand other places bully people with vendors arriving to sell snacks on water.  Absolutely none of this and this is not acceptable on a trip as you need to trust the person managing boat. The pink water lilies, green tea trees were an added bonus never mind the awe inspiring scenery of the limestone karsts from the boat. The day was misty rain but made no difference as there are umbrellas or bring rain poncho. Also good shoes for getting on and off boats at temples etc. Do go and visit here and be there at 9,00am as the place gets very busy later with day trips from Halong bay and Hanoi. We were there early and think this makes a big difference but not everyone plans to stay the night in the area to be able to do this .. This is a very busy organised operation but so worth the experience. It is also a busy Vietnamese tourist location. I noticed the Vietnamese when we were there do not tip the ladies rowing the boats. I know tipping is not generally standard here. However a tip of Vietnamese dollars if coming from Euro currency would make their day … it is a tough job rowing these boats and will not kill your budget much to give something.

reviews.author: CHARLENE G.
reviews.title: A highlight of the trip, a must do experience.
reviews.content: This was a highlight of the trip.  We climbed into small flatboats rowed by an oarswoman down the river through the caves.  What an awesome experience.  It is so beautiful and peaceful.  Can't say enough good about this experience. Don't miss it!

reviews.author: A D K
reviews.title: Enjoyed this boat tour but know it's crowded!
reviews.content: We did 3 boat tours in Ninh Binh, and this was my 2nd favorite.  We stayed in Ninh Binh 3 nights, and we rented a motorcycle from our hotel.  We had to pay 15,000 for parking.  The boat tour costs 250,000 each, and you choose from 3 different tours, based on what they offer.  We chose Tour 3 because it was recommended as the most beautiful and because it goes through a 1 km long cave passage.  Each boat holds 4 people, and they pair you up with 2 others.  If you don't wanna pair up, you can pay for the 2 other seats and have the boat to yourself.  I don't recommend this, as there are lots of other boats around and lots of people.  If you are expecting a peaceful, quiet tour, this is not it.  Tour 3 stops at 3 temples that are big and grand.  Our boat guide gave us 5-10 minutes per temple, which was enough for us.  There are 3 caves, and the caves are lit with electric lights.  There are lots of boats around with lots of people.  We were there in the winter, and it was beautiful to see all of the karsts.  That said, we were not there in the peak season, with beautiful rice fields. That would truly be spectacular.    It's noteworthy that our guide spoke a little English and pointed out things of interest to us.  He was friendly and kind. I did not note this as our favorite boat ride because of the many, many people there.  For our favorite boat ride of the 3 we took in Ninh Binh, try Linh Coc pier, which is only 1 km from the Lalita Tam Coc Resort.  At Linh Coc, the ride is only an hour.  We went about 9 am and were the only boat on the tour.  Just the 2 of us and our guide.  We only saw one other boat the entire trip, and that was a guy checking on his buffalo.  It cost 150,000 per person, and they didn't even bother making us wear life jackets.  When we went in the 3 caves, there was no electricity, but our guide handed us the flashlight.  I enjoyed this tour because we saw wild pigs (8 of them), white birds (sorry, I don't know the names), bats, buffalo, and mountain goats.  Linh Coc was my favorite tour because it was very peaceful and quiet.  No other tourists.  Also, our Linh Coc guide rowed the boat with his feet the entire hour!  So I am mentioning this in case you are looking for an alternative to Trang An or Tam Coc, which are both very popular. Please note, on both of these tours, it's expected to tip the boat guide.  Either tour you choose, I think you'll be enchanted by the natural beauty of Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.title: Shangri-la Oasis
reviews.content: One of the most magical places on earth. The area has been well planned and revitalised for tourism. Great cave systems and shrines to see, with clean toilets in each area. The only negative would be the Rowers 'expect to be tipped' so aren't the most thankful when you do tip them even if you do tip a lot. Mind you they do so much rowing so do assist as most are elderly and women Rowers. Tips recommended by tour guides are 20k per passenger.

reviews.author: Smartmart07
reviews.title: Beautiful in every way.
reviews.content: Incredible scenery and so serene. I chose to visit Trang An as there are three options for your tour, compared to one at Tam Coc, as it wasn’t the harvest season for the rice I chose Trang An, I certainly don’t regret my choice.

reviews.author: ruth o
reviews.title: Serene boat ride
reviews.content: Worth the visit. Water was clear and weather pristine. Lots to see. My teenage kids enjoyed the ride

reviews.author: Mick247
reviews.title: Cave tour 3
