reviews.content: Go really early or after lunch? There are a huge amount of tour groups at the queue that snakes on n on.we queued for about 40min. But overall the view is worth it.We took route 3 with the low ceiling caves where u need to lower ur heads else u get a bad bump.Went on a foggy n cold day that made the hills looks mystical. Awesome view. The longest cave system is on route 3. And some stops for the buddist temple. As well as a visit to kong island.No need to tip the boat lady. There r paddles on the boat that we can use to row abit faster 🤣 had a small rowing competition w other boat near by.Took appox 2hr. Just on the route.

reviews.author: Sarad
reviews.title: TRANG AN
reviews.content: It is amazing but I suggest you to reach Trang An during the early morning when it is not crowded. You will enjoy calm, silence and nature sounds. And don’t forget to check the weather: prefer sunny days to enjoy shiny colours.

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.title: Stunning Tourist Machine
reviews.content: All the photos are true though don't come during high season because there will be WAY too many people queuing in a metal maze that makes Disneyland look like the corner store. Recommend route 2 for a less hectic experience.

reviews.author: Caryn Jen
reviews.title: Nice but You Have to Help Row The Boat!
reviews.content: We tried Trang An instead of Tam Coc boat tour because I read online that Tam Coc has lot of scam. Parking is across the road (VND15,000), take the ticket and pay when you exit. Upon arrival there is 3 boat tour to choose (Tour A, B and C). We choose B because it covers Skull Island and caves. I can't exactly explain what are the routes but C takes the longest and A doesn't cover Skull island.Can't remember the entrance ticket is between VND100,000-200,000/pax depending on which route you choose. After paying for the ticket walk over to the dock, you can't miss it because a horde of people there waiting to board the boat.It's super chaotic, tell the guy/lady that looks like they are in charge which route you choose because they put people who chose the same route in the same boat. and they will only leave with 4 people. I don't see 6 when i was there, max was 4.Shortly after departure, the boat lady pointed to the oars, and asked us to help her row =.= This is probably the most unrelaxing boat tour i ever took because i finish it feeling tired. All 4 of us helped to row but of course the 2 people behind us occasionally rowed and even if they did it was like doing nothing. We tried asking her things like how long is the tour or where is she taking us but she just smiles.Anyways fast forward we arrive at Kong Island, it's not really exciting but just nice to have a few shots here and there but that's it. The boat lady was waiting at the end of the Skull Island set, so make sure you remember your boat number. She passed us a survey form for us to fill about our comments/what we think about the tour. In that form there is a question, did the boatman/lady ask for a tip, i circled no because at that time she didn't ask for any. VERY SMART INDEED! At the end of the tour when we arrived, she suddenly is able to speak english and ask for a tip but we ignored her, her face immediately turned sour and is no longer smiling. I'm not tipping because we did not have a relaxing boat ride and we had to row with her almost the entire tour which was about 2 hours long. See what I mean by smart because it is true that when you fill up the survey she didn't ask for tip, she ask for it after you fill up the form. So fill up the form at the end of the trip so you can give an accurate review.

reviews.author: su5ie96
reviews.title: 4 stars
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the boat trip, only given 4 stars instead of 5 because at the end he asked for a tip. We were going to tip anyway but thought it was a bit cheeky.

reviews.author: Kassa
reviews.title: beautiful but touristy
reviews.content: exceptionally beautiful scenery, but many tourists.  KIng Kong set was a bit of a joke, but didnt matter as we didnt go for that!  Amazing to paddle the boat through the caves, but watch your head!

reviews.author: Willaim S
reviews.title: Avoid Avoid Avoid.
reviews.content: February is a no go for this attraction, unless you like 2 plus hours in a disorderly que then a squashed wait while you are herded across the road and gates closes behind you on the connecting bridge. This is then a bun fight to get a boat with 6 people and join the other hundreds of boats on the river. This is not the idilic leisure cruise you think it will be. Tooooo many people and boats. Even if you arrive at 8.30am. Sad but its just too popular.

reviews.author: pink00flamingo
reviews.title: Good option when it's sunny
reviews.content: This was part of a tour I had arranged and I was really looking forward to it.  There are 3 river tour options depending on what you want to see.  They all take between 2-3 hours and cost the same.  I would recommend using the loo before hand and stocking up on water and snacks.  The ladies that row you about are not allowed to ask for tips but as this is really hard work for them I would suggest that you do tip - but before you get back to the pier in case the money you give gets taken off of them.

reviews.author: smallasapeanut
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: We did this as part of a day trip excursion...so everything was arranged for us.  That said, it appeared that it would have been very easy to find the Grotto area as it was well sign posted.  Boats are "overly" plentiful...thankfully for us it was not very busy on our day....I would hate to be there if all the boats were out!  So it would be very easy to always get a boat.  It appears you need to take the boat with 4 people (incl of oneself) this was my only criticism as for us we were sat behind the other couple which does impair ones forward view somewhat.  Perhaps if you are on your own you would be able to negotiate over this and no doubt pay more....but its so cheap so it would be worth it!The tour lasted just over 2 hours....You have the option to be dropped at a "skull island" which was used as a film set in a King Kong film where the remnants of this are still evident....in my mind i don't think this part was at all necessary and detracts from the sheer natural beauty of its surroundings. You are peacefully rowed by the single effort of a small yet seemingly powerful woman through the awesome scenery and through caves (be warned you do "need" to duck right down in some) there is something to see at all times.Very highly recommended

reviews.author: Jalal Iqbal
reviews.title: exploring by boat
reviews.content: these caves and places are amazing. and going there with a nice and cool boat ride made these places even better. felt like in a smaller ha long bay. i spent like 2 hours here and loved it much.

reviews.author: Faithforever98
reviews.title: Great boat trip
reviews.content: There are three routes you choose, despite being in the correct lineup for route 1, and being asked 2 ce which route.  We ended up on a route 3 Sampan, to be honest, it was very very busy with têt.  Our boat had four passengers and it was glorious, through caves and to pagodas, also route three takes you to King Kong movie set.  We heard the gvmnt had tried to discourage tipping so there’s a questionnaire.  Haha, we filled out the questionnaire and got asked for tips, after we handed the completed as ‘no’. ‘Did your baoatman ask for tips.’ Very crafty.haha.  3 hours great trip.

reviews.author: JSRees
reviews.title: Halong Bay on land.
reviews.content: we really enjoyed this tour. We had just visited Halong bay and felt this was very similar but at a much cheaper price (and smaller boat of course). Its well organised. parking is 15000 and tickets are 200000 each. Choose which route you want to do and off you go. Rowers should not hassle you for a tip. scenery is stunning and it was fun going through the various caves. Its obviously a tourist attraction so can get busy but we arrived at 10am exactly and there weren't many others on the water (this was during tet so maybe that had an impact). if youre unable to see Halong bay then visit this site, or if you just want to view a beautiful part of vietnam then again visit this place. Hopefully you will not be disappointed and enjoy it as much as we did.

reviews.author: youbloodytourist
reviews.title: Incredible experience!
reviews.content: Had a great experience in Trang An. This is definitely the most 'commercial' of the boat activities (the others being Van Long and Tam Coc) - but it's also the most interesting. Temples to stop off during the trip, 9 caves to go through (some over 300 metres long), it's a great way to spend 3 hours.

reviews.author: Zeni S
reviews.title: Ninh Binh is absolutely, one of the best places to visit in the world. We visited it in February 2018.
reviews.content: Gorgeous trip and one of my most memorable trips.  It is a wonderful place to be de-stress and let the world go by.

reviews.author: Michaelbel
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Fantastic experience. Very touristy but very good. You get rowed around a fantastic place by a middle aged woman

reviews.author: Raena Reddy
reviews.title: TranAn grottes fabulous afternoon
reviews.content: So after reading all the scary reviews of boat people and hawkers asking for money, being unhappy and threatening the cusyomer....after much trepidition ...we decided to do TrangAn. I must say that the govt or park officials have moved in and rectified the whole scene.  We were 6 of us. They gave us 2 boats of 3pax each. I wish it were two pax so that the lady rower didn't have to work so hard. Anyway there was no haggling or asking for a tip. In fact I was given a feedback form on the boat asking me to rate the trip, to state whether I was asked for a tip and whether the lady had shortened the trip in any way. Well the answer was no on all counts.ni fact we had a fabulous time racing the other boat. Each boat or sampan comes with extra oars - so you can row too....and I think that was half the fun!! The route 1 is the way to go. We toured all 9 caves. And it was amazing. I am told there is not much difference in the tamcoc caves and these and that intact TrangAn has the best caves. It was a tough call for the lack of time to choose between Halong and Ninh Binh...and I am so happy I chose ninh Binh. The place was empty. There were just two other boats out. It was so quiet. There were no luxury liners sitting the place with 100s of tourists. The main part of the ride was the interlacing of the treks and pagodas that made this trip culturally so far superior that I didn't regret not going to HaLong. In fact some of the islands have UNESCO ratings and are SIMPLY AWESOME!!! I wish we could have spent more time there. Being Tet we had the entire place to ourselves!! However the downside of Tet was that the car companies charged me more....bit WORTH IT!!! Imagine having the place all to yourself!!!?

reviews.author: BethyB
reviews.title: Amazing sceneey
reviews.content: Very cool few hours boating around. Caves can be a bit claustrophobic - one of them was 1km long & low ceilings

reviews.author: borhancikgu
reviews.title: A hidden gem in Haoi
reviews.content: I visited Trang An Grottoes on a day when Hanoi was blanketed in thick pollution. Surprisingly the air here was clean and not a sign of pollution. This is where the movie 'Kong' was shot but it has more than the location of the shooting. Take a boat ride and it is amazing. Only experiencing the ride will tell you the beauty of this place. You pass caves, limestone cliffs scattered all over and the beauty is just feast to the eyes. There are 3 routes available for the boat trip and depends on your taste. I took the 2nd route which took me to the location of the shooting og Kong. There is nothing much here called skull island but it is worth seeing the locals here. Don't miss this gem if you are to visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: Judie O
reviews.title: Gentle paddle
reviews.content: Charming afternoon amidst beautiful scenery. Quiet time of year so not that many other boats. My husband was very overexcited by film set of Kong Skull Island. Cheery lady rower who asked for a tip without actually asking!

reviews.author: Marie C
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: What an amazing place. So calm and beautiful we did route 2 and we were happy with our choice. Going through the caves is brilliant and the boat driver made us laugh with "head down! Head down!" You really do have to duck down!! We had the boat to ourself as we were the only people doing that route at the time but other people were 4 to a boat. I was nervous getting on and off the boat but she made it easier by 'parking up' sideways and onto the steps and holding my hand to get out. She didn't ask for a tip but we gave her 20k at th end. One of the highlights of our month in vietnam.

reviews.author: Dave B
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: The day before we did the boat tour in Tam Coc, DON'T do that one, what a scam! Trang An tour was just amazing, beautiful scenery, very quiet, beautiful stops (temples) and through the caves. We did tour 2 and which lasted 2,5-3 hours. Just wonderful!

reviews.author: winsern
reviews.title: Beautiful day
reviews.content: Lovely weather (20c) for day tour out of the city. About 2 hours away from Hanoi, Trang An (長安) is a nice and peaceful getaway from the hustle and bustle of Hanoi. Wasn't a fan of Kong Island movie set though

reviews.author: Oren A
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.content: The boat tour was nice but it’s very touristy. Do not expect to be there alone. It was not very crowded when we were there as it was very cold and cloudy, but we had a group of yelling Chinese around us at all times, which was quite annoying.We opted for tour nr 3. The caves were nice, the temples were okay and the last part, which is where they shot the King Kong movie is a waste of time.The area is very beautiful in terms of nature and the boat ride is pleasant. Our boatman was friendly and smiled all the time.We did have a bad experience at the motorbike parking area though. They charge an outrageous 15.000 dong for motorbike parking, but okay, this is Vietnam. When we came back to the motorbike after the tour I realized I didn’t have the key. I must have left it in the ignition I thought. I asked the guy there if he had found the key in my ignition and started looking through a bunch of lost/forgotten keys in his desk’s drawer. We found the key (it’s obvious he’d taken it) and then he demanded we pay him 10 USD to get the key back. Only after I threatened to call the police he gave me the key. It’s quite unbelievable the scams they come up with in this country and unfortunately too many people fall for them and pay, which is why they keep on doing it. So what were the 15.000 dong for if not for him to take care of the bike?!

reviews.author: Richlen
reviews.title: Go and you won’t be dissapointed
reviews.content: Came here as a part of my Ninh Binh tour. Was unsure to choose Thrang An over Tam Coc at the beginning. Lucky I made the right choice. This place is out of this world, so beautiful, the water is kept very clean, very serene. We got route 2 from the tour, but I actuality prefer route 1 as is longer route and you will be passing more caves. We did tip the boat lady even though she didnt ask for a tip. Rowing 4 ppl in that boat for 2.5 hrs is a hard job, I think she deserves the tip. The Kong movie set is a bit weird to me, but the shrines are beautiful and worth a look. But the setting is breathtaking. I went there in mid january during low season, the sky was cloudy so lucky for me it wasn’t a hot day and not many tourists!! Be prepared to pay 2000vnd to use the toilet.

reviews.author: sjamesd19
reviews.title: Must do experience
reviews.content: Definitely earns its label of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You might have to do some of the paddling but it is well worth it haha. I was a little spoiled on my trip to Vietnam. Having seen so much natural beauty before I visited Trang An, but this still felt magical.

reviews.author: CamTVoyage78
reviews.title: Mountains of the Vietnam
reviews.content: Mother nature's is incredible, mountains of the Southeast. Boat traveling through the mountains is like being in the new King Kong movie which is where this place is filmed. The view is amazing especially going through the 1000 m cave inside the mountains. It's worth the entrance fee.

reviews.author: Song_Chuang
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Take a boat trip to go along the river & enjoy amazing scenery of limestone karts...that's an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Rohan12d
reviews.title: Trang An - Boat ride
reviews.content: A must visit place if you plan to visit Ninh Binh. The location is great, surrounded with some spectacular views. It has most of the amenities. (Be prepared to spend 2000VND for using the toilets) There are shops and a restaurant if you are hungry. Be prepared to spend around 2hrs for the boat ride. They take you to different spots where you can hop off and explore the place. There are 3 routes to chose from. We went with route 2 which seems like the most favoured route.

reviews.author: OB
reviews.title: Beautiful sites, go early in the morning
reviews.content: Beautiful site and interesting boat rides (number 2 is the best!). It is very popular, so go early in the day to avoid the crowd. The restaurant on site is not great (very slow service and so so fare).

reviews.author: pomodorini
reviews.title: Amazing amazingg
reviews.content: The cold didn't stop us from getting this boat ride which was nothing short of amazing. We went in the morning where there were tourists but it wasn't too crowded. We chose route 2 which was a mix of temples and caves. The whole experience was magical, going through the grottoes was amazing. Our boat man skilfully navigated through the the nooks and crannies. It was peaceful, tranquil and the sights were just amazing. would highly recommend even if there are lotsa tourists, definitely an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: mark
reviews.title: Best sight in Trang An
reviews.content: Probably the best and most impressive attraction/sight in Trang An I’ve seen. Beautiful scenery and tour albeit the horde of tourists. Did seem like a tourist trap but wasn’t bad. We booked a driver from our hotel in tam coc to visit the grottoes. Did not need any ticket reservation. Whole process and your packages was easy to follow and experience.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Magical boat tour!
reviews.content: A wonderful experience - thoroughly enjoyable! You will not forget this trip!  Take lots of photos! ************+*********+*+++++++

reviews.author: roger1250
reviews.title: Amazing place.
reviews.content: Don't miss this.  Its a highlight of any trip to this region.  One tip, as a couple, go in the mid afternoon as there are less people and a higher chance of  not having to share a boat.  We did Line 1 which is the longer tour and is recommended as fewer take this one and you are more likely to have this terrific tour to yourself.

reviews.author: postscript65
reviews.title: Marvellous scenery and peace
reviews.content: Arrive early to avoid the masses - there are 2000 possible craft. We toured route 2 which takes about two hours with a few stops. Kong Skull Island is a favourite because of King Kong but we enjoyed the furthest place with temples and walks.Ducking through the smaller grottoes is fun but can be low - so watch your head!Our oarsman was very skilled and we helped him paddle.We were a little late for the birds but they are around in the dense undergrowth with small animals which have escaped the hunters.Very well kept; excellent facilities - just skip past the old crones at the toilets!

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Route 3 boat tour
reviews.content: Spectacular visit! In our opinion this spot beats Ha Long bay. Gorgeous views and fun trips through caves. We were able to get on and off the boats to explore pagodas and temples. Well worth the trip to Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Holiday-lah
reviews.title: I would rate this 6 stars
reviews.content: This is the must see in Tam Coc, Ninh Binh. The view and scenery is so spectacular that I couldn’t imagine such a thing actually exist on earth... it is beyond ordinary!I would not spoil your trip here by revealing everything. Just go! You have 3 routes to choose from...we went on route 2. Totally worth the money!

reviews.author: matamatablondie
reviews.title: Spectacular and peaceful
reviews.content: Amazing scenery, temples and culture. Many stops to appreciate the culture and tranquility of Vietnam. Cabes were amazing. Fantastic guides.

reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.title: Worth the time spent
reviews.content: Worth every minutes spent on the water! Were recommended to take tour#2 by a local (3 tours available).3-hour row-boat ride as we chose to spent more time at multiple temples and/or historical sites-great history lessons for the 2 teen boys:)).Weather was perfect- clear and bright sky, slightly cool as we started out early in the day. Recommending you bring hat, sunblock or umbrella if starting out later in the day or hotter months.In awe of the pristine and beautiful Mother Nature, riding thru the grottos/caves. Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Jim_atl
reviews.title: Beautiful and Unique
reviews.content: I took this boat trip as part of a day trip from Hanoi.  Four of us sat in a small boat and were paddled around by a woman for two hours.  The weather was excellent and the scenery was impressive.  We went into caves and went through limestone rocks.  More than halfway home we stopped on an island where a recent King Kong movie was filmed.  The only downside to this tour was sitting in a small boat for two hours.  But it was worth it.

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.title: Beautiful scenic landscape and caves
reviews.content: Did route 3. Very skilful and pleasant lady rower.   Lake is beautiful and clean. Spot a idiot smoking  while been rowed thru the lake. Beautiful caves. Beware of Low cave ceiling. Was totally blown away this tour. 200k/pax, 4pax/boat, 3 routes to choose from. Very organise and clean place. Must do while in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Lulu_Dee3
reviews.title: Fantastic! I'm claustrophobic and I didn't freak out
reviews.content: I was a little hesitant about doing this boat trip as I knew that with any of the three options we would have to go through caves (the grottoes) and I am not the biggest fan of small, dark places particularly when they're full of water.However, I'm so, so, so glad that we did this as it was so beautiful and not scary at all.We choose route number 2, which included 4 grottoes, 3 pagodas & the King Kong movie set. The whole journey with our guide was fantastic and he was very kind and lovely. The grottoes are all well lit so no problem with the freakouts as I've mentioned, and you're only in them for around 2 minutes at a time. In fact by the end of it I wished we had done the longer trip (route 1) that goes through 9 of the grottoes.I would definitely recommend this if you want a few hours of relaxation and to feel as though you are really out in the wilderness. Just be aware that by 11am it is certainly warming up (we started at about 8:30am) so you will need hats/ sunscreen etc.Also be aware that they only let you get on the boat once there are four passengers. As it was just the two of us we had to wait for around 20 minutes for another couple to show up who wanted to do the same route as us.This is not the fault of the boat drivers, but the company who is running the whole thing.

reviews.author: Iutas
reviews.title: Much much better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Didn't know whether to do Tam Coc or Trang An having done Tam Coc a few years ago...there is simply not even a contest...Trang An is 100 times better. Well organised (and a bit pricey), no scams possible and the tour takes 3 hours of amazing boat ride through the limestone hills and caves...loooong and amazing caves.

reviews.author: Daan de Geus
reviews.title: Nice trip
reviews.content: We've had a nice trip!Our travel agency recommended us visit Trang An caves over Tam Coc since it would be less touristy. While you're definitely not going to be alone, it is more than doable (December).The tour itself was nice. You can pick 3 routes. A local guide (not ours, but we overheard him) recommended route 2. This was a good choice. It had the right balance between caves, panoramic views, temples and ended with Kong Island (don't expect too much from Kong).The rowing lady was kind and didn't ask for a tip. We tipped her however, since 3 hours of rowing without complaining earns one a tip.

reviews.author: kbb202
reviews.title: Peace in the countryside
reviews.content: The limestone karsts and pass-through caves to hidden valleys and temples are tonic for the eyes, ears, and soul.  Book a cycling + boat tour with a company like Hanoi Urban Adventures to make a day of it, or stay at one of the local homestays along the water to soak in the ambiance.

reviews.author: Carina
reviews.title: UNESCO listed series of caves or grottoes
reviews.content: We boarded a small row boat and explored Trang An Unesco listed series of caves. The boat was rowed by a man and we also helped him to row the boat with the oars. There were four of us in one row boat. We have to be careful with our heads when the small row boat went through the narrow passage way through the caves. We passed by scenery as shown in the photos for a two hours expedition.

reviews.author: BocosTravels
reviews.title: Smart move
reviews.content: Come here early in the morning when it's not crowded. Each boat sits 4 people. If it's only the two of you, opt to purchase four tickets (200k each, 800k total) and voila you have the entire boat to yourself. Do you really want to share a 3 hour ride with another couple and have them block your view? 400k extra is basically $15, so why not pay up for a private boat? The whole time we were there we only saw one other boat where a couple bought the whole thing up.We chose route 1 because we don't care much for the Kong movie island set. We went through plenty of caves and stopped at three temples. The second stops allows you to climb up a hill, then you can climb down the other side and listen to a monk chanting. I could've stayed there all day, but the boat lady said,"20 minutes" so I didn't want to keep her waiting. If you're up for it, help out your rower by doing some of the rowing as well, it's kinda fun and a good workout. And although they don't ask for tips, a 100k tip will go a long way, and it's really like $4, so why not?

reviews.author: Anj Ric
reviews.title: Mesmerising
reviews.content: Very pretty. We took a 9 caves boat tour which went through 3 Temples as well. Amazing experience. You can spend as much time as you like climbing to the Temples. There are also some paths which you can follow but they do not take you anywhere. The whole tour is three hours and you have a local rowing for you.

reviews.author: Mark W
reviews.title: Beautiful Way to Spend a Day
reviews.content: We were 2 couples travelling in the Tam Coc area.  We cycled the few kilometers from our homestay to the Grottoes which was a pleasant trip on its own winding down some village streets.  We arrived at the area for boating, bought our tickets and were quickly on our way.  Our bikes were parked in a secure area for a minimal fee (I forget how much).  Our paddler (a tiny little lady) had to deal with 4 full size north americans and did so with a smile.  There were paddles for us to help but she did pretty well all the work. We took the 3 cave 3 temple option - in hindsight we would have taken the 12 cave option (others say 3 is enough - we would have enjoyed more).  The cost was the same regardless of the option.The views / caves / temples were beautiful ... very worthwhile.There were NO annoying vendors during the boat trip.  There is a market area across the road by the parking area - but we weren't harassed at all.  We did buy some water and snacks.We thorough recommend this tour.

reviews.author: zerella
reviews.title: One of the best sceneries in Vietnam
reviews.content: I thought it was just a crowded tourist attraction, instead I had one of the most exciting experiences in Vietnam. At the same price you can choose three different paths and the more grottoes the best. The caves are so wide and branched that you can litterally sail across mountains, and at the same time they are so narrow you have to constantly mind your head. Your boat man knows where to go, so don't be afraid and enjoy this amazing experience (if the water level allows it). You will also pass across rice fields, solitary temples and "Kong: Skull island" movie set! Don't forget to help your boat man paddle and to tip him/her if you feel like it. Our boat "woman" (boat n° 705) made the trip even more charming.

reviews.author: jamieckh
reviews.title: Not for people who gets bored easily; if you are one, explore nearby by bicycle or motorbike instead
reviews.content: The four of us on boat did not find the views super amazing like what others had said. The scenery looked pretty similar most of the time. We took route 1 which consisted of 9 caves and immediately regret it after going through the first cave. The caves are generally quite repetitive, good enough to just enter 1 or 2 of it. Maybe consider the other routes instead.As we didn't research properly, we thought that the boat ride would take only 1.5hr (just enough time for us to get back to city before the sky gets darker), thus in order to shorten our ride, we told the boat paddler to bypass places which requires us to get off the boat (e.g. temples). This was partially because my companions weren't a fan of temples and pagodas anyways. I think this decision might have caused our ride to be quite boring.Lastly, as we had cycled from Hoa Lu to Bai Dinh and back to Trang An, we felt that the views we had seen while cycling near Trang An/ Hoa Lu was similar or even more amazing than the one we saw on the boat. Thus I would recommend people to skip the boat ride and explore Trang An area by bicycle/motorbike instead. The views are more varied on land. You can stop whenever you like to take pictures and it's also less expensive.

reviews.author: Jo_9928
reviews.title: Great scenery and experience on the bamboo boat ride!
reviews.content: The scenery at Trang An is really nice - totally agree that it's also known as "Halong Bay on land". The bamboo boat lady expertly maneuvers her way through the grottoes and you get to experience ducking your heads to avoid low hanging stalactites or roof of the grottoes.

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: Great way to spend a day
reviews.content: When I first pulled into the parking lot, I thought I was not going to enjoy this place. Hundreds of people on hundreds of boats. But honestly the place is so big that we all just spread out and it hardly seemed crowded at all. Entry tickets are 200k Dong per person. There are three routes to choose from, each of which takes about three hours to complete. The difference seemed to me to be the amount of time actually spent on the boat, as opposed to poking around on land. I chose route 1, which covered the most caves (nine). The landscape was amazing, stunning topography. We were dropped off at several scenic temples, each of which had toilets (take small bills, the fee is 2k) and snack sellers. The rower of our boat was very kind to us and at the end did not ask for tips or push us in any way. We did give her some extra money however, for rowing a boat full of hefty westerners around for 3 hours. When I retrieved my motorbike, the parking attendant asked for 40k, then corrected himself to ask for 50k, and so I handed him 20k which he happily accepted. Which means the real price was probably 10k, but not worth haggling over. Great way to spend a day!

reviews.author: Cami.grd
reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.content: If you do not like places with many tourists: avoid. If you want to see something amazingly beautiful, go! We had a great driver and met really nice and smiling people. We traveled under a few caves which was nice and unique. I would highly recommend Trang an over Tam Coc which was horrible

reviews.author: Shareen A
reviews.title: Pretty and a diff experience
reviews.content: We visited the caves on my friends bday, not many people or overwhelming crowds we did'nt face qny long ques or crowded caves. We took route three which was the longest route.. for anyone else who hates climbing stairs the second stop had a temple which takes a tiring amount of stairs of you are not generally an active person .. and you have to come back the same way you climbed up. You have to climb all the way up for a few pics and then back down in the opposite direction for the temple and then all the way back to get out. Although a lot of people said it was worth the view, I didnt. The easily accessible temple at the 3rd stop was much prettier. The caves are amazing and the sparkly Crystal's are the highlight of the trip. The front two seats are the best so you should experience it. We switched out front seats with the people behind us for the return journey , everybody should do this. You dont have to paddle but our lady was so old we felt a little guilty just sitting there. We did tip but they do not ask you. We loved the experience.

reviews.author: Rumno
reviews.title: Experience cave from inside
reviews.content: A nice row boat took us from under the rocks through the three caves, one of them fairly large and dark.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: A bit disappointed
reviews.content: While the views themselves are nice and worth seeing, the experience as a whole was fairly disappointing. It was closer to 2 hours than the 3 advertised. Once you're on the boat, expect to be quickly guilted into doing a sizable percentage of the rowing. Back on land, local tourists are free to use the toilets while foreigners are expected to pay for the privilege.As one of Ninh Binhs most well in known sights, I hoped for a more positive experience.

reviews.author: Shell N
reviews.title: Stunning!!!
reviews.content: This place is soooooo amazing. you will spend time around 3 hours. I took route 3 we went around 5 cave and 3 temples. Staff who rowing boat very friendly and she never ask your tips but I was willing to tips.If you go one person, you have to wait until 3-4 people in the boat.Hope you guy enjoy!

reviews.author: Wandering_Ozzie
reviews.title: Enjoyable couple of hours through beautiful scenery
reviews.content: I had a great experience on here although the rower does ask you to help row and I'm a weakling hahaha.... oh well I did my best.There was no pressure to tip and no scams to try to sell you anything.  The trip through the rivers and caves was absolutely beautiful.

reviews.author: chicho f
reviews.title: Great experience, so beautiful!!!
reviews.content: I heard that this option of boat tour was better then the Tan Coc one now the the rice fields are not so pretty, but I think it´s better anytime of the year!!

reviews.author: uncg_nurse
reviews.title: Ok...take the short trip
reviews.content: It is pretty crowded on the water, and some obnoxious folks are out there.  The scenery is pretty, but skip Skull Island.  Small selection of snacks at one of the tour stops.  The caves were decent, but not impressive.  Don't forget 2,000 Dong, if you want to use the restrooms.

reviews.author: Macey G
reviews.title: Trang An Route 1
reviews.content: We chose route one because route 2 & 3 are more popular due to the passing by of the set of King Kong skull island. We very much enjoyed the less traveled route with 8 caves and 3 temple stops.

reviews.author: Johanne A
reviews.title: Do not miss!
reviews.content: Wow! Absolutely wonderful! Do not miss this boat excursion if you are in Tam Coc. The scenery is beautiful and really looks like Ha Long Bay. The ride is quiet and smooth along the river and you pass thru a few caves. Bring a hat and water because it is really hot in the sun. The lady rowers are nice and do not try to sell you stuff. Give them a tip, they really work hard and deserve it.

reviews.author: EddieDean99
reviews.title: Worth the price of admission.
reviews.content: Though the experience is very commercialized, it’s definitely still worth doing if you’re in Ninh Binh. The scenery is amazing and going through the caves is unlike anything else I’ve ever done. We opted for route #3 and the 2 hours it took seemed like the perfect length. I’ve also heard good things about route 1, but it is longer. The boat loading experience is a little hectic, but not as bad as I thought it might be. We purchased our tickets at the ticket booth and then told the lady at the boat queue which route we wanted to take. We waited a few minutes to be matched with another pair. We lucked out and got paired with a Frenchman and a Vietnamese woman that spoke English. She was able to act as an interpreter for the boat operator. Without her, it might have been confusing at times knowing where to go on the temple stops and how long we had. Also, who you get paired with will definitely affect your experience. You’re stuck getting on and off a small boat with strangers for 2+ hours. Based on the types of tourists that frequent this attraction, I’m sure you can infer the risks. Keep your fingers crossed you get paired up with someone good. We also got lucky getting the front seats on the boat. It was great. The tour itself was periods of paddling through amazing scenery and caves and then stopping off to walk through pagodas. Getting off the boat and walking around was the least interesting part for us, but it didn’t necessarily detract from the experience. Though trying to take in a beautiful pagoda with a kiosk selling drinks and snacks in the way wasn’t great. The last stop on the tour was the “set from King Kong” and it was definitely the worst part. It’s so manufactured and fake that it takes away from the natural beauty of the place. Overall, the experience was unique and enjoyable. The boat operator lady was patient and never asked for a tip. We did give her 50k because she provided good service and earned it. Note on parking: I read that it was going to be a chaotic scammy experience like some of the other places in the area, but it seems like they’ve dealt with it. There is a designated parking area across from the entrance. A man at a desk takes down your plate number and gives you a ticket stub. You pay him 15k when you get back to the parking lot and go on your merry way without any issues.

reviews.author: Johan_SY
reviews.title: So so so so worth it!!!
reviews.content: Just concluded a 2.5h ride. Stunning scenery, absolutely pristine. HIGHLY recommended. We woke at 6am to make it here by 715am. Worth waking up early to beat the crowds and enjoy a quiet journey. Boat lady didn’t hassle us for any tips. But we gave anyway (on the way back to the docking station; would be awkward for her if tipping was so visible) She was so skilled and very kind.

reviews.author: Kacy W
reviews.title: Get There Early
reviews.content: We had a great boat trip with our guide. She didn’t speak much English, and we speak no Vietnamese, but she was able to confirm that we were allowed to help paddle if we wanted, and we even overtook another boat for fun, on her command, which was something like “hello, more.” There were three routes to choose from, you pick the route after you pay, right before you get in the boat. We chose the longest route, it took about 2.5 hours with us paddling about half the time, and the guide paddling the whole time. Some of the caves on this route required ducking down a lot, in order to protect one’s head from hitting the rocks. It was really fun, but consider one of the routes with fewer cave passages if you don’t want to duck down. Come early if you don’t want the river to be crowded. The downside of arriving early is that if your party is too small for its own boat, you may have to sit and wait for another party of the right size to fill up your boat. My husband and I waited about 15 minutes before they decided we could just go without filling the rest of the boat. It was a pretty good deal!

reviews.author: aniceglassofred
reviews.title: Tranquil and Stunning
reviews.content: So peaceful spending 90 minutes in a row boat sailing through the most stunning scenery.  Couldn't recommend this enough.  Make sure you give you rower a few USD tip, as they do deserve it :-)

reviews.author: greg dennis
reviews.title: Paradise regained
reviews.content: My friend Hung, took me to Trang An ecopark as a treat day out and what a day. This is a little known treasure!  Acres of river country, karst peaks, caves and culture. Ladies row you for 3 hours around the park, through caves, past temples and pagodas. Very strong women !! Highlight a lady singing in a little temple in middle of the river as we sail past. The recreated set from "Kong" (filmed in area)in midst of park was a little sad. If you drop even a matchstick staff can report you to authorities in hope of keeping it pristine. 90kms south of Hanoi, about a 2hr drive.My best day in 2 wk holiday this visit to Vietnam. Hint : go in the morning before crowds.

reviews.author: jagga
reviews.title: Simply Superb
reviews.content: The sampan ride of nearly one and half hours was amazing. The boatperson was rowing with his feet. The scene of the water and mountains was breathtaking. Also, we went through three grottos. I would say it was one of the best experiences of my life.

reviews.author: Jennifer F
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.content: Definitely worth it! 200.000 VDN pp, which was well worth it. You are in boats of 4. You are able to choose from 3 different routes (check the signs at the beginning to decide before you get in queue). We did Route 1 because it had the most caves. The scenery was incredible. The tour is about 3 hours. There are a bunch of stops along the way where you can use the bathroom and grab a snack/drink. It is truly one of the most beautiful places I have ever been to. Our guide was super kind and never asked for a tip or tried to sell us extra goods. She worked, however, very hard. I suggest you give a tip to your rower, but prior to getting to the dock since they are not allowed to ask for tips. This is a must see.

reviews.author: Dr_Rohan
reviews.title: The best cave boat tour in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: There are several cave exploring boat trips in Ninh Binh. Tràng An may be the best of all. The route 1 goes through 9 caves, on the way visits several temples and takes 3 hours. It’s 200,000 per person. There are 3 routes. Routes 2 and 3 are much shorter and covers only few caves. It’s worth getting the full route. During the tour you can see amazing ecological formations, awesome sceneries, and spectacular cave formations under huge mountains. It’s impressive the way the ladies ride the boat inside the caves through the most spacious areas.

reviews.author: kaiserschmarrn2015
reviews.title: Unforgettable...
reviews.content: ... being rowed through this maze of water, tunnel grottoes, lotus, temples. Mostly absolute silence apart from the regular "splash- splash' of the oars. (And maybe the piercing wail of a child in a boat nearby or cheering fellow tourists...)

reviews.author: Heng How N
reviews.title: Morning boat rowing
reviews.content: The place is about 2 hours from the hotel or Hanoi and in Ninh Binh province. Once reach there, buy your ticket at the counter and proceed to queue for the assigned boat. Depending on the crowd & operator (rower), they will asign 2, 3 or 4 to a boat. Select the route you want and enjoy your sightseeing.The operator will stop at various islands for your to visit the temples and the famous King Kong island to take pictures.The whole route will go through a few cave-tunnels, and many hills. One of the pavillion having musician playing local instruments.Trang An is well preserved place in term of environment, green, sustainability and water cleaniness.Overall it is a enjoying trip with scenic view and friendly operaor.

reviews.author: Williams
reviews.title: Great trips to the cave
reviews.content: Trang An is very beautiful, so the boat ride relaxing and also fairly priced. I was recognized Trang An is a lot safer to Tam Coc in terms of serenity & a hassle free experience. The caves are very good but don't suggest it to those who are afflicted by claustrophobia. There are plenty of boats it is inevitable they crash into the cave walls, as well everybody rolls on the limestone. This could just have a negative influence on the caves. Happy to see something as very

reviews.author: Keith C
reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.content: We did package tour from Hanoi to Mai Chau & Ninh Binh with Vietnam Tonkin travel & had amazing experience. After very good hiking & homestay in Mai Chau, we had a very good boat trip in Trang An as well. Scenery was very gorgeous & beautiful, tunnel was amazing!

reviews.author: Ben G
reviews.title: Peaceful and amazing
reviews.content: What a beautiful way to spend a few hours, we were rowed around the amazing landscape and through caves and we just had to sit back and take it all in.  It truely is a stunning natural environment and well worth visiting when you can.

reviews.author: iamkayoh
reviews.title: Great boat ride. Highlight of Tam Coc / Ninh Binh visit
reviews.content: The boat ride was amazing. Little boat in the magnificent river/ caves. Quite an experience taking the boat ride thru the caves, some caves are really narrow and tight. The lady who paddled the boat is very friendly and skilful. Didn’t asked for tips although I paid 50k tips for the hard work. Recommended to choose Route 1 which covers 9 caves and 3 Temples. Be prepared to climb the steps if you are visiting the Temples at the top. Some are pretty small. Toilets available at every stops. The 3 hour journey includes the boat ride, visiting the Temples, etc. A must go! 👍🏼

reviews.author: Trygve H
reviews.title: Boat ride with temples, caves and Skull Island filmset
reviews.content: We did tour no3 which includes caves, temples and the filmset. Besides uncomfortable boats after 2-3 hours it was a nice trip. Luckily we had some stops at the temples.

reviews.author: Dktari
reviews.title: Fun way to spend 3 hours
reviews.content: Taxi from hotel easy and inexpensive, tickets easy to obtain (just follow the crowd), and boat ride surprisingly comfortable. Scenery was spectacular, especially entering and leaving caves.

reviews.author: Cliff Barnett
reviews.title: Great Day on Route 3
reviews.content: There are 3 routes to choose from which are shown on a map at the entry, tickets cost 200k each. We chose route 3 as it had the longest cave section. The boats seat 4 adults, wife and I were put with a solo traveler who also wanted route 3. You are paddled around for 1.5 to 2.5 hours depending on the route and how long you spend walking around the temples on the way. Route 3 had 3 temples and 3 caves including one that was 1k long which is only possible at low tide as the roof is very low in parts. Route 3 also stops at the spot where parts of Kong Skull Island was filmed, the "local villiage" from the movie is still there and you can get photos with ladies that are dressed in costume, not sure if you have to pay as we passed on this. The scenery is beautiful and unlike Tam Coc there are no rice fields so it's wonderful all year round. No pushy vendors or demanding rowers, take change to buy drinks and go to the toilet (2k per visit!).

reviews.author: nyusual
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: The boat trip in the grottos you must do. it was a sunny day when we started but started following immediately after the trip was over. Don't forget to tip the boat guide.Be prepared to sit on the floor of the row-boat as you go under the caves. The caves are well lit and you cam see daylight at the far end. Avoid if you are claustrophobic and can't crouch on the floor of the boat.Now the sights are breathtaking and beautiful. The mountains and lush green landscape should make you forget about the journey through the caves. All the temples are religious in nature, so please be mindful. Overall, an awesome experience in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Narelle A
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.content: To go through these caves in their pristine condition without lighting was magical! We were on a one day bike tour with Ninh Binh tours and part of the tour was a ride in a small boat with oars which was quiet and thankfully the waterways are not crowded. So green, clear water and lush!

reviews.author: Timo
reviews.title: Nice, but crowded
reviews.content: We did a boat tour in Trang An and the landscape was really nice. 3 to 4 persons per boat was a good group size, but there are so many boats that there can be no privacy. Hard to take a picture without an orange vest on it.200k VND is a bit too much in my opinion, but you should still visit this site.

reviews.author: UNNIMAYA
reviews.title: Premier attraction of Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Trang An Grottoes attract a large number of tourists , but thankfully they are geared to handle the crowds. The boat handlers - both men and women- are very skillful to guide the boat through the caves- however most of them do not speak English. We had a Vietnamese young man sharing our boat and hence could get some more information than one would usually get. The boat handlers expect to be tipped and will ask the tips at the end of your trip- tipping is voluntary. Expect to tip around 3 $ .There are stops during the 2-3 hour boat trip including an island where King Kong was shot . Totally touristy. However it is not the stops or the temples that makes this place special . It is nature and natural beauty and the calm peaceful atmosphere as you glide through the caves despite the large number of boats and the crowds. To enjoy this premier attraction of Ninh Binh it would be preferable to do the boat trip in the early morning to avoid hot sun.

reviews.author: BellaBalini
reviews.title: Don't miss this
reviews.content: It really is as  spectacular as everyone says. It's well organized and easy.  We rode bicycles from Tam Coc which was easy and not as long as expected. We did the two hour trip rather than three and think that was a good choice. It included a stop at a temple, several cave passages and a goofy visit to the movie set that was left behind after the Kong movie.  Something to be aware of st that stop  is that you will be dropped off on one side of this island and picked up by your boat on the other side. This is not necessarily clear and  the couple we shared our boat with got turned around and lost for a while.

reviews.author: AliceTravel1995
reviews.title: Most beautiful and peaceful day out
reviews.content: Me and my husband went on this boat tour today and it was incredible. Such beautiful views and so peaceful and quiet. We also got a chance to row with the guide which was a fun experience. We would definitely recommend and certainly worth the money!

reviews.author: don p
reviews.title: Should preserve nature, beautifully
reviews.content: The Trang An Grottoes are an intelligent option in case you like caves - I went through a lot of them, nonetheless, the scenery is not as crowded as Tam Coc. The scenery was gorgeous: blue water, marvelous grottoes, beautiful mountains,.. The entire place was very peaceful, so the splendor was breathtaking. The sandstone hills along how are just astounding. Bad mind is I have seen several visitors have thrown the rubbish of theirs into the water. So disrespected.

reviews.author: Hoaido
reviews.title: Nature
reviews.content: I love the peace and nature here. It get me out the noise in the city. I feel relaxed in the boat. The sence is very wonderful and has nothing human impact.

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.title: Great scenery poorly ran
reviews.content: Scenery here is incredible. Although the Vietnamese lady did not speak a word of English (which is fine, we are in her country).She persisted to get angry that we didn’t understand and kept shouting in Vietnamese, she then filled out the feedback sheet and did not allow me to give any feedback only write my name and where I was from.She was very loud and angry and almost ruined this for us.

reviews.author: Fangqi_A
reviews.title: Went on Route One
reviews.content: Picked Route One for the 9 Caves and 3 temples. The boat ride was pleasant even without the leg paddling (which is not allowed) - it was quite an experience how the boat woman was able to manoeuvre the boat skilfully through the caves. The lotus and water birds along the way provided much visual delights. Would be keen to explore other routes if we visit Trang An Grottos again.

reviews.author: Enne
reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.content: This is exactly what I imagined what Vietnam looks like. So beautiful and peaceful. Go on weekdays to avoid local travelers.

reviews.author: Erica G
reviews.title: Worth to go!
reviews.content: This is the less commercialised boat ride compare to other places in Vietnam. The river is super clean which really amazed me (if compare to other tourist spots) and the view is superb. We have chosen Route 1 (non KING KONG Film filming route) so we can experience the pure nature view. The boat ride is about 2.5 hours and I jz love it!

reviews.author: Huy Hoàng V
reviews.title: Proud of the natural beauty of VietNam-"TRANG AN"
reviews.content: The majestic natural beauty, unspoile but no less effort to attract tourism. Try once to this place you'll feel very private nature and not to be mixed. There are mountains, there is water, there is the cave, there are trees, boats, ... just missing people admire and feel

reviews.author: allxb2017
reviews.title: Really pretty
reviews.content: Nice activities I had some fun going through the caves. There is a nice scenery. You have the chose to take 2 or 3 hours tours, I would chose the 2 hours the 3 can be a little bit long !

reviews.author: magettoromoro
reviews.title: A must visit place
reviews.content: This tour is very nice and the scenary is just gorgeous. Entrance fee is 200k per person. You can choose three routes (1,2 or 3). Preferably do choose 1 if you guys like cave. Do wear sunscreen and bring along shades and cap. Better if u guys come early around 8am cos the weather is just nice around that time.

reviews.author: JSTrip_77
reviews.title: Absolutely stunning experience
reviews.content: Even if you don't want to visit the nearby palaces at Lin Hoa, the boat trip to the Trang An Grottoes (caves) is amazing and worth the trip. This is the Vietnam that you've seen in the movies with towering limestone cliffs, interesting birds and water creatures. Majestic is truly the best way to describe it. We did about a 1.5 hour ride on the river and were taken through a series of amazing cave tunnels (the grottoes) by a small but skilled boatman. This is also the spot where parts of the recent Planet of the Apes movie was filmed. You can see the actual "Skull Island" here on the boat trip. We didn't elect to stop and visit all of the temples along the route because we'd already gone to Lin Hoa and needed to get back to Hanoi but that would have been an option too. OK, yes, there are people trying to make money off of everything you do here - to include using the toilet. A way around that is to use the toilet in the restaurant. I'd already eaten there but no one stopped me from going in to use the toilet. But let's be honest, if it costs 2,000 Vietnamese dong to use the toilet, it's more of an inconvenience than anything else as that equates to approximately USD 0.09... So yes, the number of Vietnamese dong adds up but that doesn't necessarily make this an "expensive" trip.

reviews.author: Shaun_A_M
reviews.title: Highly Reccomended!
reviews.content: The most popular attraction to visit in Ninh Binh are the Trang An Grottoes. The grottoes consists of a handful of caves and rocks towering out from a large network of canals and lakes. The entrance fee to Trang An can be quite steep for a backpacker’s budget. However, after experiencing it, we think it’s worth it. The ticket includes a 2.5 hour boat ride which is rowed by an experienced boatwoman who really knows her way around the area. There are a few route options to choose from varying in length offering you more temples or more cave pass throughs. With crystal clear water while being gently rowed through this magical landscape with a number of stop off points allowing you to take in the beauty of some of temples. Over all highly recommended! Go early in the morning before the lunch time tour buses roll in if you are travelling during peak season!

reviews.author: phuongthaon589
reviews.title: The essence of heaven and earth
reviews.content: Ninh Binh is beautiful in ancient ways and majestic but extremely simple and really conquered me.Ninh Binh is really a place to heal every little bit of light in your soul ... Well, you have to experience the feeling of driving across the arc and swallowed by the majesty of the high mountains.

reviews.author: BlueMaharaja
reviews.title: Nicer than Halong Bay
reviews.content: I was stunned by the scenery and temples here are some of the nicest I have seen so far in Vietnam (though ultimately these here are also not to spectacular). The boat trip is really long and you see quite a few different spots, but don’t forget to bring sun or rain protection depending on the conditions as you won’t have much cover.Your rower will expect a tip at the end of the trip, which is IMO fair enough given the hard work and actually quite skilful manoevering through the caves. And don’t forget that your are doing quite expensive travelling, so you shouldn’t mind a few Dong here. What’s less ok though, that they even try to make a business out of the toilets and deny you access unless you pay them 2000 Dong. That’s unfortunately a general issue around Ninh Binh: everything is made for charge by scammers to extract rents from tourists for basics like toilets and parking. This actually adds up to quite substantial amounts over time...

reviews.author: Craig B
reviews.title: Amazing scenery rude staff
reviews.content: Trang an was breathtaking. The views are unbelievable. The staff however are a whole new ball game. We found them very rude and pushy. One even said they don’t care because we’re just tourists. We did Tam Coc the day before and found the staff incredible. Humble and super helpful. By far the better choice.

reviews.author: leashyjelly
reviews.title: 200,000vnd well spent
reviews.content: Out trip lasted about 2.5-3hours. You share with another couple. Or if you are group of three you may get your own boat. You can pay 800,000vnd for a private boat if you desire privacy. Kindly tip your lovely boat driver when she gives you the performance form at the end- if you are happy with her service :) We did tour 2 which was 3 temples, 3 caves (DO NOT DO IF U ARE CLAUSTSAPHOBIC - Absolutely neck breakingly low ceilings and one quite long cave) and a movie set of King Kong Skull Island indigenous village. All in all there are 4 toilet stops (a temples and movie set) cost 2,000vnd. Lovely peaceful boat ride. Would recommend highly.

reviews.author: ADAMandLYNNE
reviews.title: Have to do it but accept it’s very touristy
reviews.content: The surroundings are amazing, the hidden temples magnificent and the routes passing under low caves are worth experiencing.You will he met however with parking guys shouting at you where to park your scooter, unhappy ladies at the ticket counter and grumpy boat ladies, on top of tons of other tourists.It’s worth seeing, possibly trying to choose a bit more unusual time to visit to avoid the crowds might help.

reviews.author: siewleng82
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape
reviews.content: Very beautiful and natural landscape, scenery. The water is calm and peaceful which nicely reflects the mountains and blue sky. You can experience going through and enjoy the rocky caves. You can bring a rain coat to avoid getting wet.

reviews.author: Arshii A
reviews.title: Such still water, such calmness in the wind. This is a beautiful boat ride.
reviews.content: We had a amazing experience here. After this boat ride, every other experience seems dull. This was my most favorite experience. Loved it totally. I recommend everyone to take this ride and immerse in the beauty of nature. We did the route with 3 caves and 3 temples, it also had one of the longest cave in this route. The oarsmen are so talented and skilled, they know their way around and dodge the insides of the caves smoothly.

reviews.author: Jasmine M
reviews.title: Best Boat Tour Ever!!
reviews.content: Wow!!!!!! I was super excited to go to Trang an grottoes but was nervous because of certain reviews. ignore the negative reviews these are people that are a glass half empty and can't be pleased.This boat tour was truly incredible breathtaking and jaw dropping. I have never done a boat ride and was overwhelmed by the beauties hidden in between the mountain. We choose route 2 and the boat ride lasted 3 hours we were able to get off and stretch our legs at various points which was nice. We stopped of at the Kong set which was incredible was really blown away by the experience and won't forget the day for a long time. The boat lady worked very very hard, we helped a little but she knew I had weak muscles 😂😂. But she was 3 times my age and she made sure we had a great day was always waiting for us smiling and laughing and talking to the other boat ladies and we were able to stay as long as we wanted.Fantastic value for money!! The boat lady did not ask for a tip we were not sold anything! We gave her $5 tip as she deserved this for all her hard work This is a must!! Do not be put off by negative comments

reviews.author: lukevincent71
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape but..
reviews.content: Spent a day in Ninh Binh with my friends. We bought 5 tickets there but the woman in Trang an did not let us go in one boat. We tried to tell her we wanted 3 and 2 but she just said  ' wait and wait.. for almost 2 hours. The another couple came and we started with 3 and 4.  Sad but beautiful landscape., we did enjoy this boat trip but not that woman.

reviews.author: Wendy C
reviews.title: Better than Ha Long Bay
reviews.content: After doing a cruise on Ha Long Bay and Trang An Grottoes, I can say 100% you do not need to do both. Ha Long Bay is a bit overdone and you can tell by the multiple cruise ships everywhere (even in the nearby bays we went to). However, when we went to Trang An Grottoes, it was a much more intimate experience with fewer tourists. We highly recommend the 3 hour boat ride (around US$10!) and you actually get to go into caves while still sitting on the boat! It was an incredible experience.

reviews.author: buiducquan102
reviews.title: nature
reviews.content: amazing. Everything is natural and very beautiful. This is good place to get away from the noisy city.

reviews.author: Lou F
reviews.title: 2 hour tour
reviews.content: This was an enjoyable tour.  You have an option of 3 tours.  The shortest is 2 hours going through 4 caves.  There is a 2 1/2 hour tour with more caves, then the 3 hour tour that goes through 9 caves.We found that once you’ve gone through the 4 caves, the rest would just be repetitive.We did bring along rain ponchos just in case.We enjoyed this tour and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Gratadour D
reviews.title: It's great to enjoy the scenery
reviews.content: We selected the grottoes in Trang An, Ninh Binh as a single part of me during the entire trip to Vietnam (My good friend recommended the area to us). It was truly well worth visiting the place. We had taken a relaxing boat journey through the scenery for two hours. It was truly gorgeous all around. The grottoes had been colorful and warm with electric lights although care with the head of yours as it's fairly small at points. Because of the fantastic driver as well as the guide. we'd incredibly fun time in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: DOTI
reviews.title: Well worth it
reviews.content: ❤️❤️❤️amazing, did route 1, lots of caves and temples, great rower, shame she couldn't speak English, would have been 5* if she could answer our questions.No ques, can imagine it is very busy in high season but was a nice 23 degrees in October and just the right temperature to spend 3 hours in a boat.

reviews.author: Mandeep K
reviews.title: Most beautiful views
reviews.content: We did the shortest of the 3 available routes. Later approx 2 hrs. There were 4 caves on the way. Absolutely stunning views. The weather was beautiful too. There was slight drizzle which only added to the charm. Much better than the Tam Coc boat ride!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: So serene and beautiful place
reviews.content: Such a beautiful, peaceful place. Great to get a boat trip through caves and the kong movie location.

reviews.author: Naung_Naung_Han
reviews.title: Amazing Boat Ride
reviews.content: I was surprised by the beauty of the Nature. Fantastic boat ride into the cave, then you see the beautiful live picture of the Earth, Water, Mountain Cliffs and humble people who make my trip unforgettable. My friends who are in their 70s get pain on legs after 2 to 3 hours of sitting in a small boat with maximum 4 persons. However, we loved a lot and we had good memory of this place.

reviews.author: Laura A
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Such a beautiful, peaceful place. Great to get a boat trip through caves. Lots of steps at times - be aware but would highly recommend

reviews.author: Mancunianabroad90
reviews.title: Cool caves, stunning scenery and some leftover props from Skull Island
reviews.content: After reading mixed reviews about the boat tour owing to people seeming to have issues with the person rowing the boat stopping half way/demanding a tip, we were slightly cautious on arrival. We opted for tour number 2 to take in some of the Skull Island set. The boat trip was 2 and a half hours long and even though the weather was miserable, the boat ride did not disappoint. The caves were pretty cool (watch your heads as the roof can get very low and the stalactites hang quite low in places) and had an eerie feel. We stopped at part of the set to Skull Island and were able to get off the boats and have a look around. The boat driver gave us a feedback sheet to complete towards the end and indicated what we should fill in (she pointed at no for “did your driver ask you for a tip?”) and then once the form was complete, as we finished she did indicate that she wanted a tip (we hear this is a very common practice that the tour operators are clearly doing nothing to stamp out). We did tip 200,000vnd because she had been rowing for nearly 3 hours in the rain and we’re pretty sure that a lot of the 200,000 entry fee doesn’t go to the boat drivers themselves. The ride was worth it for the spectacular scenery and views throughout.

reviews.author: SerendipityGallery
reviews.title: Timelessbeauty
reviews.content: You expect to see a T. rex come out of the bush it is so untouched despite the history of this country.  The boats hurt your bottom so a cushion is a good investment

reviews.author: henni2004
reviews.title: Nice boat trip with a fantastic scenery
reviews.content: Nice boat trip through a fantastic scenery. The price is 200 k dong per person. We took route one. The first cave was a little bit frightening because it's very narrow. But all in all absolutely recommendable.

reviews.author: Carolina G
reviews.title: So serene!
reviews.content: Loved the water and surrounding mountains.  So peaceful.  Visited some temples and caves.  Snacks and drinks are sold at most stops.  Bring your umbrella or raincoat for eventful rain, we went in September when there was a storm in Halong Bay.

reviews.author: Lan Lulu
reviews.title: nice natural scenery
reviews.content: You will travel by small boat for more than 7km of lakes. There are 3 options to go and I chose number 2 because you can pass a lot of caves. There's a new cave that was newly opened , 1km long, very beautiful and old. The best season is from Jan to May, because weather is not too hot and not rainy, i went there in June, it's pretty hot but less crowded.

reviews.author: Kate B
reviews.title: Breathtaking views
reviews.content: I read about this place on tripadviser and im so glad I ventured there during my short trip in Tam Coc, it was my favorite thing I did. The views are incredible, the staff are lovely, lots of caves and the right amount of time. I went for route no.2 and it lasted about 2.5 hours. If I did it again I would potentially go for a little less time but thats mainly because I didn't have a lot of time to spare. This boat trip will be very relaxing. I was advised not to go on the Tam Coc lake tours and to take this one instead and now I can see why. Thang An Grottoes felt a lot more authentic & less touristy than what I saw of Tam Coc lake tours.

reviews.author: CSC
reviews.title: Eye soothing treatment
reviews.content: Surrounded by karst mountains, greens, clear water, temples, birds, ... Is a one good way to calm down our nerves. Don't worry about the boat, is small but very safe.Duration of trip : Allow min. 3 hrsWhich route : before u get on the boat, there is a board on the left which u can select. Most tourist take route 1 with more tunnelsWhat to bring : Sunglasses, umbrella (highly recommended, there is no shade on the raft), sun block, hat, drinking water (there are stalls selling snacks when the boat stops at one of the temples)Shopping : at the main entrance Many tourist reviewed this place is better than Tam Coc. Which I find it true. Trang An is operated by the same company of Bai Dinh Pagoda. Is systematic, no hustlers, no paddy fields. Yes, the paddy field along boat ride is in Tam Coc.Tips : try not to visit mid afternoon, the sun can be very direct and pictures might not turn out great

reviews.author: Ben H
reviews.title: Must see if in the area!!!
reviews.content: Absolute highlight of Vietnam! The 3hr boat rose through 9 caves (tour 1) was absolutely amazing. You need to duck down in many spots so you don't hit your head because the gap the boat goes through is so small. We went at 1pm and were alone for most of the time (many pictures show hundreds of boats in a line). Very serene, favorite activity so far in Vietnam! On a side note our boat operator was very insistent on us filling out a questionnaire about our ride.  This would be fine except she wanted us to fill it out half way through the tour.  One of the questions was "has your tour guide tried to cut the tour short" which was a bit suspicious but she then finished the full tour after we said that we'd finish the questionnaire at the end. In the end still amazing.

reviews.author: Angie K
reviews.title: One of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam!!
reviews.content: Such a peaceful and serene experience! Rowing through these incredible caves was so interesting and fun!  We would certainly suggest leaving a tip to the lady who rows you around for 2 or 3 hours!  And we would also suggest a hat as the sun can be quite merciless!  You an buy them across the street for about $1.00.

reviews.author: Dimar
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.content: We were accosted by individuals who try to offer things. We rowed to assist our direct away and folks in some other boats have been laughing with us, singing, and also snapping photographs. The grottoes were colorful and warm with electric lights but cautious with the head as it's fairly low at points. It was truly well worth visiting the place.

reviews.author: Thảo Vy N
reviews.title: Ha Long Bay on ground
reviews.content: When I came Ninh Binh I spent 3 hours to visit Trang An. This tour have 3 trips, same price ($9/person) you can choose 1 in 3. I choose trip 2 because I wanna visit movie montage of Kong skull Island. I sat on boat and sightseeing. This place in the past was the capital of king. The architecs in here have preserve the status until today. The impact of modern life is very rare here. The river is clean to see the bottom. In here we have a diversified and specialized ecosystems. You can't throw trash. The unique natural cave system will make you feel unbelievable. Don't forget to tip for ferry woman. I hope all of you enjoy the trip

reviews.author: Samuel L
reviews.title: Gorgeous boat ride through spectacular landscape
reviews.content: Visiting the Trang An Grottoes has been a highlight of Vietnam so far. We rented bikes (bicycles) from our homestay and cycled to Trang An. There is a place to park your bikes for 10,000 Dong per vehicle. The entrance to Trang An is 200,000 Dong per person and you get to choose between three different routes. We chose Route 1 as it has more caves and less temples. Each boat can accommodate 4 people, so we cruised down the Grottoes with another couple. The sights are spectacular and its no wonder the director and producers of Skull Island wanted to film here. Yes, we did expect to see a massive King Kong around the corner. However, the highlights were the caves as we approached them we had to crouch to ensure our heads don't smash against the rocks. On Route 1, you go through 9 caves, so the excitement was always there. Our female rower kept on talking Vietnamese to us expecting we would know what she was saying, but I guess she was just trying to be friendly and start some sort of conversation. The 2-3 hour boat journey can get lonely for them.One little negative about the boat tour is that our rower asked us to fill a questionnaire, which we did and one question said "Did your rower beg for a tip?" which we asked "No" as she didn't. But as soon as that questionnaire was given back and we were approaching the end. The two words of English she knew was "Tip please". We were a bit shock, but she did deserve a small reward for all that effort of rowing us for 2-3 hours.

reviews.author: stevehawkins2016
reviews.title: Great Grottoes
reviews.content: Great place to visit and the boat ride was great. Those people can tow forever. We did help a bit and gave her a US$5 tip. You wont regret it as its named "HaLong Bay on land"

reviews.author: samrey
reviews.title: Highlight of 6 weeks in Vietnam
reviews.content: I am stunned that anyone could not rave about or appreciate this boat trip. We spent 6 weeks exploring Vietnam, including Ha Long Bay and this was by far the highlight. We chose route 3 which has the best scenery. Our tower never tried to sell us anything nor did anyone else and she didn’t ask for a tip although it was almost 3 hours of hard work (we helped her tow a bit although she didn’t ask.)We arrived in the late afternoon and were the last boat to come back at 6pm. The scenery is otherworldly, lush and gorgeous. The trip is very quiet and every minute from the start to the end you feel like you are in a National Geographic documentary. It was way better then our overpriced Ha Long Bay boat trip. Go in the late afternoon (around 3.30-4pm) choose route 3 and have a wonderful time. I’m not sure what planet the people who gave this bad reviews come from but having travelled extensively as a photographer, I can say this was a breath taking experience from start to end.

reviews.author: Chris F
reviews.title: Tranquil yet spectacular
reviews.content: This is renowned as one of the world's most beautiful landscapes. The trip along the river in a tiny sampan is a delight. One warning - if you're not highly flexible in the hips, squatting on the little bench seats of the boat will be a problem.

reviews.author: lokeshyadav99
reviews.title: A mesmerizing boat ride through the caves.
reviews.content: One of best places in Vietnam. Simply loved it. Both the landscape and the tour was awesome. The ride through the deep caves was thrilling and very serene feeling in calm water outside the caves. The way it is organized is highly commendable. The boat operator was very friendly.

reviews.author: yusukesuzuky
reviews.title: perfect memory
reviews.content: highly recommend for all of you . We really had the unforgettable moment when visiting this place . Perfect

reviews.author: Cat Ba Express Bus & Tours
reviews.title: It's great way to get to Ninh Binh
reviews.content: You can visit Trang An by yourself from Cat Ba or Ha Noi, contact Cat Ba Express to get transportation service.If you are group of 3 people up, you should ask them for private tour, if you follow group tour, they are normally visit Bai Dinh and Trang An, but I think it is much more fun with Trang An and Mua Cave or Trang An and Biking around which are available in private tour.Enjoy your time with good choice!

reviews.author: Peter W
reviews.title: To do or skip? Question answered.
reviews.content: When we went at 9.30 am there was a conveyor belt of boats ( 100s) all leaving the dock so we came back at 4.30pm and there were less .if you have never been in a cave or on a rowboat that often,then you may enjoy this especially if you have children .BUT for me this was awful! The temples and places you visit have all been made to create things to see on the tour.A far better option and free,is to cross the rd and bike or walk in either direction until you find a small rd .Go down the rd and get lost .You will see the same scenery ( or better ) without the crowds and gimmicks.We spent a good few hours wondering around here and it was a zillion times better than being stuck on a tin boat !

reviews.author: ALON S
reviews.title: Graet Time guided By Mr Dung
reviews.content: fabulous place . we had a great Time thanks to our amazing guide Mr Dung from emeralda resort . (Raino) Mr Dung took us to the best places. He was so nice and kind and helpful . I truly recommend to hire Mr Dung from Emeralda Resort

reviews.author: Explorer541132
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Beautiful. Would highly recommend the 3 caves/3 places of interest tour. Good 2.5 hours. Boat lady will ask you for a tip! But only after you’ve filled in a form where you are asked if you were asked for a tip.

reviews.author: Hoài Linh T
reviews.title: Fabulous Ninh Binh !
reviews.content: Boat trip was fantastic !! The caves are amazingly surrounded by the nature. Very beautiful landscape looking like Kingkong's island.

reviews.author: Lorella D
reviews.title: Unmissable!
reviews.content: Wonderful long trip on the water, through amazing caves and sceneries. I took about a million pictures and enjoyed every single minute of the time spent here

reviews.author: Pierre H
reviews.title: Very good experience
reviews.content: We went to Trang An Grottoes after hearing that the Tam Coc one was a tourist trap with rowers asking for tips in the middle of the tour or else they would stop paddling! No issues in Trang An Grottoes, it was an amazing 3hours with highly skilled rowers. We were very impressed!

reviews.author: Gregorius
reviews.title: Very decent
reviews.content: I have been to many of the tourist sites. They're all really fascinating and some are extremely stunning, but Trang An is extremely valuable. It's visited by tourists very much and is pretty much completely appreciated by Vietnamese. I like Tam Coc, though I've to point out, Trang An was a lot more peaceful and pleasant. No business owner selling things.

reviews.author: Lor6969
