reviews.title: Nice boat tour
reviews.content: We did not know if we should chose Trang An Grottos or Tam Coc boat trip. We decided Trang An because I did not want to get asked for more money in the boat!! I am glad we did this boat tour. There was 3 circuits and we chose n3 as this one had 1 longue cave and 2 small one.  Very happy with the choice.

reviews.author: 663zins
reviews.title: Very Scenic and Beautiful boat ride - must do
reviews.content: I took route 2 and did it in late afternoon, it is a must-do when you are in Ninh Binh..splendid sceneries, impressive caves,  mysterious karsts; all of these make the boat ride just simply amazing and breathtaking.

reviews.author: Bel
reviews.title: Caves were insane
reviews.content: Did route number 3,  very cool caves. Great mix of boat time, land time and cave time. Buy a hat across the road for 25000 its so hot.

reviews.author: Pohyeeeeee
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: We booked Ninh Binh day tour thru Lily's Travel. At Trang An, 4 of us shared a boat. The boat ride took 2 hours. Compared to Tam Coc, Trang An is more quiet and serene. One wouldn't be disturbed by vendors who force tourists to buy drinks and souvenirs. During the boat ride, we got to explore different caves and temples. We passed by the temples but the boat didn't stop for us to go to the temples. As we went there in afternoon, it is advised to prepare umbrella/cap and water to avoid dehydration. Towards the end of tour, the boat rower would ask us to fill in a survey form and rate the boat ride and services. We were also advised by the tour guide to provide 20K VND for tipping as a token of appreciation to the boat rower.

reviews.author: Sudesh
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: This natural environment has destructed for tourisam There should be proper mechanism to save thisOther hand this is a beautiful place which if you come around, must visit location

reviews.author: tlchin
reviews.title: Amazing scenery
reviews.content: We had a boat ride along the river in which the rower deftly navigated the boat especially when going under the cave, where the visitors may need to bow their heads to avoid some of the jutted rocks from top and sides. Although it was still hot during the time we went, the scenery was simply amazing and serene. You could see colorful fish and ducks in the tranquil water, and the best part was when the boat entered the cave and coming out to reveal limestone mountains on both side of the river: it was as though as you are entering a lost paradise :)

reviews.author: Hoang Lan
reviews.title: Great tour
reviews.content: This is one of the most recommended places for you in Ninh Binh. You will travel on boat to see the beautiful landscape and also through the dark caves with more exciting feelings. There are 3 routes, we choose route 1,the traditional one. Route 2 and 3 go with Kong film, maybe you could try route 3,they say route 3 will go through the longest cave 1km. If compared with Tam coc, this is a preferred tour. Tam coc is more beautiful in May or June as it is covered by yellow ripe rice fields.

reviews.author: LucasTG96
reviews.title: Kingkong
reviews.content: Travelled through 12 caves by boat and the place is stunning. The area is large and the landscapes is fabulous enough to bring you to Kingkong island.!!

reviews.author: Mike k
reviews.title: Idyllic few hours
reviews.content: Choice of 3 different routes, choose route 3 and had to pay for a third ticket to ensure we had no one else in boat with us. After setting off surrounded by other boats it wasn't long before we were on our own with the others turning onto the other routes. The lady rowing took us through a series of caves where we needed to crouch down to avoid the low hanging rocks before we exited in to hidden lagoons with temples to explore. In all the relaxing trip took almost 3 hours of near solitude and would recommend it as a must do while in Ninh Binh area.

reviews.author: tuztraveller
reviews.title: a rowboat ride through the Trang An Grottoes
reviews.content: We took the local train from Hanoi to Nimh Binh and hired a scooter for the day. Definitely a highlight was the three + hours (there are three choices of ride, ours the longest) of boat ride through the grottoes and seeing the Pagodas/Temples along the way. The peace and tranquility of gliding through the river and caves after the hustle and bustle of Hanoi/Saigon was bliss. Some of the caves were so narrow, we had to slide into the bottom of the boat. There are four to a boat, so if you are a couple, you will have to wait to be paired with another couple. Great way to meet people.(For the train trip, it took two hours--recommend booking from Train Station rather than online, and ask for soft seats + aircon!)

reviews.author: iliketomoveandsee
reviews.title: Didn't ride the boat, but did cycle around the area
reviews.content: Very pretty area, and lovely tourist attraction. We did not ride the boat trip as it takes so long and we didn't want to sit in direct sun for that long. The area is very pretty to cycle around though.We rode our bikes here from Tam Coc and it took about 45 minutes.

reviews.author: Dexan
reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful
reviews.content: While some people prefer to visit Tam Coc over Trang An when in Ninh Binh,I chose the later for my family holiday. It was a good decision as the trip was truly an exciting one. We rowed through 9 caves and the surrounding is stunningly beautiful with many limestone hills all along the river. Tips: After the ticket counter,there is a huge board on the lef that display a choice of 3 routes. Once you have decided,you then proceed to board the small rowing boat with a rower. You can assist her or him to row for fun and enjoyment.

reviews.author: Larry_J_Petas
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: 200,000 dong each for a 2h boat ride With 3 caves and 3 temples- king Kong movie set and Disney-feel "village" section was terrible but tolerable. Lucky as had live music in one of the locations, worth a go. We are lucky as traffic was low but the boats are literally hundreds so if all had been engaged it would have felt a bit like a floating conveyor  belt. Early morning recommended before buses arrive.

reviews.author: Jo N
reviews.title: Beautiful caves
reviews.content: This was a lovely tour through 12 caves. There is other shorter tours which go through less caves (maybe better for children). The ladies that paddle the boats are friendly and very talented when manoeuvring through the caves. There is beautiful scenery and many photo opportunities

reviews.author: Suz
reviews.title: Not to be missed!
reviews.content: Highly recommended to visit this place. The boat ride around the area was beautiful and amazing! And going to cave was a exciting experience.

reviews.author: atuaprima
reviews.title: Forget Tam Coc, do Trang An instead!
reviews.content: Much better than Tam Coc. It's a larger area and the trip takes longer. You also stop along the way to visit different temples. Unlike Tam Coc, you are not constantly pressed to tip or to give money to fruit sellers. The landscape is beautiful and peaceful, and you can make very nice pictures.

reviews.author: Anu S
reviews.title: Must Not Miss!
reviews.content: The tour exemplifies Ninh Binh and the limestone karst formations, interspersed with many Pagodas and sights along the way.  Not worth missing when in Ninh Binh, unless you know you are coming back!  I did not experience Tam Coc Rice Fields boat ride for a comparison, but did see the rice fields from the top of Hang Mua.  During the season I visited the rice fields were brown and were not such as incredible and bright green as some of the pictures you might see.  There are two tours.  We did the non-King Kong tour.  Visited in December 2017.

reviews.author: Louis M
reviews.title: Lovely trip but ended badly
reviews.content: Our guide and rower was very miserable and that's fine as she was excellent at guiding us through the caves and didn't speak English. There was another couple on the boat from Vietnam so they helped translate a few things for us. There were extra paddles so me and my partner often helped but that's optional of course.At the end of the tour I looked for my headband which I had placed under my seat on the boat and it wasn't there. Then the other couple also said they were missing some sunglasses and they were also missing. The lady in the boat made a silly gesture that they were thrown overboard or something and avoided eye contact with us. Ok just a headband but it was lovely and sunglasses, they could've been expensive. It left a bad taste in my mouth but I wasn't about to accuse her of theft but nothing else jumped overboard in the time we were off the boat.I doubt it's very common but don't leave anything of value on the boat when you get off at temples etc.

reviews.author: Vacation714423
reviews.title: Trang An over Tam Coc, any day!
reviews.content: You can row-boat tour in Tam Coc or Trang An. My opinion: skip Tam Coc and go straight for Trang An. Tam Coc is beautiful, but it's a tourist trap. You'll have to read up on how to avoid everything (incorrect rates, ridiculous tipping, paddlers demanding money in the middle of the tour to continue rowing, etc). On the flip side, Trang An is also beautiful, hyper organized, less chaotic, and an overall A+ experience. There are 3 routes to choose from based on how you're feeling; I did Route 2.  This experience was one of the best parts of Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Emilija K
reviews.title: Definetely a great experience
reviews.content: We came here after visiting boat tour in Tam Coc. Many people says Trang An is much between, however I think they are both worth a visit as it's so different. We took 1 option with 9 caves and it took us 3.5 hours to visit it everything. Caves were so much fun! You had to bend down not to hit your head. I'm a claustrofobic person, but it didn't bother me at all!We also had to help to row, but it was really cool way to experience the tour.My recommendation to go very early in the morning, because at 9 was already super hot and we got sunburned even with a sunscreen. Also, evenings are cooler, so it would be the best. We did Tam Coc boat tour in the afternoon and it was great weather with almost no people.In case you don't have time to visit both boat tours, I would recommend Trang An just because its way longer and diverse!

reviews.author: cherry_streets
reviews.title: A must on everyone's itinerary!
reviews.content: This place was magical. I went with my husband and we decided to pay for 4 people to have the boat to ourselves. The water level was very high so we could only go to the Skull Island route. Going through the caves was phenomenal- so serene and beautiful. It was one of the top activities of our trip to Vietnam!

reviews.author: Siok H
reviews.title: Picturesque
reviews.content: I opt for route 2 as my kids won’t like to explore caves. The boat ride was longer than expected and my child fell asleep during the journey.  The scene was gorgeous and peaceful. A pity that I couldn’t communicate at all with the boat lady.

reviews.author: Bright
reviews.title: Do not miss cave no.7
reviews.content: This's not really a tour because the boat driver does not show you anything. You will find two boat rides to select from, each costing 200,000₫. Route two is the smaller boat ride taking about one hour and also includes four caves/grottoes and a few Temples. I chose Route one, the greater boat ride taking approximately three hours and that comprise nine caves/grottoes and four Temples. Cave/grotto no.7 is the only person you do not go through. The motorboat driver drops you close to the entry and also you walk towards the other side in which you get found once again. The scenery is stunning and I am happy I did the further boat ride. Nobody attempting to market your material on the water or even asking to have the photo of yours as at Tam Coc This was Much Better compared to the Tam Coc Boat Ride. I have kept the best pictures for myself.

reviews.author: kayla0307
reviews.title: Beautiful picturesque scenery
reviews.content: A must if you’re in the area!  We took an 1 1/2 hr boat ride around the grottoes and the scenery was amazing.  Our lady guide pointed out the native floral and fauna as well as the history of Trang An.   Our kids LOVED going through the caves.  Due to the high water, we couldn’t explore all the caves but we did toured the area where Kong: Skull Island was filmed.  We visited with the natives in their huts and my daughter’s ice cream was stolen from one of their goats!  It was a very memorable experience and our whole family loved Trang An Grottoes.

reviews.author: GGFC54
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: The grottoes are about 2 and a half hours south of Hanoi and my trip took in a visit to the largest temple and pagoda complex in Vietnam ( beautiful ) and a bicycle ride through the rice fields in the gorges near the grottoes (great fun). Being paddled through the waterways and caves of the grottoes in a bamboo boat for 2 hours was a blissful experience. Strongly recommended and one of many highlights of my amazing trip to Vietnam.

reviews.author: AshiqAbdeen
reviews.title: GROTTES
reviews.content: IIt was so hot the I visited these grottes in a boat of three people.Need entrance tickets then you choose what type of places you intend to see in your boat trip.We chooses the longest tour for about Three hours.It was very good all the way.we went through many caves and Pagodas.The river Surrounded by magnificent mountains.BEUTIFUL FOR NATURE LOVERS

reviews.author: VanessaTran101
reviews.title: Beautiful scenic area
reviews.content: We visited Trang An on a sunny day. Three of us on the boat to go around the beautiful landscape complex including Kong filming location. The caves are quite massive. A must-do in the Northern Vietnam.

reviews.author: Marline
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: We didn’t quite know what to expect & were positively surprised! After getting our tickets, we got into a boat of 4 ppl & a lady rowed us down the river, through caves & to several temples. We also stopped to see one of the places shown in King Kong, which was cool!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: In doubt? Do it!
reviews.content: Really nice and scenic tour. Definitely do not miss this. You’ll go in boats of 4, and there are different routes to chose from.

reviews.author: Carel1978
reviews.title: Worth the drive from Hanoi
reviews.content: I was in Hanoi for a couple of days and needed to escape the hustle and bustle of the Old Quarters. Really easy to find calmness in this beautiful surroundings. The day trip included Bai Dinh Pagoda and lunch, but this was the highlight by far

reviews.author: Natalia K
reviews.title: Very nice quiet and beautiful place
reviews.content: The tour is amazing. It takes 3 hours to do the tour on the boat. It costs 200k dong. The view of the caves , mountains and lake is beautiful. It’s so peaceful. Just remember to take something to protect your head and ou some sunscreen because the sun is really strong even in the morning .

reviews.author: Ian S
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery but very touristy
reviews.content: Trang An is a world heritage site of great beauty. It comprises valleys with waterways and is seen by taking to the water, being ferried around by ladies (mostly) who steer the barge from the back whilst you assist with the rowing. There are various ‘islands’ with sights (temples) to visit but the highlight are passing through the caves, with the distance between the water and the cave roof dependent on how much rain has fallen!! You can choose between the length (and therefore time) of tour you want to do.The only potential downside is it’s popularity means that you are one of hundreds barges out at any one time, but if you can ignore this, the beauty is something to enjoy.

reviews.author: prasadk27
reviews.title: Pristine, Ethereal, Mind Blowing
reviews.content: A must do activity, Tran An Grottoes is best undertaken as a full day trip. Reaching early, helps to not only beat the crowds but also the heat. Opt for the maximum hire time for the boat as there are 3 routes through the landscape and you can go through all 3. The row boats can take between 5-6 persons each. However, limiting the number, means you can go that much faster and spend more time on the route.  We were just 2 of us on my boat and it helped me get wider angles of the land scape. The routes are ethereal, pristine, peaceful and mind blowing. If you have not been through a grotto before, it can be scary.  It is absolutely safe though. Post going through Trang An by boat, do try to go around the area on foot, for stunning views.

reviews.author: laurentp08
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: We had a great boat tour about 3 hours to discover Trang An. It's very interesting with the scenery and the caves are excellent

reviews.author: Alen Z
reviews.title: Awesome tour!
reviews.content: Boat “drivers” are very nice, although they don’t speak English, you’ll visit 3 temples, 4 caves and the place where Kung Kong movie was filmed. Caves are fantastic, in some of them you have to be really careful to not to hit your head. Temples are newly built but very beautiful. I would definitely highly recommend this tour!

reviews.author: darylg283
reviews.title: Relaxing journey through fascinating scenery
reviews.content: Being rowed through this amazing landscape and viewing the temples and gardens shouldn't be missed. I would recommend a small parasol or wide brimmed hat for some shade if it is a sunny day since the boats are not covered so the wonderful views are not blocked.

reviews.author: 672g
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery but bring snacks and plan ahead
reviews.content: Recently visited the Tran An grottoes and had a great time.  Very peaceful and beautiful.  There are three routes that are available. The longest is route number 3 which goes through a series of low caves.  It was a lot of fun but be aware that the openings are very small and low which can be difficult for those that are claustrophobic.  Also during the tour you can visit the island where the King Kong movie was filed and the old movie set still re,mains. There is not much left other than a few of the tee-pees that were depicted in the movie but it was still interesting if you are a movie fan or are travelling with kids or teens.  Since the ride lasts about three hours, I would suggest stopping at a store before you depart for Trang An to pick up snacks for your journey which lasts about 3 hours.  Also, there are no convenience stores or good restaurants in the area so if you are planning on spending the day in the area and touring other sites, I would suggest bringing food, fruit, drinks and snacks for the day.  Otherwise, you will be very hungry, thirsty, tired and aggravated looking around for a place to get something and being unable to find anything.

reviews.author: rachandben9192
reviews.title: Ecotourism
reviews.content: A worthy UNESCO site that is 'commercialized' with the care and involvement of locals to run each grottoes

reviews.author: sabineober
reviews.title: Beautiful nature but masstourism...
reviews.content: The nature itself and all those beautiful caves (which are sometimes quiet small) are awesome and I enjoyed waching it. Everything is green, the water clear and the mountains impressive! It's definately worth to see.But the problem was that me and friend were sat on a boat together with two vietnamese tourists (about 50 years old) and they went there together with a big group and so our boats stayed together and they talked all the time between the boats very loudly and the woman in our boat started to sing all the time (also super loud and also in the caves). That was so annoying and a pity because we couldn't enjoy the nature.. However, my advice to you: go there early in the morning right when it opens or in the evening (about 4 pm) because there wasn't anyone at the peer when we went out at the same time. And maybe try to get on a boat with other western tourists or not with people out of a group...

reviews.author: Chris L
reviews.title: Worth A Visit
reviews.content: We did route 2 when we went as that is all that was available and the views were great! I highly recommend taking a lot of water and a hat as being on the water for two hours with no shade or water would be killer. Some of the caves are very small so if you have back or leg trouble I don’t recommend going as you will be very uncomfortable through those.

reviews.author: Roaming Kiwi
reviews.title: Needs more tourist control
reviews.content: Nice enough boat ride, interesting scenery. Unfortunately the peace and tranquility were destroyed by being surrounded by screaming tour groups - at one point, in a nearby boat, the guide gave one of her members the megaphone to sing loudly (and badly) in. If maybe the decorum of tourists was controlled a little more it'd be nicer.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: Unexpected
reviews.content: This is a little gem place. I was not expecting such amazing views and pristine nature.The 2.5h tour is enough, they take you with the boat all along the route with stops on several temple.s

reviews.author: Megin v
reviews.title: Cool boat tour and beautiful surroundings!
reviews.content: We really liked the surroundings and the entire Ninh Binh area. Especially going through really narrow and small grottoes is something I will not forget easily. Also getting out of the grottoes and seeing all karst rocks come up is an awesome experience. Be prepared for a lot of paddling though. And tourists..

reviews.author: yboxer
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.content: The nature pure beauty. What a wonderful boat trip, the scenery is beautiful, so relax, you get into caves with boat and one out from the other side, you get off in some places and walk a bit- wowPrepare yourself to the hot sun for 3 hours.I slept at Tam Coc village - so I took bicycle to get there- wonderful ride.

reviews.author: KellyS3210
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.content: We arrived by motorbike - following signs for parking, it costs 15k dong for the day. There are 3 routes to choose from but today only route 2 was available due to high water levels which was a shame. However we really enjoyed it and saw 3 caves, 3 temples and the King Kong set. You can have 3-5 people on a boat, as a couple we went with another couple. It is worth trying to make sure you get the front seats!! Get there before 9am as that is when the tour groups arrive. For us it was not busy at all. As of August 2018 the tickets cost 200k dong per person - expensive by Vietnam standards but we had a 3 hour tour that was stunning. You can get off to explore the temples which are pretty. Worth noting all toilets cost 2000 doing to use anywhere at the site, even the temples. The caves are fantastic - watch your head!! I loved the caves, but perhaps not for those who are a bit claustrophobic. It gets very, very hot with no shade so take plenty of water and a hat. There are oars for you to help out - I recommend doing this. Our boat rower did ask for a tip (seems unusual?) but never were we hassled on the whole trip, it was beautifully peaceful and few boats too. Amazing experience.

reviews.author: Erik S
reviews.title: Expensive boat ride but it is worth it anyway
reviews.content: Go here. You will be rowed around the caves and you will see some temples. From here it is a nice MC drive to the big buddhist temple.

reviews.author: Xiao Huang
reviews.title: Beautiful and natural sightseeing
reviews.content: Just completed to explore Mua cave, we had a local lunch with local meat “ goat meat “ . It was delicious. We went on our trip to see Trang An ecosystem. Sitting on the small boat and take a look view. The local people rowing the paddle on river and we are relaxing, some time we did it for trial. It took us around 2 our to visit this site and there are 3 schedule : route 1,2 and 3. We chose route 2 with film studio . Where “King Kong film “ was made in 2016 and launched in 2017. We have a hard day but it is deserved.Highly recommend

reviews.author: Raquel
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: An excellent spot to visit. The scenery is stunning. The boats are rowed by Vietnamese females who earn very small each day and also have a tough job. The lady who rowed our motorboat was grateful for the help of ours and excited for a suggestion at the end. The boat ride underwent a total of nine amazing caves. The roofs are very small we'd to duck and these women are good at maintaining the boat on the center track. It was an excellent journey. The boat does get somewhat uncomfortable after 2 3 hrs of rowing and thus there's simply no quicker path as the caves are very narrow and manage a' one-way' program.

reviews.author: Nadia Watson
reviews.title: Great trip with cave adventure!
reviews.content: August is allow season for Trang An. They offered 3 routes (3 hours, 2.5 hours and 2 hours). There was only 2 hour boat trip available that day because of high water. The cave was a good fun, especially watching how the local steer the boat in a narrow path.

reviews.author: Ryun
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: We selected grottoes rather than Halong Bay and weren't disappointed. What an incredible place, so peaceful, we arrived holding a Vietnamese vacation and also the location was busy however actually peaceful. And so happy we choose Ninh Binh in front of Halong bay.

reviews.author: Tom S
reviews.title: Cheap fun day out
reviews.content: We went to Trang An because we had a few hours to kill and it was perfect for just that. It was 200k and lasted about 2 hours. You get to visit a few little stops on the way, most known is where Kong: Skull Island was filmed.

reviews.author: Devin
reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.content: This was an excellent experience as well as one that can feel as it's not as famous yet because it is going to be... very exclusive and the impressive night cave sections have been a huge shock but amazing! when the other side of the caves you end up in a very secluded lagoon with only yourselves.

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Just Okay
reviews.content: The boat tour at Tam Coc was much better. Trang An is beautiful and seeing the King Kong movie set was cool. However the staff ruined it for me. They will not do solo tours. The boat driver was very mean and rude to us. The other boats try to sell you stuff too much that it gets annoying. If you only have time to see one boat tour just go to Tam Coc and save your money.

reviews.author: Fabbri
reviews.title: Beauty
reviews.content: Go to Trang An grotto. Beautiful and serene scenery. Do not wait to hire a boat only for yourself... so tranquil to hear the oars within the bath, the singing birds and also contemplate the gorgeous scenery. Magical!Next, stop at among the goat restaurant in which the niche (goat!) is among the best memories of mine!

reviews.author: Billy r
reviews.title: Bad experience due to poor staff
reviews.content: Firstly do not park where they tell you to. As with most vietnamese scammers there is free parking where the taff park about 100 meters from the main gate. We parked there no issues.When we got there we saw a couple hope out of the back of a boat into the next boat at the front. We thought what a good idea. We would like to sit at the front too. The staff member in charge of assigning people a boat told us to hope into the back of the boat that the couple just got out of. We said we would like to do the same as them and sit at the front (they got on the very next boat). I dont know if it was because we were young or what but this was a massive problem for him to organise this for us (it was no problem for the other people). He made us wait 30 minutes (there was plenty of opportunity for us to get on another boat he was just being a smartass). This ruined the whole boat ride for us.Wouldnt waste my time going here. Instead go somewhere like the ecotourism park and watch the birds and see the caves. They realise their industry needs tourists to survive and are pleasant people.

reviews.author: 86VeeMN
reviews.title: Kinda cool.
reviews.content: It was a much longer boat ride than we were expecting (approx. 2 hours). So bring water & sunscreen & a fan. The ladies work very hard rowing tourists around. Don’t envy their job. They kind of awkwardly expected us to participate in rowing once they grew tired, which wasn’t fun.

reviews.author: Emily T
reviews.title: A beautiful can't miss boat ride
reviews.content: A beautiful boat ride along the mountains! A great experience (bring sunscreen!!!) and loved every minute!

reviews.author: Olga S
reviews.title: It's really Ha Long on the ground!
reviews.content: After Ha Long Bay cruise we went to Trang An and were suprised when saw such a beautiful place! The nature is best creator! Excursion on boat takes you though caves and canals, and you just enjoy fantastic view! It's worth to visit with no doubt!

reviews.author: Arvind C
reviews.title: Just beautiful!
reviews.content: Went with my parents and they loved it. The first of the caves is pretty long and can be scary, my parents got anxious while crossing it, by the third cave they were comfortable. My daughter enjoyed it thoroughly, water is very clear too, it seems greenish but thats coz of the plants and weeds.Better to go very early to avoid the sun, recommended to take sun screen and umbrella to avoid sun burns. Also, if one is not interested in visiting pagoda's they can skip it and just do the tunnels.

reviews.author: Ngoc Ngo
reviews.title: Very nice boat ride
reviews.content: Nice boat view with cheap price ( $10/4 hours). The landscape still keep their nature as is. Water also clean and you can see through. Should go there by early of Jun.

reviews.author: Matt G
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Trang An is a lot better compared to Tam Coc in the terminology of hassle and tranquility. We weren't accosted by people who trying to offer things like at giving Tam Coc. We rowed to assist our direct away and folks in some other boats have been laughing with us, singing, and also snapping photographs. The grottoes had been colorful and warm with electric lights, but watchful with head as it's fairly small at points. It was truly well worth visiting the place.

reviews.author: Megan Y
reviews.title: Scenic!
reviews.content: The Trang An Grottos was a scenic tour that is fun for the family. However quite long and not recommended on very hot days.

reviews.author: listhadi
reviews.title: For those who loves nature experience
reviews.content: The original  boat ride is about  4 hours ,  in a small wooden sampan  with   wood and iron  bar  as a chair.  Yes they gave you cushion. But beware for those with lower back problems.  Ideally i think  this trip is not for children under  7 .  Many of the caves are dark and like a long tunnel.  Its better also to take this trip when the weather is below 30°celcius. To avoid sunburn..always prepare your umbrella, although the sampan rower can lend you theirs.  Overall ecperience was fun..and unique scenery.. I chose shorter route cause it was an extremely hot day.

reviews.author: July010
reviews.title: Stunning Scenery!!!
reviews.content: This is a beautiful location with stunning scenery! We are a family of 5 with 3 teenagers and we all totally loved our boat ride through this area. Highly recommend visiting here!!!

reviews.author: TravelExpert32
reviews.title: Do not miss this!
reviews.content: Yes, it is a little expensive for Vietnamese standards (200,000 VND per person as of July 2018) but what you get for that money is fantastic: you get a boat, and your own personal rower who will take you around the caves and the islands. The views are fantastic and the caves are simply spectacular. Motorcycle and bike parking available outside for 15,000 VND a bike, and once inside, apart from 2,000 to use the toilets, you won’t be asked for any extra money. Ideally you would need your own transport to get there as it’s a 15 minute drive outside of Ninh Binh centre, however hiring scooters is very easy in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: sue r
reviews.title: Fun boat ride in beautiful scenery
reviews.content: We loved this. Our boat driver was very skilled at negotiating the caverns - this was tricky as waters were high due to recent heavy rains. Moments of blissful calm gazing at mountains, greenery and caves - and even cute baby ducks!

reviews.author: katebui_97
reviews.title: Twin of Halong Bay
reviews.content: If you have gone to Halong Bay before, then nothing much to expect except for the rice paddies that you might catch glimpse of on the way. Ah, the waters, for me, is more impressive. There are weeds or something beneath. I saw couples lying on the waters taking wedding photos there :)))Nothing much to see at caves. Dark, and not that beautiful.

reviews.author: GK
reviews.title: A must visit!
reviews.content: The cruise was amazing! We were 3 and we had the boat for ourselves. We picked the route 3 with 3 temples and 3 caves. The first cave in particular was fantastic, however, you need to watch out for your head as the ceiling is low at times. The scenery is breathtaking and there werent't too many boats around so we could enjoy the nature. Cruise lasted for around 2.5 - 3 hours. You can get off at the temples and Kong film set and walk a bit. The rowers are waiting for the tourists at predefined spots. At the end of the trip we were also asked to fill in a short service questionnaire. Overall, it was a fantastic experience! If you're hesitating between cruises at Trang An and Tam Coc and you can only do one, go for Trang An.

reviews.author: Livvy
reviews.title: Great tour!
reviews.content: just regrow by train an, take by little bout the person row the boat for two hours the gorgeous place and incredible to check out of scenery we enjoy a very minute in fact, we row the motorboat to notice numerous cave and grottoes almost all together we come across eight grottoes I've a lot of enjoyable to chat with woman row the motorboat, I would love to recommend the trip for anyone arrive in Vietnam must go there to go to Trang an,

reviews.author: Alex5121
reviews.title: Nice place let down by the hoards of rude tourists
reviews.content: Considering all the great reviews for boating at Trang An rather than Tam Coc we travelled here with high expectations.On arrival we had to deal with big groups pushing for a place at the ticket window. Once we had our tickets we went to the boats. This was a nightmare as hundreds of people were doing the same in a very unpoliced way. Eventually we were told to sit and wait for another couple to make up the 4 seat boat. This couple had their umbrellas up the whole time so we couldn’t see much, they screamed like hooligans through the caves and would not stop singing/talking loudly/shouting to friends on other boats. This spoiled the experience for us. The type of tourists visiting these sites makes me certain that we would have had the same experience with different boat companions too. Plus, other tourists were constantly pushing us (physically- my gf got a huge cut on her arm from a woman grabbing her) when demanding we star in their photos. Being manhandled in this way was extremely rude and put us off the entire thing. This isn’t the tour operators fault but the uneducated tourists there. After an hour or so we had well and truly had enough, the seats are extremely uncorformatble to sit on for even an hour let lone 3. * Don’t visit in the rain!*

reviews.author: KiwiTravellerOnline
reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.content: We were lucky and arrived when it was quiet. Stunning scenery and pretty special to row through a cave to emerge on the other side. The temples were so serene in that setting. I had left my phone in my bike's basket and the parking attendant found it and kept it safe for me.

reviews.author: Nerys L
reviews.title: Fantastic boat trip! Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: We took route 3 trip, went through lots of caves and saw some really beautiful scenery. Was just under 3 hours as we didn’t get off at all the stops (King Kong Skull Island movie set, as had two small children). Clean toilet facilities along the way also, make sure you take small change with you as they charge 2,000 vnd. Our guide was so lovely, not pushy at all unlike at Tam Coc, so we tipped her at the end.

reviews.author: Hugibert
reviews.title: Quite crowded, but beautiful scenery
reviews.content: As other people stated, you will find numerous Vietnamese tourists here and it is able to get risky attempting to get a boat on a national vacation, but this all adds to the cultural knowledge. Expect a lot of interest, but a beautiful and calming boat ride.

reviews.author: Florian C
reviews.title: Awesome !
reviews.content: We spent an awesome day there with my girlfriend. The landscapes are really beautiful,one of the best thing that I did in my life. The operator was really friendly. I recommend

reviews.author: ccmaree
reviews.title: Pretty as a picture
reviews.content: This area does feel like your own Nat. Geo. documentary! Very beautiful place and we were lucky not to que or wait for anything long - we were there just before 9am.  Very enjoyable.  We chose route 2 of the three choices as I’m not a fan of caves and this had only three.  Fun to visit the Kong film set especially with the teen and hubby who loved the film.  It took only two hours.

reviews.author: Dimitry
reviews.title: Fantastic trip!
reviews.content: We enjoyed the visit of ours here a lot! The incredible scenery, the serenity as well as attractiveness of this particular school. It was among the highlight of the trip of ours in Vietnam. We began the visit of ours at 4pm so we have been the final boats to leave so we almost had the location for ourselves. The brightness was ideal to take photographs, also liked the nice pathways through the grottoes. Do not miss this place!

reviews.author: UK việt
reviews.title: Just keeps giving
reviews.content: We had an amazing two hour tour of this landscape. We opted for tour 2 and were happy with what we saw. Truly breathtaking

reviews.author: tifasch
reviews.title: Amazing scenery
reviews.content: Very nice guide even though she didn't speak english. I did tour 1 with more caves and we were the only boat most of the time. I started at 3 p.m. during the week which seems to be a less crowded time. The Tour takes approximatly 3 hours

reviews.author: Anthony F
reviews.title: Anthony Ferguson
reviews.content: On way to Ninh Binh we enjoyed a Sampan trip along the river at trang an. The trip was leisurely & the limestone mountains made for a serene atmosphere. Cruising through limestone caves added to our experience. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: quivo03
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: Our private tour group got on 4 boats and had a lovely 2hrs+ tour of three caves and the King Kong movie set.  We skipped the temples because we seen them before.  The sights were beautiful and relaxing.  My family had a nice chat with our row women.  They gave informative narration of their daily life and the work that they do.  (We are Vietnamese-American) Please tip your row person well because they make less than $10 a day rowing.

reviews.author: Colin P
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.content: This was brilliant. The caves and temples were all spectacular. There were no vendors to hassel you on the tour which sounds like it has become a big issue at Tam Coc.Be prepared to help out with the rowing.

reviews.author: Vincent D
reviews.title: Picturesque romantic spot
reviews.content: Love this place Beautiful and peaceful Boat ride takes about 3+ hours and is great valueRemember to take an umbrella if you visit in the rainy season (April till september) a hat and something to drinkCan get very busy on weekends so try to go through the weekBeautiful scenery everywhere you look

reviews.author: KaladinT
reviews.title: Very good, until it got ruined by masses of other boats
reviews.content: The first half of the tour was great, the surroundings were beautiful with the calm waters, beautiful green surroundings, and spectacular karst cliffs as well as the caves the boat takes you through (we did the 3 cave tour and were impressed by these).However, roughly half way through the trip it suddenly became a lot busier. What was previously serene and relaxing became loud and overcrowded with so many other other tourists - the main culprits being Chinese tour groups.There was literally 15 or so of these boats around us, full of being shouting and talking loudly, and several of them taking pictures of us without permission or any discretion.If you can go early or late and avoid the huge number of tour groups, its a very good trip.

reviews.author: chuhn8
reviews.title: Skip Tam Coc this is amazing
reviews.content: Option 1 has 9 caves and 3 temples all by paddle boat. The facilty is clean and the views are breathtaking. We had three of us on one boat it was 200000vnd each for about 3 hours. Our paddler guided us through low hanging caves like a champ. The temples we're okay more like breaks, but the caves and karsts rivaled Halong Bay. We tipped 100000 vnd but the ladies are not allowed to hassle us which was refreshing as foreigners.

reviews.author: Trang N
reviews.title: Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Ok, we just went to Tam Coc yesterday, and then to Trang An grottoes today. You really don’t need to do both because you’ll see everything at Trang An, plus more.Trang An has the same boats with much more pleasant rowers who aren’t allowed to ask for tips. You also won’t get the aggressive vendors like they have at Tam Coc. There’s temples, more caves, and the Skull Island movie set to see/visit.  The tour takes you around the entire park, vs. Tam Coc made a u-turn and takes you back the exact same route you came from.Overall, a much more pleasant trip than Tam Coc. More to see and do, as well as tranquil. You’re not expected to tip, although, you should know that the rowers have to wait  their turn and only get to row every 3-7 days. So tipping would be really nice to help the people out.

reviews.author: Solesouljoy
reviews.title: Interesting landscape
reviews.content: Boat rides had some semblance of safety - lifejackets were handed out upon boarding, and queues were organized. 3 routes are offered and I’d personally go with the third one that takes you through a 1km long cave and makes a stop at the kong skull island movie set. Water is clear at some parts of the river, allowing you to see the sand bed and sea grass below and the little fishes. Seems that tipping is controlled here? A questionnaire was given (in Vietnamese language) which explicitly asked if the rower asked customers for tips/money. The rower didn’t ask for any extras though we did tip her as it is really hard work. Overall nice views from a small boat, but better to see it from a higher vantage point for grasp the extent of the landscape. Bring along a drone if you’re coming here !

reviews.author: phaikkhee
reviews.title: A peaceful place
reviews.content: I like the peaceful and quite environment. The scenery is so nice. It is suitable for the family trip.

reviews.author: Ai Lin P
reviews.title: Mesmerising UNESCO World Heritage Site
reviews.content: Trang An was one of our last stops in Vietnam and it was really the icing on top of an already amazing trip!We were mesmerized throughout our 2 hour boat tour over the sparkling emerald waters, under towering limestone cliffs covered in lush rainforests.Our children loved rowing through the narrow grottoes and then discovering ancient temples and pagodas in the middle of all that natural beauty. Our photos really do not do justice to this breaktaking destination. Make the trip and soak it all in!

reviews.author: Enrico V
reviews.title: Amazing Nature
reviews.content: Be there early to avoid to many other turists. We took the 3h tour and we wanted to see more. No one spoke english but lucky us we had read alot about this place before going there wich made it even more exiting to experience! Strongly recommend this to anyone no matter your age this is a world heritage site that few get to see in their lifetime so go for it and have a great day and please respect that no flash is allowed when taking pictures and NO LITTERING! Throw your trash in the bins. Thank you

reviews.author: Gaetan R
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL, PEACEFUL SURROUNDS
reviews.content: A definite must do when in Tam Coc or Ninh Binh.Thankfully we chose a good time for this attraction. We hopped straight on the boat with life vest on. Our navigator/pilot, a tiny Vietnamese lady, did a phenomenal job rowing with four people plus her on board. She was amazing. The journey takes approx. 2 hours of which the boat negotiates 8 fabulous grottoes. The roof is just above our heads, some of them lower meaning that we had to brace to avoid them. The scenery in and out of the grottoes is spectacular. Have your camera ready. There is a midway stop where you can visit a beautiful temple. Cold beverages are available for purchase too. The trip is well worth doing. It also keeps people in a job. We all gave her a tip and she was wrapped. Oh! take a good torch for the dark grottoes and umbrellas are a godsend in the sun. Have fun.... 👍

reviews.author: native-travels
reviews.title: Serene
reviews.content: This river tour has a similar feel to Ha Long Bay minus the pricing, tipping, pollution, noise, etc. This is definitely a must-do if you are in the area. It was incredible.

reviews.author: Shinta A
reviews.title: A must on the list while visit Vietnam
reviews.content: Actually this place is so great, perfect, limestone everywhere, when i visit the lotus was blooming. The rower lady was so nice and sweet, they dont push us to give they money. No scam at all. All you need to prepare is just water and sunblock.

reviews.author: Nemo N
reviews.title: Well worth to visit in May or June
reviews.content: I am very confused what if Trang An grottoes is too hot for my summer vacation but it makes me surprise with its beauty and so cool during the whole boat trip, maybe more than 4 hours, it is really worth to spend time. We have a wonderful trip through totally 9 caves in this complex landscape and the most important things is that the beautiful river with emerald water imposing the limestone mountain, make it a perfect summer getaway. The weather is rather cool and fresh for relax.

reviews.author: CBarahona
reviews.title: Just Wow
reviews.content: This was probably one of the highlights of our Vietnam trip. We choose Trip #1, which gives you more caves, so you start out getting on little row boats in groups of 4 + the lady whos rowing, you slowly make your way to the first cave and it is absolutely amazing for starters how these ladies can make their way their such small channels without a problem and once you come out the other side it is just absolutely breathtaking. You are surrounded by lush green untouched mountains and just have this feeling of amazement all the way through.

reviews.author: Derby
reviews.title: Quite crowded, but beautiful scenery
reviews.content: The Trang An Grottoes are excellent in case you like caves - you're going through a lot of them, nevertheless the scenery is not as stunning as Tam Coc and it's a really man made feel to it. At three hours it is a little long too, especially if it's a sunny day. Take an umbrella to shield as a result of sunlight in case it's. Additionally, we got there fairly early and yet it was full of visitors, so much therefore the caves had been visitors jammed at different points and we'd to tediously wait to get through them. I will select Tam Coc over Trang An in case you'd to create a choice between the 2.

reviews.author: Blackwater190
reviews.title: Amazing journey through Limestone Features
reviews.content: This is a slow paddle up a lazy river through amazing limestone formations and through three Grottos with barely enough head room.  The rowers, mostly women, operate the paddles with their feet.  I studied them closely but still can not work out how they keep their feet on the oars, either bare foot or with socks.This is a very pleasant experience and at the time of year that we went it was very peaceful.  Judging by the number of empty boats up against the shore I would say it  could be hectic in peak season.

reviews.author: Eden J
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape
reviews.content: Had amazing 3-hour boat trip to this dreamlike complex. The boat take us to different narrow caves, be careful with your head. We join to row the boat, say "xin chao" to smiling Vietnamese. Well worth!

reviews.author: ipsimishra
reviews.title: Mesmerizing natural beauty
reviews.content: It's a beautiful place. Lot of hills and caves inside river. There are row boats driven by ladies. You need to buy ticket and around 4-5 people are send in one boat. The typical boat ride takes around 2.5 hours. There are 3-4 caves and boats can go inside those. Very unique experience.

reviews.author: sunn1g1rl
reviews.title: Dreamlike, stunning landscape - highly recommended
reviews.content: Recommend getting there before 10am, to avoid the crowds and the heat.  We went early on a weekday and were able to enjoy the surreal landscapes without too many other boats spoiling the peace. It really is a stunning landscape, beautiful azure water, butterflies and birds flitting beside you and amazing limestone rock formations.  It's not called the Inland Halong Bay for nothing.We did tour #2 and thoroughly enjoyed it.  We had wanted to do #3 but as we were only two people would have had to wait until more people turned up to fill up the boat (min. 4 required).  It gets hot so make sure you take plenty of sunscreen and a hat.  We took drinks but there was a shop at one of the stops where we could have bought water and snacks.

reviews.author: Kellia A
reviews.title: Beautiful nature
reviews.content: The Trang An Grottoes are the sensible option in case you like caves - I underwent a lot of them, nevertheless the scenery is not as crowded as Tam Coc. The scenery was stunning: azure water, marvelous grottoes, beautiful mountains,.. The entire place was very peaceful, so the splendor was breathtaking. The sandstone hills along how are just astounding.

reviews.author: axelrod10
reviews.title: Stunning boat trip though the karst formations
reviews.content: This boat trip is one of our highlights in Vietnam. We were told to avoid the weekends because then there are many local people visiting. There are some stairs leading to a valley with a swamp like atmosphere.

reviews.author: Carson R
reviews.title: Thanks for the guide
reviews.content: We selected the grottoes within Trang A, Ninh Binh as a single part of my throughout trip to Vietnam. It was truly well worth visiting the place. We had taken a relaying boat journey through the scenery for two hours. It was truly gorgeous all around. The grottoes were colorful and warm with electric lighting, but the cautious with your head as it's fairly small at points. Because of the great driver as well as the guide, we'd very fun time within Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: TheBlackleys
reviews.title: Lovely experience
reviews.content: We went there about 8.30am and didn't have to queue.  We shared our boat with a young vietnamese couple.  We all helped rowing and the trip took about 2.5 hrs.  We did Tour 1 as not intested in Kong Island and it was great as a bit quieter than the other tours.  The caves were lovely as was the scenery and our lady rower was very sweet and smiley.  We did Tam Coc the day before as we heard it was quieter but really there was no difference and I would recommend this boat ride if you are only going to do one.

reviews.author: RobMCCA
reviews.title: Amazing boat ride
reviews.content: Beautiful natural site with a lot of caves, mountains and river. The boat tour goes through nine caves, some of them being several meters long and very narrow. Watch your head! The paddler lady worked very hard but was also very smiley (did not speak English at all though). No vendors a this location.

reviews.author: psychestation
reviews.title: Don't miss this natural wonder; even if you may have been to Halong Bay...
reviews.content: Using Hanoi as a base, there is actually alot to see around Ninh Binh. The Trang An Grottoes is not to be missed, pictures simply don't do it justice.Best to visit NOT during the wet season, or risk caught by strong winds and heavy downpour on a tiny wooden boat...one may help with the peddling to help the local ladies whom will be ferrying the passengers all the day....

reviews.author: dags111
reviews.title: Beautiful natural area
reviews.content: reportedly a quieter more natural and less touristy option than Tam Coc and with less sales pressure from boat people. It was quiet the day we were there, but going by the number of boats lined up it must get busy sometimes. We did the 3hr 9cave trip. Scenery was beautiful and peaceful and the stops were interesting

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Boat Trip and day tour
reviews.content: The Trang An area reminds one of Halong Bay with its Limestone karsts and emerald green water. The water was so warm! The grottoes are low and we had to duck our heads down in the boat numerous times. Its was a a beautiful 2 hour relaxing boat ride seeing the sights. Its an excellent choice for a day trip from Hanoi!

reviews.author: Naturetravel
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Beautiful scenery with boat ride. We go through the caves on boat n to another paradise. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Eilenesheffield
reviews.title: Relax
reviews.content: We'd the opportunity to go to Trang An Grottoes. The river was relaxed, the cliffsides were stunning, and the caves had been simply incredible to float through (even in case several were male made). We'd a really cute lady rowing the boat of ours and also she labored her butt off, therefore we grabbed the extra oars and also helped her row which made the journey more pleasant. I'd reccommend Trang An.

reviews.author: robyn d
reviews.title: Most beautiful place I have ever seen
reviews.content: Wonderful. The lady didn't ask us for a tip so we tipped her. Tranquil beautiful paradise.We went later.in the day on a week day in Low season, was nice and quiet!

reviews.author: Mayank S
reviews.title: Silent place but need tie to wait
reviews.content: As I think Every beautiful place must need to wait this also same so beautiful but having less boat so have to wait a long for that but when on sailing you feel like very silent lake and you are selling on that. can see caves all

reviews.author: SirGaw
reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.content: There are at least 4 boat trips that can be done in and around the Tam Coc area. All are very beautiful and relaxing and mostly the only sound you hear is the slap of oars against water - and the big surprise is that nearly all the rowers row with their feet. After a bit of thinking about that, I concede feet win over hands. Feet (legs) are much stronger than arms and it does free up the arms for other more important tasks - holding umbrella, talking on mobile (cell) phone, eating lunch to name a few.We were taken to the Trang An Grottos as part of a tour in and around Tam Coc and having done the Tam Coc boat trip, I can honestly say the Trang An trip is better, much better. There are 7 caves that are transversed by boat and we took the 2 and a half hour option with about 25 minutes stop at a spectacular pagoda - a good way to ease the backside from all the sitting in a low seat.The Trang An grotto people run a tight ship, so to speak, and it is 4 westerners, or 6 Vietnamese per boat - we're bigger than they are LOL. We were teamed up with a young French couple who live and work in Cambodia - and they had a fascinating tale to tell. After we were teamed up, there was no time for pleasantries and we were hassled aboard the boat. We noticed each of the rowers was in uniform with a traditional 'Coolie Hat' on top. Soon after the journey began, we noticed a bride and groom using the boat and amazing UNESCO heritage listed scenery as a backdrop for their wedding photos (see image) - such a stunning and totally different photo opportunity.Almost every few metres or so was another photo opportunity as we gawked at just what Mother Nature had dished up. We heard the local authorities has removed all the rice paddy fields in favour of a pristine scene. There's more money to be had for far more people by farming tourists over rice.Strongly suggest hat, sunscreen, water, maybe a snack and a blow up cushion to ease the backside from all the sitting in almost a crouched position. A great experience.

reviews.author: jamieontour92
reviews.title: Too busy
reviews.content: This place is full , full, full of Chinese tourists on massive busses and far to busy to enjoy nicely, go to the other tam cox boat trip instead we did both the other one was better .. just for reference we did tour 3 that includes the King Kong move set... but it’s just a bad copy of the move set and not even the real film set ... to to to touristy.. not really recommend

reviews.author: Am B
reviews.title: Trang an boat trip
reviews.content: Trang an is a beautiful big lake set amongst caves and small islands. You enter the park and pay for a ticket, you can do a two hour or three hour boat trip. The two hour trip does not include the Kong caves. A rower sits at the back and paddles you through the lake and through various caves. It was super hot during the day, so go early or later in the afternoon. Unfortunately the trip was way to long at 3 hours to keep me entertained. The rower, who was a middle aged women, spoke no English, which was a shame, not to get some history or information during the ride. I did not enjoy this trip, as it was super hot, and my bum went numb for sitting for 3 hours. Although you do get 3 stops along the way, where you can take a short walk or rest. You may like it if you like boat rides, but maybe do the two hour one.

reviews.author: Lilian K
reviews.title: Better do the Tam Coc boat tour
reviews.content: When we arrived there were no other tourists there and at least 20 rowers waiting to go. However, you have got to wait until you are with 4 people in total, otherwise they refuse to let you go. Eventually we got on with another couple. We were forced to wear the life jackets the entire time, while the water is literally impossible to drown in. The rower didnt speak a word of English and communicated badly on where he would pick us up from the King Kong Island (you walk across the island). It was too hot and after 2,5 hours we were really done with it. When we got of the rower also shouted MONEY MONEY at us. We didnt give him anything. I would advise to do the one in Tam Coc. Our rower was really nice and spoke some English. Its only 1,5 hours and much nicer. You dont have to go with other people on the boat. They also row with their feet here, which is nice for photos and you also dont have to wear the life jacket. Dont buy anything from “the floating market” here however. Thats a scam.

reviews.author: florisvdb
reviews.title: Great scenery!
reviews.content: Had a wonderful day on route 2! The nature is amazing and the woman peddling the boat was very friendly and didn’t ask for a tip when the activity ended like it’s commonly done at tam coc.

reviews.author: KNewms
reviews.title: Amazing scenery!
reviews.content: We debated to go here or Tam Coc and we are so happy we choose this boat tour. We did route 2, 4 caves and 3 temples. We went at 11:30am and walked straight onto a boat, no queues. We were so lucky as there was no one at the first temple we had the entire place to ourselves! It costs 200.000 each and we weren't asked for a tip. Definitely wear sunscreen, take a hat and a sun umbrella if you have one because it is hot!! There are places you can buy water at along the way if you don't take any with you. My favourite experience in Vietnam so far!

reviews.author: Young
reviews.title: Don't miss it!!
reviews.content: I will show Trang An Grorros asset: scenery that is stunning, the people that are beautiful, tranquil, relaxing, great picture opportunities, culturally fascinating, A necessity on a person's itinerary.

reviews.author: Victoria B
reviews.title: Double - Check entry for the boat tour on google maps
reviews.content: I tried to navigate here using tripadvisor which led me to Ninh Bình City...I used google maps instead and it brought me to the entrance. So double check the maps before heading off. Otherwise spectacular, can recommend, I took route1

reviews.author: Priya
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.content: The most beautiful place in north vietnam. We booked it through our tour agent. It is worth a visit. We had a boat ride for almost an hour or more that we didnt see the time but enjoying the ride and beauty.

reviews.author: BritinEgypt10
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.content: A must go to place if you are in the area, we had a fabulous day, get there a little earlier to miss the bigger crowds that arrive on group tours from the bigger cities

reviews.author: keiryn g
reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.content: Came here on first day, not to expensive if you go without tour. Buy your drinks before you go I  and take an umbrella and lots of sun cream if hot and water proofs if raining as you will be out there for while.

reviews.author: Kirsty C
reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.content: We took the Tran Temple route which was fabulous! The first Cave was probably the best one though.The scenery looks like a lost world. I absolutely loved this tour. We had no other boats around us either which made it great!I had booked this via Vic Travel, in conjuction with other activities and can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: gustav265
reviews.title: A trip worth every dong
reviews.content: This is an amazing trip where you get to see the incredible scienic landscapes of Trang An. The price of 200k is fair for what you get and I personally also did not mind giving a little tip (usually around 30k) for our rower who did some hard work navigating us through the tight caves with skill. For the landscape and the caves it's five stars. Only the "temples" were quite dissappointing.

reviews.author: Casey Rafferty
reviews.title: A Most Pleasant Surprise
reviews.content: Our visit to Trang An was such a pleasant surprise.. having been pretty disappointed with Halong Bay on our last trip (the usual, too many people, rubbish and oil in the water, constantly pushed to buy or tip), we were a little trepidatious. In addition, the reviews that spoke of myriad concrete factories nearby had concocted a certain image in my head. But one of our party dedicated herself to reading and then re-reading as many reviews as she could, and we decided to make our way down from Hanoi. We choose Trang An over Tam Coc and it was absolutely the right choice. Just stunning, not too many boats on the water, and no scams or pushing. Beautiful scenery. Yes, there are concrete factories in and around Ninh Binh, and it's hard not to be affected and saddened by this, but Trang An was an oasis, clean and untainted. Highly recommended. We did route 3, as a few of us have slightly dodgy backs and the boats are pretty pint-sized. The only reason I couldn't give our experience the fifth star it deserved was some due to the noisy patrons in the boat behind us, who had no regard for our experience or the beautiful environment we were all so lucky to be enjoying (smoking whilst in caves and throwing cigarette butts in the water). But do visit before it becomes too much like Halong Bay.

reviews.author: juned baig
reviews.title: Boat Ride under the narrow caves mountains
reviews.content: Awesome , simply thrilling , boat riders are too skilful. must visit place . missing this place is a crime

reviews.author: BibiDub
reviews.title: Great scenery don't miss it
reviews.content: We visited here with a guide on a Sunday and it was extremely busy. Our guide bought our ticket very quickly and arranged for a private boat which was great as many had 6-8 people on and are just rowed by one person. The tour was excellent and one of our favourite trips of the holiday. We skipped the King Kong bit as it was very crowded but the rest was spectacular so don't feel we missed out. You are rowed through lovely mountains and through long low caves where you come out into quiet valleys and more great scenery. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: MARK S
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: Rowed by a local women (we helped a little with our paddles) on a small boat through waterways and caves. Regular stops at pagodas and the set of Kong- Skull Island. Well worth doing!

reviews.author: Patrizia G
reviews.title: Beware of Bribes
reviews.content: The scenery is superb, worth a 5, but I was very upset because I took the trouble to move from Tan Coc by taxi in order to see the King Kong film set,  which is on this tour and not on the Tan Coc one. At the box office they guaranteed we would go there,  but the woman who was paddling asked me to write the survey before we arrived at the end of the tour and then refused to bring us there. My fault to trust her.  Little further suggestion: When you get down of the boat in some places it is quite slippery,  so beware of where you put foot. I went straight into the river and my daughter will laugh for the rest of her life at the word "river". I wish I protected my phone with a waterproof cover.

reviews.author: RaktimRay
reviews.title: A must do in Vietnam
reviews.content: This boat ride in Ninh Bin is a must on any travelers itinerary for Vietnam. Just like you hear of halong bay being the star attraction of this country well this boat ride is called the Halong bay on land and with its winding adventures through caves interspersed by hills all around. The ticketing process is far more organised than Tam Coc where they give you actual tickets and there are gantries through which you need to pass. If you have time sit around inside the Pagoda before you head out to the water to catch a show on the history of the surroundings. Generally if you are a group of three or four you can have your own boat but depends on the crowd at that time. Boat capacity is usually around 6-8 excluding the guide. This boat ride is quite long and can take nearly two hours passing inside eleven caves. So go with plenty of time in hand. Carry water and some snacks with you and ofcourse dont forget your camera. It helps if you have a waterproof casing. The caves might have a very low ceiling so keep your head down. Some of them may be pretty long and therefore for people with claustrophobia this may not be the best of experiences. Keep your eyes open for birds and fishes. There are plenty of exotic fauna around. Temples and pagodas dot the cliff walls along the river. depending on your route they boatman may even stop at one of them and give you the opportunity to walk around. The last boat leaves the dock at around 430 in the afternoon so make sure you go well before. And needless to say, visit the bathroom before you start. Keep change handy if you want to tip your guide. They dont ask for it but its a good gesture especially because they dont force you. This is one of those rides which you should definitely put down as a day trip from Hanoi. There are plenty of tour agencies and private car hires which can help you with this itinerary but make sure you pack this one in.

reviews.author: llgzeell
reviews.title: Worth a visit!
reviews.content: 3 hour boat ride to experience caves, limestone mountains, and temples. Very scenic, you'll get great photos and drone footage.

reviews.author: valueformoney71
reviews.title: Worth a visit - watch your head
reviews.content: Beautiful grottoes you visit via boat trip. Depending on the water level, some might not be accessible. You also visit, depending on which tour you take (3 to choose from), 3 pagodas. Some of them require quite a walk with many many stairs to visit. I recommend the tour with 9 grottoes and 3 pagodas. Unless you are short of time (3 caves, 3 pagodas) or movie aficionado (there^s a tour with the place where they filmed King Kong I don't know wihich part). Some of the ladies who row the boats might try to shorten the tour, so watch out for this. All in all, even if you can't compare, I liked these grottoes more thanTam Coc.

reviews.author: kevlar740
reviews.title: Amazing scenery
reviews.content: Spectacular scenery. The boat ride through the caves was fun, the kid enjoyed helping to row.The seats became uncomfortable after 2 hours! We went in the middle of the day and had a relaxed quiet trip. We returned at about 15:00 and it seemed much busier and noisier.

reviews.author: Toastiehb
reviews.title: Mesmerising Boat Ride
reviews.content: One of the most beautiful boat rides in our life. It's completely stunningly beautiful. Highly recommended. Try to choose a time less busy. we went around 5pm it was pretty good. You can tip the person riding the boat but not mandatory. You buy the ticket from the ticket office where the boats line up.

reviews.author: GalkaSh
reviews.title: Interesting caves and lovely sights
reviews.content: We went to a Trang An boat trip after a boat trip in Tam Coc and enjoyed it as much if not more. As we were getting on the boat things got a bit scary as the boat was swinging from side to side due to lots of people getting on their boats at the same time and our boat got a little water inside it. As we sat down and settled in the boat, it went smoothly. The lady rowing the boat was really sweet. We were lucky to have a nice and quiet Korean couple together with us in the boat. We chose Route 1 which is the longest and includes 9 caves. Passing through the caves was a lot of fun. The views are lovely.There was one thing which we thought was not really good - at the second stop our rower told us we had 10 minutes, and there is a long staircase which I don't think is possible to climb in 10 minutes. We didn't want to climb the stairs, but for someone who wanted it, it wouldn't be nice to have such a short limit of time.I believe your experience depends a lot on who you share your boat with and on how the rower behaves. We were lucky with both. Also, the rower didn't ask us for tips. She also gave us a questionnaire in English to complete after the trip which I think is a nice effort to improve service on this route.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: Superb, relaxing boat trip with a friendly boatman.
reviews.content: We were advised by the staff at our accommodation that this is the best boat trip in the area & we weren't disappointed. This is a really well run operation. We were able to park our bikes across the road from the terminal for a small fee. There are 3 routes to choose from. Maps of each route are shown at the entrance. The trips range from around 2 - 4 hours in duration. Prices are fixed at 200,000 VND per adult regardless of the chosen route which is good for tourists and the operators. Life jackets are provided.We chose route 2 which took around 2.5 hours, passed through 4 caves and visited several temples. My wife & I shared our boat with 2 Vietnamese tourists who were travelling as part of a larger group. Our boatman spoke very little English, likewise the tourists. But they were warm, friendly & keen to communicate. We got by just fine with a few words and a bit of sign language.You can assist with the paddling if you like. Probably best to let the boatman navigate the caves though as it's a tight fit and you'll probably be busy taking photos or movies anyway.This is a magic place. Every time you pop out of a cave another temple seems to appear. The scenery is fantastic too.The boat stops off along the way allowing you to walk around the various temples, buy some food & drink if you need it, and go to the toilet.Just be aware that there is no shelter on the boats so depending on the weather take a hat and sunscreen if it’s sunny and a raincoat if it’s wet.

reviews.author: jco631
reviews.title: Just amazing!
reviews.content: This boat trip is amazing! Even if there is a lot of people near to the boat station, you can be pretty alone on the water during all of it! 'First, let the big group start and wait for several minutes before going. Second, chose routes number 1! You will avoid the King Kong island which is pointless and you will also avoid most of the people! A lot of Vietnamese take routes number 2 and 3 so there is almost nobody on routes number 1.Moreover, i don't know if we were lucky but our driver was perfect, very nice, and everything went perfectly. The trip last 2h45 because we did not stay long on the several stops we made.

reviews.author: Flying Dutchman
reviews.title: Not like a movie set, actually a movie set
reviews.content: Trang An is a place where Kong: Skull Island movies were made. The place is with one word "breathtaking". You arrive to the place where you get on the small boats (4 people) and you can choose between 3 routes from shortest to the longest (don't worry same price). Once you are on the boat you should wear life jackets, but don't worry there is no wave or a danger for drowning, it is for precautions. And during your journey you see go through the caves, stop by temples and of course this great scenery. I would also kindly ask you to help the ladies at rows as they are doing a difficult job (though they do almost perfect). The place is way less crowded than Tam Coc. We were there on Monday and that may be the best day to avoid crowds. After the ride you can have a lunch in the restaurant close to the entrance.

reviews.author: Rosalie
reviews.title: Beautiful experience!
reviews.content: One of very beautiful places you must come once if coming Vietnam. 2 hours on boat is highly recommended. Hope this can remain this natural beauty much longer.

reviews.author: museummummy
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Really loved our to Trang An. The children were able to help paddle which really made their visit special. Beautiful scenery and if you go early in the morning you miss the crowds.

reviews.author: BKK Wanderer
reviews.title: A must visit for Vietnam
reviews.content: Highly recommend everyone, it's very beautiful 2 hour boat ride. It goes through caves and the landscape are truly mesmerising. It cost 200,000 Dong per person, everything is clear and easy.

reviews.author: JaimeW
reviews.title: Beautiful & Serene
reviews.content: We took Route 3 boat ride. Took us nearly 3 hours as we stopped by the temples & where King Kong Skull Island was filmed.The caves were interesting and the kids enjoyed. The novelty of being able to row the boat wore off after 15 mins but we all took turns to help our row lady.

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Picturesque tour of an iconic landscape
reviews.content: The Trang An Grottoes were recommended by the customer service manager at our hotel (Golden Sun Suites and Hotel), who is from Ninh Binh. I had no idea about this place, but merely asked for a destination for a 2 to 3 hour train ride and was told of this landmark. The hotel bought out tickets and arranged for a taxi. I do recommend the train, it's a 2 hour ride through beautiful Vietnamese country side.Firstly, it's hot and sunny with barely any shade save the short parts in the caves. Bring sunscreen, a large hat or an umbrella. We hired a driver who also ownd a restaurant by the train station. It's called Dong Minh and they make delicious food, all run by the family. They were very cordial and pleasant.Once at Trang An, you will need to buy a ticket. They had a couple routes at the time, one through the set of Kong and the original without the set and more caves. I wanted the one with more caves but the language barrier got me on the other. Worth it regardless. Note they are very proud filming was done there.You grab your ticket and head to the docks. The boats are mostly rowed by middle aged women. Women with more strength and stamina than I could muster probably any time in my life. I was really impressed because these trips last around 2 hours and it's very hot.Prepare yourself for an amazing ride through picturesque hills, caves and water ways. I was in awe the entire time. It was so beautiful.Toward the end we stopped by the set used for Kong. I understood why a Hollywood Studio would use this location. They have parts of a small village there as well as the boat made from a plane in the movie. They also filmed in Halong Bay.You will also stop in a small area with a temple where you can also buy refreshments. At the end we ate at the on site restaurant which served decent food. Don't forget to tip the strong amazing boat rower. These people work hard and are very pleasant.Make a day of it and visit this gorgeous place.

reviews.author: Kamal C
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: We took a day trip from Hanoi. We first visited two temples in Hoa Lu and then went to Trang An for the 2h boat ride.I recommend the boat ride. You can choose between 3 itineraries. We took the route 2 wich had few grottoes and 2 temples and lasted about 2 hours. The tour is very well organized. You purchase a ticket and then go to the docks were the first boat in line takes you. They provide clean life jackets. For the whole length you sit without a back support and when you are not used to it gets very tiring. The temples visits are a great relief to stretch. The temples have clean bathrooms but you need to pay 2000VND so be sure to carry some change. The rowers are mostly old woman and they manoeuver their boats expertly in the caves. After an hour they ask you to help row. We did not mind , we saw other boats were people were not paddling . We started our toyr around 1 pm and did not encounter anyone trying to sell anything. The water is clean but we saw some tourists throwing plastic bags in the river. The boat people stopped at tge place were the movie skull island was shot. The huts from the movie set are still there. Our rower did not ask for a tip but we felt it was the right think to do given the time she spent rowing. The site management asks for the customer' s feedback and suggestion with a short survey. I do believe they want to improve tourists' experience.

reviews.author: lostandfoundatsea
reviews.title: Better than the Tam Coc ride - you only need to do one
reviews.content: I picked option 3 of the 3 ride options. It took us to the best 3 caves and to where Skull Island was filmed for what that's worth to you. This is something a lot of Vietnamese locals do for their holiday time so we were in the midst of almost all locals and they were not very polite! They stared and said a lot of trash without realizing I spoke the language so just be aware that other (local) guests may not be friendly to Western travelers. However, the woman who rowed our boat was extremely sweet and we tipped her $20 US. The rowers also seem to appreciate help with rowing so keep that in mind. I loved this tour and would recommend it as a highlight when visiting Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Rachel D
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: The scenery on this tour is amazing! I enjoyed it more than anything I did in Ha Long Bay. We biked here from Mua Caves which took less than 30 mins (5km).
