We went late Feb and even though the rice fields below were several inches high they did not look emerald green in colour from up there.  More of a patchy green with muddy water.  Those steps are steep, so mind out coming down and I don't know if I would have liked to do it if it were raining.

reviews.author: Bryanvdk1
reviews.title: Amazing views, beware of parking scams!
reviews.content: Definitely worth a visit, especially in the morning when there are very few people on the steps. Treacherous but beautiful! Beware of parking scams.. the lady at the first lot on the road will stand in front of you and blow a whistle to get you to park at her place, and she charges twice as much, while having a big sign blocking the cheaper parking further down. Don't pay more than 5000d and you should bargain down further.

reviews.author: James H
reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.content: Well worth the climb to see this view.  Would love to go back and see it again when the rice is yellow.  When we went there were not too many people.  That was first thing in the morning.  I would imagine once the day trippers arrive from Hanoi it's a different story though.I am sure they let the air out of my back tyre in the parking closest to the entry though.  Miraculously there was someone there with a pump and I had no issues afterwards.  20.000 dong to help me out and pump up the tyre.  Why oh why are the Vietnamese like this ?

reviews.author: Etienne
reviews.title: Very nice point of view
reviews.content: It definitely worth a visit there. There is quite some stairs to climb but once on top the view is amazing.

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.title: Good looking Tamcoc, Halong Bay on land View
reviews.content: Good looking Tamcoc, Halong Bay on land View, from hoalu eco homestay 5,5km good visit by bike, motorbike

reviews.author: Michał W
reviews.title: View worth climbing
reviews.content: Beutiful view from the top. Entrance fee is 100,000 dongs per person, you can go there from Tam Coc by bike or scooter. 500 steps to reach the top.

reviews.author: Johannes R
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.content: It’s totally worth it climbing up the stairs to the two tops. Amazing view from up there! Many parking lots, don’t stop at the beginning of the road although the people are very nice. Park in front of the eco lodge.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Well worth the effort for the views at the top!
reviews.content: You can’t go to Tam Coc without going up Hang Mua for the sheer pleasure of the views from the top. We took it gradually to climb the 500 steps to the temple and dragon which gave a great view of the other pagoda which is slightly lower. Entrance as 100,000dong and well worth it.

reviews.author: Milka_Taniea
reviews.title: Beautiful view
reviews.content: Views from the top of this mountain cave was very beautiful. What a pity because not enough time to enjoyed it, we do a day trip, including visit Hoa Lu & Tam Coc as well!

reviews.author: Roxanne L
reviews.title: 500 steps to the top. Great view
reviews.content: There were lanterns that decorated the bottom creating a scenic view. The lush padi fiels were just across. Lots of places for photo taking. The parking area for scooters outside is quite a rip off. I guess locals r charged at 5000 dong. While visitors at 10,000. Climbing up the 500 steps would  start off relatively easy. The steps and narrorer n steeper at the top. Suggest walking sticks if not used to narrow steps.There r a few restaurants and a lodge in this area as well. Entrace fee is 100,000 per pax. Took us appox 2hr to walk around.

reviews.author: Maja135
reviews.title: Worth the climb
reviews.content: The view is definately worth the climb even on cloudy days.But be aware of the scams for parking of motorbikes, it goes anywhere from 5.000 to 20.000. The guys can also be very rude! Since you pay an entrance fee of 100.000 the parking could easily be included and make the experience more pleasant!

reviews.author: Jason Reeve
reviews.title: Worth the climb!
reviews.content: Mua Cave is a lookout which sits atop a mountain overlooking Tam Coc - a brisk 500 stairs to climb to reach the top. The views were pretty fantastic but the smog had a big impact and drained all colour from the landscape. At the top there is a dragon statue that stretches out across the rock - very cool but such a shame to see people climbing all over it and obvious damage already present from previous visitors.

reviews.author: Willaim S
reviews.title: Wow what a view.
reviews.content: The view from the top is fantastic, but if its summer you should do the assent in the morning or late afternoon. (Unless you like sweating out of your eye balls for 500 steps in the blazing sun.) You will be rewarded with a great view if you take the left fork near the top and a good but less impressive view if you go right. The choice is yours. If you have had 3 weetabix do both. Good luck and encourage others that are near the summit on your decent.

reviews.author: Caryn Jen
reviews.title: A lot of things to See!
reviews.content: We actually parked our bike in one of the parking space before Hang Mua and had lunch in a bamboo hut before heading inside. We were tricked because they waved at us to park at their space. I didn't know that we could park for free inside Hang Mua.Ticket fee is VND100,000/pax.I borrowed toilet of a homestay at the entrance so it was clean. You pass by quite a few things to photograph on the way up. There's one dragon at the lower part of the mountain. The amount of stairs is doable just take some time to reach the top. I didn't see thrash all over the place as observed by the visitors in this thread. But I did observe a group of Vietnamese ladies taking a lot of pictures, it's annoying and inconsiderate (not that they care), How many pictures do you want to take before you are satisfied, chances are you look the same in all 100 shots, it's not like in one of the shot you suddenly look like Angelina Jolie? Let other people have a chance to take pictures also.At the top you can see the boat rides. The view of the surroundings from the top is nice but I wouldn't say it's impressive. The famous dragon we all looking forward to photograph is on some very sharp rocks and it's a very small space for you to step on. Took me a while to figure out to stand properly to get a selfie. I think you should check this place out, I think it's more worth seeing than Hoa Lu.

reviews.author: pink00flamingo
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: I stayed at the eco-lodge so I could go up early and avoid the crowds.  The views are amazing if the weather is good.  Take plenty of water and race to the top, just pace yourself as it can be hard going if its very sunny or very damp and slippery.

reviews.author: Cong
reviews.title: Great experience1
reviews.content: I and my friends have been there. Coming to the top of the mountain, you must cross all over 300 steps. Sounds like hard work but it's worth it! a must see in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Bob Payne
reviews.title: Great view, awful management. Shame.
reviews.content: We visited Mua Caves at 9am and it was heaving with tourists, mainly loud Vietnamese. I’d advise going for opening.The entry fee is 100k with free parking, don’t be scammed by the official looking men with whistles (overly used in south east Asia) attempting to charge 20k per bike. The climb is an easy 400 or so steps but bring water if you’re unfit. The steps are littered with rubbish (trash to the US) which is dissatisfactory considering the 100k entry fee. I’d expect some site management or at least some bin men but nothing. The summit provides great views but there are too many people in a small place. Ideally there would be a maximum people count to ensure safety the higher you go.  The toilets aren’t well maintained and smell horrendous. It could be amazing but for the overall condition and management. Shame.

reviews.author: Holly R
reviews.title: OK
reviews.content: We went for the climb and the view and did not stop at the caves. In the spirit of all honesty, I got half way up to the little store selling ice cream and cold drinks and didn't go all the way to the top. The first part of the climb was fine, but the second half the steps were narrower with less secure footing. I just didn't have a good feeling about it so stayed put while my friends completed the climb. It wasn't the climbing (really!) that deterred me. I was worried about losing my footing.  There are actually two different paths from the mid point that take you to two different vantage points. Our group went to the left, which according to our guide had the better views. The path to the right, looked daunting to me but many people were on it. On the other hand, if you walk to the side of the little store there are a few steps that bring you to the back side where there are a couple of tables and chairs with a beautiful view. I enjoyed sitting there and didn't feel like I missed anything amazing from up top. You can see the Tam Coc boating area from the top which I couldn't see from my perch. We passed a bride and groom on our way up who must have chosen this spot for wedding photos. Quite a climb in a wedding dress! I felt like this was like a lot of things in Vietnam --- built for tourism but not particularly well done. But it's good exercise (500 steps) if you skip the ice cream (which I didn't). But I wouldn't make a special effort to visit.

reviews.author: BriAnne V
reviews.title: Garbage everywhere
reviews.content: Garbage everywhere. It's so sad. They need more efforts to hire someone to fine ppl for littering. They charge 100 000 per person and then you pay to park your motorbike or bicycle. The views were nice but too much garbage to really enjoy.

reviews.author: Chai K
reviews.title: Lying dragon - spectacular view
reviews.content: There is a hotel at this area called “Mua Caves ecolodge”, worth to stay and you can walk to the lying dragon without paying the entrance fee at 100000 VND. The hotel is excellence, nice view, helpful staff. Don’t miss the view at the top of Lying Dragon. You have to climb up but you will not regret for your effort.

reviews.author: Manou
reviews.title: Beautiful but ugly
reviews.content: The view is so beautiful but the mess and garbage is so bad. Everywhere is garbage and flies on top of the rock. It looks like that they never clean up.

reviews.author: FYL003
reviews.title: Panoramic view
reviews.content: The climb to the top for the panoramic view was worth the effort. The steps near to the top were quite steep and the platform was not very large to accommodate the large crowd. We were there late in the afternoon and was able to catch the sunset. We did not linger in order to get down before the sky was completely dark. The view was beautiful but the place was not respected by some visitors. There were thrash all along the path.

reviews.author: youbloodytourist
reviews.title: A stunning view!
reviews.content: Probably one of my favourite places in the province. Even if the weather isn't amazing, the mist adds lots of atmosphere. Would definitely recommend getting on a scooter and visiting - it's only 15 minutes outside of Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Ricasman
reviews.title: Nice spot but artificial and crowded with tourists
reviews.content: Coming from Ha Giang Loop and after experiencing Ma Pi Ling Pass it is always hard to find something better. This place is just 1 hour from Hanoi, with easy access so many people come to see it. Good exercise to walk up the stairs but you are rewarded with excellent views. Unfortunately the silence that this place needs is corrupted but all the people.I did not go for the cave as I am not a great appreciator of them.Don t miss on the ground a passage, like a cave, that give us access to the fields on the other side

reviews.author: hong un
reviews.title: Amazing spot
reviews.content: Its one of the best places in tamcok i have ever seen. Entrance ticket were a bit expensive but  i had amazing view. Dont miss out this place while you are in tamcok

reviews.author: BethyB
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: Wouldn’t recommend the cave - it was v small & uneventful. Views from the top of the hill was very beautiful, but steep climb up. Also, you don’t need to stop at the first parking man who blows a whistle at you - this is not official.

reviews.author: Jan L
reviews.title: Good hike
reviews.content: One of the highlights in our Vietnam trip is hiking up to the Dragon and Pagoda at the Mua Cave. The way to the top was pleasant despite the heat. A lot of renovations and improvements around the area causing the place to be extra dusty and gravelly. Nothing we can’t handle. Twas fun. Great activity for the family with bigger children.

reviews.author: Kane
reviews.title: Exceptional views and great climb
reviews.content: We did this trip via bicycle from Tam Coc and took around 20 mins cycle on quiet roads. When you approach the entrance locals will try and get you to pay to park. DONT PAY ITS FREE after the entrance to the park. It was $100VND per adult for entry which was definitely worth it. Inside there are a couple of restaurants and shops incase you needed water top up. The climb took around 30 mins to the top with the dragon which you need to reach by going off path which is quite dangerous but fine if you are careful. There are 2 peaks which over look each other with the dragon being the highest. Lots of opportunities for pictures along the way up so take camera phone. I wouldn’t say you really need a paid tour here but if you are coming from a distance then it will be worth.

reviews.author: MLPF
reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.content: I have a fear of heights but the view was worth my fear.  Spectacular.  Both my children aged 9 and 10 made the trip up as well.

reviews.author: dianaskai
reviews.title: Must visit!
reviews.content: Warning: FREE BIKE PARKING BESIDE TICKET OFFICE! Ignore people yelling at you to park your bike far from the entrance.From afar the stairs look steep and high. But when you climb it, it feels fun and not high. It's totally worth the walk. Go to the left peak first to enjoy higher view, the river with boats from Tam Coc and then to the right peak to see the paddy field. In January, the farmers are still planting the paddy so its not the best time to take picture for your instagram. However if you just wanna enjoy the hills, the village, and the landscape then you must visit here!

reviews.author: BlueDolphin9
reviews.title: Gorgeous views from the top
reviews.content: We did not visit the caves but went to the top of the lying dragon mountain to see the gorgeous landscape. Fortunately, it did not rained on that day as it would be slippery and dangerous. There were no hand rails and at times it was steep but it was worth the effort in the end.

reviews.author: Thuha
reviews.title: The most beautiful destination in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: If you travel to Ninh Binh, you have to go to this place. This place is near from Hoalu center to Mua cave. It is about 5km. It is easy to find. There are high mountains. You have to grow up a lot of steps but it is deserved because you can see the hug rice fiel below, you can enjoy the beautiful views with great way to grow up and down, with a gorgeous valley, with peaceful river... You have to go this place.

reviews.author: sjamesd19
reviews.title: Amazing physical activity
reviews.content: This was the type of place that I love. Very cool, authentic, big, amazing view and physical activity.A must visit for someone who doesn't mind pushing themselves for a great experience.Climbing and exploring the two peaks go right up there with: climbing the Florence Duomo and bell tower -- climbing the leaning tower of Pisa -- climbing the Vatican dome -- reaching the heights of Cinque Terre villagesThis and Trang An made for an amazing day.

reviews.author: Shajona
reviews.title: Ning Binh 2 days 1 night
reviews.content: We explored the Tiger Caves and Mua Caves. It was raining so the ground was wet and slippery. Climbing up the Dragon trail was quite challenging despite the rain. For the not so seasoned climber, it was surprisingly quite manageable.  Fortunately the rain did not deter us or dampen our enthusiasm. The view at the top was spectacular. Nice place to go especially when weather condition is good.

reviews.author: CamTVoyage78
reviews.title: Amazing view of the countryside
reviews.content: The hike up of 500 steps is not easy for someone with physical disabilities. If you are afraid of heights than it would be intimidating but the view is worth it. The cave "mua" was nothing special as its very very small, it is more of a shrine for locals.

reviews.author: Danlouw
reviews.title: Breathtaking View
reviews.content: Definitely worth the climb, just remember to bring something cold with. You will regret doing it halfway through, but keep going. Its worth it. Note:  if you travel by scooter, don’t park where the ladies with whistles try to to pull you over. You can go through the gate and park right next to the ticket office

reviews.author: Song_Chuang
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: Mua cave is very well worth a visit. Climbing up to the top of this attraction was brilliant. Should do it with a local guide or book a package tour will be better!

reviews.author: Laurawaller1997
reviews.title: Great walk up!
reviews.content: This is a good walk and gives you a cool view of Ninh Binh area. Writing this review to let people know NOT to park their scooter and bike at the people along the street with whistles, go straight to the office and you can park there!!

reviews.author: Nachiketas B
reviews.title: Nice trek, good Views
reviews.content: A moderate trek. Decent views. Gets crowded since there's just one set of steps. Can be skipped if you don't have much time. Needs about 1.5 hours return.

reviews.author: Raveendra P
reviews.title: Visit to Mue Cave
reviews.content: Breathtaking view from top of this Mue Cave.There are two paths during hiking both views are good, however left hill view is very good, visit this during Sun set, you can see sun going down in the mountain.Must visit place.On the second hill, you can see beautiful paddy fields from top of the view.If you are Indian food fan then you can visit Aroma Indian restaurant,very good taste. It is just 5 km from Mue Cave.

reviews.author: mark
reviews.title: Beautiful and easy track
reviews.content: Beautiful scenery at the Top of the hill that overlooks the vicinity. Easy to get around by yourself. Probably the best attraction in after the Trang An grottoes. Suggest to go early (8/9am) to avoid the crowds.

reviews.author: Václav B
reviews.title: Nice panorama
reviews.content: This place is a bit hard to reach as you need to drive through small village full of curvy little streets but we made it.There are a lot of steps to the one of two peaks and the whole stairway is very nicely decorated.And the views from the top are amazing although there were crouds the time we arrived and made our way up. Not a must but nice when you have time.

reviews.author: Jolan6
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: This place is very beautiful, you have to climb some steps to reach the viewpoint but the view worths it ! The Enter Ticket costs 100 000 vnd, it’s a little bit expansive

reviews.author: llshan
reviews.title: Amazing view from the top
reviews.content: It took us about 20mins to climb all the staircase. The view on the top is amazing, which allows you to see  through the whole scenary of Trang An district. Before arriving at the Mua caves, you will see a lot of signboard stated "motorcycle/bicylce parking", DO NOT park there, even the locals might scream or whistle at you. All these parkings require parking fees. Go all the way straight untill you enter the gates and pass through the ticket office. The cave itself provide free parking. In fact, the free parking do not have any signboard but you will see a lot of cars or motorcycle parked there.            There are two peaks at the cave. When you climb up the staircase, you will reach a junction. Head to the left if you are rushing in time as the peak at the left is higher than the peak at the right. Also, if you want to see the dragon statues, it will be at the peak at the left.

reviews.author: Holiday-lah
reviews.title: Be prepared for the climb
reviews.content: The view from the top is spectacular. However, to get to the top, be prepared to climb about 500 steps.. some steep steps near the top. It’s one of the top attractions in Tam Coc. Do not miss.

reviews.author: Aussie lady
reviews.title: Great view - gets the heart pumping
reviews.content: About 400 steps to get the top, take a little water with you and take your time. Great exercise to work off all that food. Public toilets and cafe to grab food is there at the base.

reviews.author: William O
reviews.title: Great views spoiled by many reckless photographers
reviews.content: Very nice 360 degree views, especially during sunset. The climb is not the easiest when traveling with smaller kids as there are hardly any handrails and people just go which ever side they think is the easiest at that point. It gets really crowded at the top which spoils the experience of a sunset at such a beautiful place. People do everything for a nice picture, climbing over one another, standing on fences and well outside the ‘official’ viewing points. Bet this place ends up in the news over a ‘killfie’ in the near future.

reviews.author: Neri D
reviews.title: A must
reviews.content: Go there on sunset or sunrise. Very often is too foggy in the morning, so probably better for sunset. Just need to come earlier as it takes time to climb up and there are different sides of the 'mountain'. Very instagrammable:)

reviews.author: Pauxenia
reviews.title: Free parking!!!
reviews.content: Be aware: if you come by motorbike, there will be several locals trying to stop you on the way, showing you to park there. They will take a fee of 10.000vnd. Just drive all the way inside the gate where all the buses are, there’s a free parking to the left of the buses. The view is amazing from the top and cannot be missed!

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.title: Good workout!
reviews.content: Good and safe way up to the top. Steps are unexpectedly high! Last 100 steps I so are even higher I basically crawl myself up. 😹. Enjoyable climb with family

reviews.author: Reiko
reviews.title: Worth the hike!
reviews.content: Breathtaking views from the top of Hang Mua! Paranomic views of Ninh Binh, Trang An and Tam Coc...500 steps up to the peak according to our tour guide, people usually takes about an hour if they climb fast and 2 hours at slow pace. We made it up in about half an hour. There are steps to climb all the way so it’s pretty manageable. If you need a break, you can stop halfway for a coffee, there’s a small shop on the way up.

reviews.author: Gireedhar
reviews.title: Excellent view!!
reviews.content: Fantastic scenic view! You can see the whole trang na river from the top !!! Quite a bit of a claim but totally worth it 👍

reviews.author: aidan_luke95
reviews.title: Scammers. Don't pay for parking.
reviews.content: If you're riding a bicycle or moped, just keep driving straight til you get through the gate. There you can pay for entrance and park without paying extra. The locals will make this difficult. They are very aggressive scammers. They blow whistles, stand in the road - yelling at you to stop. Just keep going.As for the hike: views are good, even on a rainy/cloudy day. Not sure if it's worth 100,000VND or $4.30USD. Takes maybe 15 minutes to the top.

reviews.author: misochin
reviews.title: Dancing Caves
reviews.content: Our guide said this was the place the emperor would come and watch the beautiful dancers dance in front of the caves.  I don't think there were really 500 steps up though they were quite tall and far between.  It was not an easy hike up, and the way down required some effort.  The locals really made an effort to climb all the way up to take their bridal photos.  We saw a lovely couple up there, with their entourage and photographer.  The view was definitely worth it, and we went there on a sunny day and the view was breathtaking.  Our guide showed us the directions of Tam Coc and Trang An.  It was a good work out that day for all of us!

reviews.author: FarAway694437
reviews.title: Beautiful, but full of people
reviews.content: The view on top of the mountain is gorgeous. We arrived there at sunset, so the light and atmosphere were stunning. The steps are pretty rough, so I wouldn‘t recommend going there with flip flops or the like (although many tourists do so). If you arrive by motorbike watch for the prices of the parking lots. Some take more than the others. The only downside is that there are plenty of other people, but that‘s of course natural.

reviews.author: Wilks04
reviews.title: Brutal walk on a hot day BUT WORTH IT!
reviews.content: The “must see” Mua Caves are definitely worth the visit. Feels like a brutal climb to the top if you’ve been on holiday having too much food and beer like we have. Just kidding, but for reference the 10-15min walk to the top viewpoint is about the equivalent of 34 floors according to my partners iPhone. The iconic view is one that shouldn’t be missed. You can get some great photos of yourself and scenery from the top

reviews.author: jamieckh
reviews.title: Great scenery but expensive and super touristy
reviews.content: The entrance fee seemed to have increased a lot from the last time I researched on it. I think it's because of the touristy instagrammable decorations (e.g. swings, bamboo huts...) that adorned the path towards the foot of the Mua peak. I would have preferred it if they had 2 different entrance ticket instead, so that people who are only interested in the Mua Peak can pay lesser for this attraction.Not sure if it's a good idea to specially come for the sunset. It was packed with tourists 1hr before sunset time and we couldn't locate a good spot for ourselves as the whole place had probably 100+ people crowding at the top already. Many heads will be in your photos and then you would have to climb down in the dark which is super dangerous and scary. Maybe come for the sunrise or just at normal timings; attractions always lose points for me when it's crowded with people because one just can't enjoy the scenery in peace.

reviews.author: Russell B
reviews.title: Dancing Cave
reviews.content: 500 step - you will get a good view from hereTrash need to take care on the way & on the top. Rubbish everywhere

reviews.author: Cami.grd
reviews.title: Nice walk and view
reviews.content: You have to climb about 400 stairs to see the view, but it’s worth it. Very original and nice place. Be carefully when you arrive by bike or scooter, people will ask you to stop and pay the parking. Continue to the end of the road and DO NOT PAY THE PARKING IT IS FREE INSIDE!!

reviews.author: nmr86
reviews.title: Best viewpoint, don't miss it! And don't pay for parking!
reviews.content: Quite a climb, but the view at the top is totally worth it! Go in the early morning or late afternoon because the heat is killing. Beware of scammers at the entrance, they try to make you pay for parking but when you buy an entrance ticket parking is FREE inside.

reviews.author: landt
reviews.title: Stunning view!!
reviews.content: Stunning view from the top over Ninh Binh, beautiful sunset. I didn't go there when the rice fields turn yellow, but would definitely come back for that.

reviews.title: Beautiful :)
reviews.content: We fell for the parking scam... booooo!!! Should have read this magical thread first! As said previously, please don’t fall for the first parking guy. Hot headed guy, we paid 10,000 dong but he asked for 20 at first. I think the whistle threw me off and didn’t even question it - “oh this is where I go I guess!” Definitely a damper on the first part but the hike itself is great, I really did love the views and I love hiking so all in all it was great :) you live and you learn

reviews.author: Macey G
reviews.title: Do in the morning
reviews.content: Go in the morning so that the steep climb is shaded!! Also, don’t pay for parking! There is free parking with the Mua caves but there are hawkers convincing you otherwise. We got duped into paying to park. Views are beautiful even when the rice patties aren’t.

reviews.author: EddieDean99
reviews.title: Magnificent views from the top
reviews.content: The view is worth the 100k/person entrance fee. A bit of a climb to the 2 separate lookout points. Luckily, it was a mild day when we went. I can imagine it would be a lot more difficult on a hot day. I recommend wearing proper shoes because the steps are not even and they get pretty far apart closer to the top. We saw 3 separate couples makes the climb for their wedding pictures. I bet those pictures look great, but the climb up and down in a wedding dress would be treacherous. The view from the top by the dragon is magnificent whichever way you look. The view from the other lookout is good in its own right, but more limited. Both are what I imagined when I pictured what Vietnam would look like before coming. Unique and beautiful. Not much to see in the tiny “caves”. The area at the bottom of the climb is nice, but it seems neglected. You can walk around the pond but there isn’t much to see. Some swings to take pictures on and that’s about it. Note on parking: drive past all the whistle blowers and yelling old ladies straight to the front gate. Once through the gate, hang a left past the ticket booth and you’ll see the free parking area. It’s a shame they let scammers put up huge legitimate-looking parking signs to take advantage of tourists. We went past at least 4 “parking lots” before we got to the gate. Hopefully this helps.

reviews.author: Kacy W
reviews.title: Impressive Views
reviews.content: As other reviewers have said, this is more about the climb to the lying dragon stairs than it is about the cave. We went for sunset and found it to be too cloudy to see any sunset, and also quite crowded, but the stunning views were worth it. If we were to go again, we might try for sunrise instead of sunset. The views from the top are 360 degrees, so it doesn’t favor a specific direction.

reviews.author: Straw Tran
reviews.title: Spectacular mountain scenery
reviews.content: Ticket: 100.000vndThere are a lot of parking yards on the way with people trying to ask you to come in, just ignore them. Drive through the road until you see the ticket booth, then you can park your motorbike or car there, no need to park too far. You need to take 500 stairs to go on top, make sure you wear suitable shoes and bring water.The view from top was fantastic. It takes time and effort to go but it’s worth it.You should go in the afternoon. The sky at 4PM is perfect for picturing. We came a little late and in a cloudy day so the sky was not so bright.I stayed at Ham Rong Homestay which is located very near to Mua Caves. So we didn’t spend too much time for riding motorbike.

reviews.author: Krzysiek N
reviews.title: Not a must see
reviews.content: Visited in November with a little sun this didn’t impress much. The way up and the views are ok, and the park beneath the stairs is being worked on as well, but taking into consideration the price (100k/person) compared to fees in other places, this is barely worth it in my opinion. You should visit if in the area and have nothing better to do.

reviews.author: zahirai3
reviews.title: Worth the view!
reviews.content: A must see. Rally worth the view! The only bad thing was the amount of garbage but once you are up there the view is stunning.

reviews.author: Kopano B
reviews.title: Not so much caves, but breathtaking view!
reviews.content: Expect a good 15-20min trek of uneven steps to the mountain top!As soon as you get there,  you feel rewarded having endured the steps but, you immediately forget about it as you're greeted by the beauty of mountainous view. Only paid 100 000 vnd. Worth visiting !

reviews.author: Olivia L
reviews.title: Great view from the top, rubbish and locals trying to scam tourists into paying for parking out a bit of a dampener onit
reviews.content: Would recommend visiting the Mua Caves. Easy to hike or scooter from Tam Coc. Drive through the main gate and park inside (as per other reviews).

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Not so Much "Caves" as a spectacular view
reviews.content: It's a haul, I mean quite a climb up through ancient stairs. It's a bit meditative if you allow it. However, the views are spectacular once you get to the top. 360 views of the area. Just watch out for all the outta shape tourist (of which I am one) who plop themselves down in front of the alter and block the passage for everyone. Then there's the smokers (of which I am not), beware as nothing compliments an amazing view after a hard stair climb like breathing second hand smoke. But the view is worth it and the cost of admission is low. The nice stroll to get to the stairs is dotted with scenic picture spots and lovely gardens.  Pro tip, if you go Left instead of right, you can find you way to a cave which can be explored a little bit. Bring a light and be warned you may get wet.

reviews.author: Dr_Rohan
reviews.title: A mountain with a view
reviews.content: Not sure why it’s called caves. It’s a mountain with 500 difficult, uneven steps to climb. If you manage to the top you are rewarded with a spectacular view of the surroundings, the mountains, the water and all the nature. Entry costs 100,000.

reviews.author: Thoai T
reviews.title: Amazing view from the top of the mountain
reviews.content: I climbed here at 17:30 a bit late but still feel overwhelming with the view. Quite tired because the steps is made high and tilted. If you can catch the sunrise or sunsets over the place will be awesome. You can park your bike inside the campus for free. Highly recommended place to see “Ha Long Bay on land”

reviews.author: Gratadour D
reviews.title: Interesting experiment
reviews.content: It was really an exercise session being there on my moped. My chart was hardly handy in its instructions so I asked around and finally bumped into 2 women who simply drove up there. It was actually out of way from Other attractions and tam Coc that i pass by a bit and paddy fields rocky roads. This one takes the cake with the least expensive parking fee and staff that is friendly. The walk up with the top was somewhat of a workout although not as strong. The views, nonetheless, are fantastic! I was anticipating this one and I was not disappointed. Just be sure to make it happen earlier than three because the fog can make the opinions hazy. Climb on the top!

reviews.author: kawafamily
reviews.title: パノラマの景色
reviews.content: ハノイから、ホアルー、タムコック、ムアケープを回る、少人数の日帰りツアーで行きました。(USD60)500段ほどの階段を登った頂上からは水田、手漕ぎボートで行った洞窟のある川が見下ろせます。15人までの少人数のツアーで、バスのシートもゆったりしていて、日帰りでしたがさほど疲れませんでした。ツアーはGolden sun palace hotel のThomas さんが全て手配してくれました。Took the day tour from Hanoi Hos lu temple-tamcoc-May cave for 60USD arranged by Mr Thomas from Golden sun palace hotel .It was a small group tour. Each seat in the bus was comfy with enough leg space.Worth going thereNot so tired with comfy ride

reviews.author: iamkayoh
reviews.title: Be prepared to climb. Totally worth it.
reviews.content: Endure and climb till the top of Mua Caves. You will be rewarded with a beautiful 360 degrees view! No regrets! One of my favourite places to visit in Tam Coc!

reviews.author: Trygve H
reviews.title: Nice hike and view, be aware of the different parking lots
reviews.content: We where stopped at the first parking lot, and did not know it was one of many, and got hustled. After we left we noticed the gas tank was drained, as we had just filled it before arrival. This was after he tried to hustle us and give us back the wrong change when parking. Besides that it was a nice hike with good view.

reviews.author: Cliff Barnett
reviews.title: Dont Bother if Rice Fields Arnt Blooming
reviews.content: Visited few weeks after the second rice harvest on a cloudy day, great view from the top but unfortunately at this time of the year all I could never was fields of brown water. The photos look amazing when the rice fields are bright yellow, I'd say it is a must do if you're in the area at the right time of the year. Walk to the top is up 500 uneven steps, more if you go to the lower lookout first, took me about 10 minutes to the top. I went near sunset and it was packed, lots of people climbing on the ridge at the top which is quite slippery, take care if climbing up. Parking for bikes is free inside the gate, don't fall for the paid parking on the road leading to the entry.

reviews.author: nyusual
reviews.title: Great vistas of the area
reviews.content: Mua cave gives a 360 degree view of the Tam Coc region. Plan for atleast three hours to visit this place. Lot of climbing is involved and to see the dragon perched on top needs some extra effort. If you can be there for the sunset and soak in the sights of the region. After rains, the steps could be slippery, wear comfortable shoes.Place has an entry fee and accepts credit cards for a fee.  Visit for the vistas of Ninh Binh and leave no trace behind.

reviews.author: Ajax7925 -Steve W
reviews.title: Mau Caves , Ninh Binh, Vietnam
reviews.content: This was much better than I thought it would be.  Beauiful.  We climbed the 450 stairs.  What a hike!  We also rented a boat it was the best.  I told everyone I know.

reviews.author: UNNIMAYA
reviews.title: Good views of Tam Coc and Ninh Binh country side -Good exercise and worth the climb
reviews.content: The steps to reach the top of Ngoa Long mountain passes through the Hang Mua Eco Lodge property and restaurant and some well maintained parks around a lake (there are swings along the lake where you can have some fun swinging) to reach simple altar to Quan Am (the Goddess of Mercy). The somewhat steep climb is worth the time and efforts for the view of Tam Coc and Ninh Binh paddy fields and scenery from the top. However due to the large number of visitors, the summit can get crowded and it might be difficult to get your photographs without getting photo bombed.

reviews.author: Jerry
reviews.title: Best view of Tam Coc
reviews.content: You've to go to these caves, not for the caves but for the incredible view once you climbed the stairs! The stairs can be slippery and steep quite when it rains but it's very well worth the effort! You are able to also notice the small boats on the river. It was very quiet and peacefull!At the bottom part, there's in addition a garden with kitch statues. We went there by motorcycle which was simple to locate however the last several kilometers have been somewhat bumpy! So should visit! Really nice view. Perhaps hard to find though we are able to just suggest visiting this place!!! Steep climb but really worth to undertake it.

reviews.author: Fangqi_A
reviews.title: Beautiful views at the top
reviews.content: It was quite a managable and pleasant climb up the 500 stone steps. Spectacular views from the top - can see the boats from Tam Coc. The other look-out offers another view of the rice fields and is worth the short climb up. A worthwhile attraction in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Erica G
reviews.title: Beautiful Scenery vs Rubbish everywhere
reviews.content: Climb up the rocky staircase so you can get the beautiful scenery of Ninh Binh landscape... Nevertheless, you will see rubbish along the climbing and tonnes of rubbish stuck between the rocks under the 'Dragon'. It was sad and disappointed to see the beautiful environment is not well protected by the tourists who are irresponsible to the environment.

reviews.author: Chris O
reviews.title: Spectacular Vistas
reviews.content: Fabulous views all the way up.  The climb is very steep.  Uneven steps all the way.  No handrail.  Joint supports recommended for those with injured knees or ankles.  150DNG per person entry November 2018.  Up and down takes 30 -40 minutes so leave a little time fir a beer when u are finished.

reviews.author: allxb2017
reviews.title: Great but **Watchout for parking Scam**
reviews.content: The qhol experience and view is really nice. The cave are not great tho. It’s 100 000 To acces the site. ** DON’T FALL FOR THE PARKING SCAM** There is free parking in the site, as soon as you will be close they will have whistle and try to stop you on. Don’t syop enter the site qhere there is a sign and park on the left nobody will come ( See the picture of the fake parking with the sign and the real one)

reviews.author: Roise
reviews.title: Nice view but expensive ticket
reviews.content: Pay 100000vnd for hiking. So fun but the view r amazing. The ticket is experience. We not recommended this place

reviews.author: Amy L
reviews.title: Beautiful setting
reviews.content: This place is so well finished, it’s gorgeous. A little smaller than I expected but so tranquil definitely worth visiting. The steps to the viewpoint are tough going so wear comfortable shoes, but it’s worth it at the top!! Don’t get caught by the women trying to get you to pay for parking, they wave you down as if you can’t go any further, very cheeky because it’s free inside the gates of the park!

reviews.author: Chislaine P
reviews.title: Park your motorbike at the end of the street its FREE!
reviews.content: Beautiful walk! Just park your motorbike at the end. There will be locals scream at you that you have to park there and walk to the tickets office! It's free parking.

reviews.author: Sofie B
reviews.title: Very beautiful!!
reviews.content: It was worth all the steps up there! But if you want to see the sunset from there, you have to go early. There was a little bit crowded when we came around 5pm, so it wasn’t easy to get pictures without photobombing people. But we saw it, and it was so amazing!At this time we went, we saw a lot of brides and grooms who got some amazing photos in front of the sunset!

reviews.author: Uro_Wil
reviews.title: Worth the climb!
reviews.content: We visited here at the end of the day and walked the 500 steps to get the most amazing view of countryside surrounding Ninh Binh as the sun began to set. Children managed the climb easily and enjoyed the rock climbing at the very end!

reviews.author: leashyjelly
reviews.title: PARKING IS FREE. dont get scammed.
reviews.content: We were directed into a parking area (200m from the main entrance) by a semi official looking man with a whistle and charged 15000vnd. In reality this is a scam and we should have driven right into the. The man STOLE OUR BIKE KEY AND BRIBED US for it’s return. He then THREATENED US WITH A WRENCH AND METAL PIPE because we would not pay him to return our key. Please do not give this man your money. Politely shake your head and Drive straight on into the official grounds where parking is free. The walk itself is best done in the morning or evening - very very hot walk. but be aware multiple tour buses make this their sunset spot. So if you are staying in the area come for sunrise :) lower mountain (to the right) is cool to view Ninh Binh city. Higher mounter (to the left) is awesome natural landscape as far as the eye can see! ENJOY

reviews.author: Arshii A
reviews.title: Amazong view, do not miss this.
reviews.content: Loved climbing up here. It was raining when we visited this place, but still it was beatiful walk up and view was stunning. Do not miss clicking a picture with the dragon up there.

reviews.author: samrey
reviews.title: Loved climbing up here!!
reviews.content: We loved the view and setting and experience of being here and climbing up the 500 stairs that we did it twice! Sunset is a lovely time to come but give yourself enough time so you can enjoy the view and notrush. it is busy and crowded at the top but so worth it!

reviews.author: Fabbri
reviews.title: great view on the top of ninh binh
reviews.content: We went there by bike, through quaint villages and beautiful terrain at a calm pace. It is super easy to bike there from the middle of Ninh Binh. The basic thing we noticed was the quietness, very little visitors, and the gorgeous mountain. We skipped the caves, moreover rather climbed the 500 or maybe one thing stairs, and although a bit slippery there and here, it was a simple climb. The simple fact that there have been very few more visitors also produced the climbing that more pleasurable. The view from the pinnacle is just gorgeous. The countryside and rice paddies stretching out for miles on one side and also you are able to see Tam Coc because of its limestone peaks on the other person. We are able to look at the fantastic scenery above

reviews.author: JKR999
reviews.title: Worth walking up all the steps!
reviews.content: This place is packed at sunset, and its a long walk up more than 450 steps, but the views at the top make it all worth while.

reviews.author: HilsNZ
reviews.title: A hard climb up Hang Mua!
reviews.content: Our driver took us here, not sure why. We climbed the uneven steps which is no easy task in the heat and full sun. It is not for the faint-hearted, one older lady was crying half way up saying “I am scared,” she went back down. The statue of the lady Buddha of Da Nang is at the top along with a dragon and the view is spectacular. The whole area is being done up so people can come and stay. For me, to be honest I could have given this a miss as it was just too hot to do a climb like that.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.content: People trying to scam you to park on their property and try to charge you for that and they even stop you. keep going until the end of the street, you can park beside the ticket office for free. Such an amazing view from the top.

reviews.author: Mancunianabroad90
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing views (even in misty weather)
reviews.content: We visited Mua Caves and the stairs at the recommendation of the receptionist at our hotel and were not disappointed. She recommended that we went early to avoid the crowds and the heat (no need to worry about the heat as it was mild and drizzling for the whole day). We arrived at 8:15am and the place was almost deserted. The steps aren’t too challenging as long as you’re moderately fit. And it’s definitely worth it for the breathtaking views from the top. The misty conditions only added a feeling of eeriness to the whole place and made the walk seem other worldly at points. I’d definitely recommend the walk up the Long Dragon back. We actually didn’t go very far into the caves because there was a lot of standing water in them and we had a few other locations to visit in the same day. Probably one of the best sites we visited in Ninh Bình.

reviews.author: henni2004
reviews.title: View is absolutely breath taking
reviews.content: Don't miss this amazing view point. Taking the steps is quite exhausting, but if you reach the top you won't regret it.

reviews.author: CarolineN79
reviews.title: Nice view, stairs are not that easy for younger kids
reviews.content: The stairs are steep at the end, my 5yo needed help.The view is nice on the top but we couldn’t get near the dragon as there were too many people.Entrance fee is a bit pricey compared to other attractions/temples/caves in Vietnam (100’000d per person, free for kids)

reviews.author: tsvyatko
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: This place is amazing and the view is awesome. On the way up you can see some wild animals. The place is popular among Vietnamese girls and they take a lot of selfies :) it’s very funny!

reviews.author: Samuel L
reviews.title: Good views, but nothing amazing plus litter problem
reviews.content: You walk up (449 steps) to the Lying Dragon Mountain for the good views looking down at the boats going in and out of Mua Cave. It is very pretty, but nothing special. Still for 100k we found this place more interesting than an hour strolling around the ancient capital. Yet, the highlight in Ninh Binh is definitely Trang An. Didn't go on the boats at Tam Coc, but reckon Mua Cave is a second highlight. So not disappointed, but not wowed. This tourist destination does have a small litter problem. Upon walking up and down this mountain, we noticed that there are bins, however a lot of the tourists are either missing the bins or the wind could blow the litter out of the bin. We hope it can get sorted.

reviews.author: ilham r
reviews.title: Beautiful view from the top
reviews.content: The road becomes rough which just adds to the experience of genuine Vietnamese country life. We headed directly for the stairs based on testimonials we seen and boy, what a view from the top!! The chance for photography here's next to none, fantastic for an alternative perspective on Tam Coc. It was simply amazing. After coming down we turned straightaway at the end and at the rear of the valley is a big purely natural tunnel and that results away to Tam Coc. Would say the location is a must see for anyone going towards the place! The trip up the hill was really quite a pleasure. Aerial view of grain fields along with limestones.

reviews.author: Jimmy Grim
reviews.title: Nice view. Be sure to avoid people outside.
reviews.content: The 450 odd steps sound worse than they are. It took us about 6 mins to walk to the top. Nice views and even a shop on the way up. Just be sure to avoid the rats outside who will try to stop you and pretend that you can't drive any further so you will pay to park outside their shop. Drive down to the very end and go in the gate on the left where you can park for free right beside where you buy the ticket (100,000 dong a head).

reviews.author: stevehawkins2016
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: A must see with the family when in Ninh Binh Region. Make sure you take plenty of water, hat and some fitness. Lol

reviews.author: liefie73
reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.content: Place nicely taken care of, beautiful views from the top of the mountain, cave is small and not spectacular (can be skipped) - climbing the mountain is a nice experience

reviews.author: DavidPham
reviews.title: Fabulous Scenery and a bit exercise
reviews.content: After 2.5 hours taking a car riding from Hanoi We arrive Ninh Binh where we find more interesting activities and picturesque places!Mua cave is such a beautiful place!It is located in a resort.If we stay at the resort,the entrance ticket is free but we don’t we have to buy a ticket with price 100.000 dong (~5 usd)!We must do a bit climbing up to the mountain top that makes us sweat but we could reach to a thousand miles road or hidden dragon mountain peak then we see Tam Coc and Ninh Binh town by panoramic view!It is a present of Earth Mother ❤️❤️❤️!

reviews.author: AndreandBex
reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.content: We cycled to MUA caves from our homestay, only about 5km from Tam Coc. As you approach the caves the shops on the side are quite vociferous about you parking there. IGNORE! Parking is free when you pay to walk up. The steps weren’t that taxing to walk up but maybe for someone carrying a bit of timber! Views are out of this world

reviews.author: Tash H
reviews.title: Crowded pagodas
reviews.content: We'd read about this place on trip advisor and decided it was definitely worth a look, the post said the ideal time would be to get to the top of the mountain pagoda as the sun set. The climb wasn't too bad, we took a number of breaks and made it up to the top in about 30 mins. Along the way you see travellers coming down the stairs drenched in sweat and looking extremely red and put out, but maybe it had been hotter on their journey upward?Also a fun sight are the many wedding photographers, brides and grooms that make the trek up to the top for the ultimate wedding picture. I can't imaging climbing those stairs in heels and a fully laced dress! But to continue, once we made it to the top we couldn't even get to the pagoda for all the masses of tourists already sitting there waiting for that one gold picture of the sun setting over the valley and cliffs. Quite disappointing, however there was another spot on the way up called 'love valley', great views and much quieter. To round up, I would suggest going at dawn and making it to the top as the sun rises. Otherwise you'll literally be elbow to elbow with your fellow travellers when that glorious sun disappears behind the mountains.

reviews.author: 663zins
reviews.title: nice place with great view
reviews.content: very nice view from the top, near Tam Coc and can go with either bicycle or motorbike..take note there’s 100K VND entrance fee though.

reviews.author: אור א
reviews.title: WARNING: PARKING MAFIA SCAM
reviews.content: THE ROAD LEADING TO THE CAVE IS ALL WITH PEOPLE WHO WILL AGGRESSIVELY DEMAND YOU TO PARK IN THEIR PLACE. THEY WILL ACT AS IF THEY WERE THE AUTHORITIES. JUST HAD ON TO THE CAVE, WERE YOU CAN PARK FOR FREE. We had a very bad experience.  After ignoring the whistles and shouts on the way, when we had back we warn other tourists and told them they can park inside for free. Then the local man threw a stone towards us! That just ruined the whole experience for me...

reviews.author: Moshe
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: worth an attempt to climb up 500 steps with excellent view of tam case and the Ninh Binh city, country side. half an hour or so, relax on top as well as wish all views here should bring back the home of ours for seeing everyday. no leather bothers us.

reviews.author: tlchin
reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.content: The climb to the top could be exhausted under the humid sun, but the view would be worth it. On one side, you got to see the boats rowed along the river surrounded by limestone mountains. On the other side, you got to see the panoramic view of Ninh Binh and the green paddy field.

reviews.author: Yael1991
reviews.title: Lovely visit
reviews.content: We climbed the stairs and the view was beautiful. That being said, it is full of tourists and super crowded.

reviews.author: Gardie
reviews.title: Great view - must go
reviews.content: Need to go! There a great deal of steps into the top, though The perspective is extremely gratifying. Almost all around Experience that is great.

reviews.author: Boony B
reviews.title: Fabulous views
reviews.content: When I 1st arrived and discovered the cave. Nevertheless, after you get to the pinnacle of the mountain you're rewarded with probably the most beautiful view. The steps up are difficult though it actually is worth every penny. I did it two times to watch the view in mist and sunlight and both were simply astounding.

reviews.author: iliketomoveandsee
reviews.title: Very hot, but worth it!
reviews.content: My husband and I cycled here from Tam Coc, it probably took around 30 minutes and we just followed Google Map instructions for walking/driving. We visited here around mid-day and it was extremely hot so the climb up the 500 steps was quite hard work. Make sure you take plenty of water and take it slowly and you'll enjoy it.

reviews.author: Suz
reviews.title: Worth the climb up!
reviews.content: 500 steps to the top you will get to see the amazing landscape of the whole area. Take it slow and enjoy the view.

reviews.author: Imogen P
reviews.title: Good views
reviews.content: Firstly- don’t get scammed by the locals saying you need to pay to park. You can leave your car/bike/moped by the ticket office through the gates.It’s a good view, stable people can climb round the dragon. There’s caves and nice water features. Good value for 100,000 VNDBest not to do when super humid as it kills your lungs!

reviews.author: atuaprima
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: Absolutely worth it. As other reviewers pointed out, ignore those trying to get money for parking. You can park the bike for free at the end of the street next to the ticket station. It's a difficult climb all the way to the top, but it pays off. It's especially beautiful by sunset. Take water with you, you'll need it!

reviews.author: Carmen B
reviews.title: Stunning View
reviews.content: It is one of the most beautiful places to visit in Vietnam. The way up to get to the top is a little hard but in spite of, it is worth it because you will be able to enjoy the breathtaking views.

reviews.author: Anu S
reviews.title: Incredible, Not as Bright Green as you may think!
reviews.content: Just so you don't get your hopes up, in December they are past the harvest and the fields may look brown.  Still, this is a really incredible spot with a view of a river once you get to the top.  It's totally worth it.  I'd recommend getting scooters to ride around Ninh Binh, the ride to the caves is really cool because you are riding through the rice fields and farming village.  It does close at night apparently, and probably has a limited view, so plan accordingly.  You do sort of walk through a Lodge foreground before approaching the actual site.

reviews.author: Africa t
reviews.title: Great views
reviews.content: Totally recommend the visit. It is a hard climb (5000 stairs) but totally worth it. You can get there with bycicle from Tam Coc or by bycicle. The entry fee is 100 000 dong.

reviews.author: YanVa
reviews.title: Heaven!!!
reviews.content: We went up at 16h. (It closes around 16 so we were scered we wouldn't get in, but you can) we stayed and watched the sunset from the vieuw point with the dragon and left in the dark. It was like heaven on earth, soooo beautiful, a must if you stay a day in ninh binh.

reviews.author: Vaclav Dekanovsky
reviews.title: Hot climb between cliffs
reviews.content: They say Hang Mua has 500 steps to climb the summit. I think it's less, but some are 40cm high. It's great sport, especially if sun is shinning to the stairs, which is most of the day. But the view is nice and you can visit a cave afterwards, but bring light and swimsuit. Park inside and don't let people on the road stop you, because the further you park the more expensive it is.

reviews.author: Simon L
reviews.title: Crazy vietnamese people!
reviews.content: Several people is doing everything to make you park outside the entrance for a fee, even though it is free to park inside. They are lying straight to you face!The entrance fee is 100.000 VND which is quite high compared to other places we visited in Vietnam. Only kids under 6 years is half price - other places all our kids up to 14 years were half price!This experience is a shame for Vietnam.

reviews.author: Livvie Dabels
reviews.title: The view at the top!
reviews.content: The Mua Caves had been quite "simple" nothing amazing or perhaps great though the primary attraction there's visiting the top part, uniquely before sunset. The perspective is one the most incredible things you'll actually observe, breathtaking, will be the ideal picture that I'd in the head of mine when someone mention vietnam, take your time love everything and it is completely well worth it.

reviews.author: RockbillyCafeHanoi
reviews.title: Stunning view - worth a visit
reviews.content: Mua Cave is popular with local people but just recently known by tourist. We just been back from a day trip to this beautiful place (Mua Cave  - Thung Nham) and really impressed with the view from the top of this cave. Along the way up with around 500 steps, there are many places for you to stop and take great photo. I'm sure that you will not regret when visiting this fabolous area

reviews.author: WebbB
reviews.title: Wow, nothing more to say
reviews.content: Mua Caves is one. there are approximately 500 steps though many places to stop taking a picture with the gorgeous views. There are not way too many visitors that feel comfortable. Plus in case you park in the next last parking lots it has 10,000 rather than 15000 for parking, that's for motorcycles.

reviews.author: Son D
reviews.title: Great views on the busy cliff top
reviews.content: You will find a number of visitors up right here so it is no simple to get a picture in, this particular place is popular with local photography crews. We went more than on the smaller cliff with the small white tower on it, yet another excellent place to take pictures. Is like the location gets really active around sunset.

reviews.author: cherry_streets
reviews.title: high price, but worth the view!
reviews.content: We arrived early morning and were awarded with stunning views and only a handful of other solo travellers. We came by motorbike and were thrown off gaurd when a lady wearing a uniform blew her whistle and told us to park. we payed 20K dong which was a rip off, since when walking towards the enterance we saw free parking. The 100K dong ticket is steep, but worth the view.

reviews.author: LionHan
reviews.title: Short time
reviews.content: I came to Ninh Binh second times but I never ever come here. So I feel so excited with trip. I must get up at 5 a.m and prepare something. At 6 a.m we move to Mua cave by taxi. About 7-8 km from my hotel, I pay 140.000 VND for 4 person. It's quite convenience.When I come here, I must buy the ticket. It's 100.000 VND. It will so cheap if it make me satisfied. But it's not. It's an unfinished construction site. However, when you climb to the top, the climate is quite pleasant.My opinion, if the price of ticket just from 30.000 to 50.000 VND is better in this time. And if you have a plan come here, let's attention to my suggestions.Final, although I was not too satisfied but I'm sure that you will have some nice pics.

reviews.author: Mhel F
reviews.title: Challenging tour
reviews.content: We manage to get on top and climb that 500 stairs OMG!It's amazing when we reach on top. A very nice view ever

reviews.author: Pimnart W
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.content: You have to climb up 486 steps to reach the highest point. The view along the way was spectacular and stunning. Worth going !!

reviews.author: Witt
reviews.title: Best view in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: I was amazed to find out there was a good small location at the foundation of the hill to appear around also. I'd read about the actions with the top and was a bit of apprehensive, but did not think it is as daunting as I expected. It's a climb though (I counted 458 steps) and must be mindful over the uneven rock. It had taken aproximatelly twenty minutes to reach the top part, at a reasonable rate and stopping watching the goats on the stones. The view is amazing when you reach the top. Well worth the effort. Much below the summit, you are able to envision the boats from Tam Coc rowing on the river. You are able to go to the spot, to buy a different perspective of the summit, by going to Thai Vi.

reviews.author: AshiqAbdeen
reviews.title: MAGNIFIQUE
reviews.content: Wow that’s all the word I have for this place.you have a steep climbing up the hill if you want to have Amazing view.Better go in the evening to avoid the heat and the sun,preferably with appropriate foot wear.

reviews.author: Marline
reviews.title: Too high expectations
reviews.content: The image of the dragon on top of the Mua Caves, has been shown on many photographs all over the internet. Sadly, it wasn’t how I imagined it but still very lovely! It’s worth climbing the stairs to the top, the views are great!

reviews.author: Natalia K
reviews.title: Amazing view !
reviews.content: This is an amazing place! Of course you have to climb 500 steps and it’s not easy with this hot and humidity here but in the end the view is breathtaking! You can see the river and the rise fields . This is so beautiful!

reviews.author: mryandao l
reviews.title: a view must see once in the lifetime
reviews.content: just 16 minutes to climb up to peak. the view must see before you die.first time climb up moutain need paid 100k DONG for entrance. it might pricey.what to do? the view must view before you die..

reviews.author: rosejhsrilanka
reviews.title: PARKING IS FREE
reviews.content: Drive right past the people demanding you to pay, through the gates and into the free parking for the cave. Cost of climb is 100'000vnd. Snacks and refreshments on the way up if needed. Beware of wasps (I think that's what they were) at the top!! There were loads when we went up in the early evening. It's a steep climb but worth it for a good view. We climbed at about 4.30pm when it was cooler and this was a lovely time to do it. Would recommend trainers.

reviews.author: Yankiekiki
reviews.title: Worth the climb!!!
reviews.content: Gorgeous, breathtaking panoramic scenery from the top of the climb! It was a bit of an effort but totally worth it! I have been here twice in the last 3 months. And both times are as amazing.

reviews.author: Kordula D
reviews.title: Best view
reviews.content: The Mua cave as well as its environment has a little interest, though the star, here's the view, from which you are able to envision the road of the popular Tam Coc, in addition to the basic landscape of the spot. You've to climb approximately 500 steps, but it definitely worths it.

reviews.author: 672g
reviews.title: Challenging Hike But Worth It-Check Out the Dragon at the Top.
reviews.content: Recently visited and hiked to the top with the family (2 adults and 2 teenage children) which was challenging given the temperature of almost 100 degrees.  When you get to the top, make sure that you turn around to check out the dragon statue that spans the top of the mountain peak, just above the pagoda.  We did not even know it existed until we returned from our trip saw it on a You Tube drone video.

reviews.author: livga
reviews.title: Stunning view!
reviews.content: After climbing up the 450 stairsteps we were awarded with a stunning view! Regarding the parking of bicycles.. all i can say is that we could park our bicycle right next to the ticket office for free. It is worth a try to pass by all the demanding people and park the bicycle in front at the office.

reviews.author: GJSWA
reviews.title: Mountain not cave
reviews.content: Quite a walk to the top but worth it for the stunning view. Best not to do in the hottest time of the day.

reviews.author: rona
reviews.title: Best view
reviews.content: We have been a little uncertain as to if you should do a one day trip to Mua Cave just since we've seen a lot in Vietnam already. We had been experiencing slightly carved out! It was a really stunning cave though, and I'm happy we went to go to it. The climb up to the cave was exhausting though, as well as I'd ordinarily class myself as rather a fit person

reviews.author: Rubén G
reviews.title: Not worth 100k VND
reviews.content: People at the entrance very rude. The view is nice but not worth 100k vnd. Definitely not the best cave.

reviews.author: Chris L
reviews.title: Well Worth The Hike
reviews.content: Whilst the hike up the caves is tough when you get to the top the views are phenomenal! I highly recommend taking plenty of water and not to go if you have any leg or cardiovascular issues as it does put a lot of strain on the body.

reviews.author: Roaming Kiwi
reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.content: Fantastic views - it's a steep climb but doesn't take too long. There's free parking inside next to the ticket office so you don't have the park and pay with the first lots you see.

reviews.author: KellyS3210
reviews.title: Great views
reviews.content: First of all entry is 100,000 dong as of August 2018- far more than Lonely Planet or blogs post, I think there has been a recent price increase. Great views from the top but a very challenging climb when hot - very little shade so take a hat and plenty of water. We didn’t bother going in the caves. The site as a whole is being refurbished to include water features, bamboo swings, restaurants etc. It will be nice when completed. Beware outside people asking you to stop and park all the way up to entrance. Parking at the site (through the gates) is FREE including motorbikes. As we got near a woman actually stood in front of the bike we were driving shouting, forcing us to stop and use her parking area (10k dong). Just drive straight along the road until you get to the site and ignore the shouts and whistles. They even try to trick you by wearing shirts.

reviews.author: yboxer
reviews.title: What an amazing view
reviews.content: Hi before sunset- Clive 500 staircase to get up - worth the views- see the pictures - you need at last 1.5 hours. I slept in Tam Coc and used bike to get there

reviews.author: Florri
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.content: The cave is especially fascinating, the view out of the pavilion on top is fantastic. Certainly a must do when visiting Tam Coc. We'd a number of problems finding the cave as you use it from the different street subsequently the Tam Coc motorboat station.

reviews.author: Judas
reviews.title: Great view at the top
reviews.content: Caves are not special looking but head to the pinnacle of the mountain. It has 100 zero dong to enter and you've to climb steep steeps though the view is fantastic.If you've a bike, ignore the very ambitious males that show you to park within the parking areas on the right. Just drive pass them to the gate where you are going to park for free and get the tickets of yours.

reviews.author: Artur S
reviews.title: You have to see it!!!
reviews.content: So you are in Hanoi take a bus, motorbike or any kind of transport and shake your leg to this place. Because the views are like in no other place. It became my favourite place after same minute I reached the top. It's over 500 steps but totally worth it. Just take some water and a hat on a sunny day and maybe try to go there late afternoon when sun is not that strong. If you get there by motorbike or bicycle do not stop on first parking place even if they whistle at you. Just keep going closer to the entrance because next parking places are half price. Make sure your cameras are fully charged and enjoy!!!

reviews.author: Tam Le Vietnam
reviews.title: Amazing high-point to enjoy Tam Ckc Valley
reviews.content: Tam Coc boat trip is must-do activity for any tourists. For some hours on boat rowed by local people. Thousands of limestone mountains and rice fields make you fall in love. Best place to see this amazing valley is Hang Mua. Get some steps and enjoy!!!

reviews.author: Allissa
reviews.title: Beautiful View
reviews.content: I recommend doing the hike, which overlooks the Tam Coc. While it was extremely hot in summer, it had been totally worth it. The sights are impressive at the top and there have been almost no various other individuals around. Entrance was very economical too. We did this particular as soon as the motorboat trip and appreciated the hike even more because you will find no tats and no manuals begging for even more suggestions and we had been alone most of the time at the top.

reviews.author: Minh-Ha N
reviews.title: Amazing view to Tam Coc
reviews.content: It takes 548 high steps to get to this peak. In a hot summer day it might be challenging, but very much worth it, in my opinion. The view from above is spectacular!The way to go up is also beautiful. We crossed some mountain goats on the way and were amazed by how they can claim rocks.It’s possible for kids to get to the top. My 5yo had no trouble at all. Just prepare sneakers and water and a hat if it’s sunny.

reviews.author: гульнара самикова
reviews.title: Nice view but was it worth the climb?
reviews.content: We cycled towards the Mua caves from Tam Coc that is aproximatelly seven km. The cave is not special, what you actually go for will be the view from the roof of the hill. But 300 plus measures in 32c heat along with hundred % moisture isn't fun

reviews.author: Tom S
reviews.title: Must see if you're in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: It's not that hard of a walk first of all... I'm not the fittest but I didn't struggle. You may sweat a bit though if the day is hot. So... I'm sure you'll see all the other reviews about the parking... Yes, don't stop when they whistle or flag you down... It is free when you get through the main gate. There is a parking sign right before it and a guy might try and stop you going past, but just keep going. It is 100k for a ticket at the office for the walk, and you can park your bike in that area. The view from the top is incredible and well worth the hike!

reviews.author: wayne
reviews.title: One of a few nice things to do in Tam Coc
reviews.content: One of many pluses to learn in Tam Coc. We cycled there (around 5km) providing a selection of great views of the rice paddies. It's 100k getting in ground a really are attractive along with the structure in place no a shame. Views at the top fantastic though it is crowded.

reviews.author: Spencer S
reviews.title: A must see!
reviews.content: Don’t miss out on this awesome spot just outside Tam Coc! It’s a bit of a climb but the steps are large and easily to conquer. The view is incredible!

reviews.author: Kiwi1963
reviews.title: 500 steps but who's counting?
reviews.content: Instead of repeating what other reviewers have mentioned, here's a list of TIPS:* Go early due to heat. We met people who got in at 5am* A walking stick was so helpful* Take plenty of water and some more* Wear a hat as there is NO SHADE* At the end, at the bottom of the steps, lash out on an iced 'big water' to pour over your head and resuscitate yourself! It will be the best $1.50 you ever spend!We confidently rode our bikes all the way through to the ticket office despite being strongly co-erced in to the paid parking lots! It was funny. But the free parking is closer to the beginning of the walk so keep riding.The bike ride from Tam Coc village to Mua Cave was an easy flat ride.The Cave at the end we sort of missed due to delirium from the heat! Apparently there's a bar inside the Cave? Not sure of this though. So Mua Cave is really more about the walk up the hill to see the amazing view! I'd definitely do it again but would pick a cooler time if I could. I'm 55 and reasonably fit. I nearly gave up several times but was determined to climb to the top so I could write this review! You're welcome!

reviews.author: Abi414
reviews.title: Good view - there is free parking
reviews.content: It’s worth the climb to the top as the views are really good even when cloudy/rainy just be careful when it’s wet. Didn’t read the reviews on here before so we ended up paying the parking scammers 15k to park when it’s free inside. So when you see big signs saying parking and they are blowing whistles at you just go straight by, I think there are two of them before the actual entrance.

reviews.author: Cantu
reviews.title: Greatest view!
reviews.content: I was amazed to find out there was a good small location at the foundation of the hill to appear around also. I'd read about the steps with the top and was a bit of apprehensive, but did not think it is as daunting as I anticipated. It's a climb although and also must be mindful over the uneven rock. It had taken twenty minutes to reach the top part, at a reasonable rate and stopping watching the goats on the stones. The point of view is amazing when you reach the top. Well worth the energy. Far under the summit, you are able to see the boats at Tam Coc rowing on the river. You are able to go to the spot, to get an alternative perspective on the summit, by visiting Thai Vi.

reviews.author: Journoud
reviews.title: So worth the climb
reviews.content: The measures are tiring but workable. At the summit, you will be rewarded with gorgeous ideas on the Tam Coc River on a single side as well as rice paddies within the other. Certainly a must check out within the itinerary to Ninh Binh. I went during first Oct and there have been not many visitors. I was a lot on your own at some point.

reviews.author: Resgol
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: We went there relatively early but it was already hot. The climb is not easy but is still worth the effort. The view down the river on one side and to the valley on the other side is beautiful. We went down the river on the day before and it was interesting to see the look from another angle. There's an artificial pool and island in the entrance. There is a small shop where you can buy drinks and refreshments. We had difficulty to find a taxi back. It's probably better to come with bicycle or motorcycle.

reviews.author: Olga S
reviews.title: Fantastic View!!!
reviews.content: It was hard to go up, expecally when it's 45 degrees outside, but it's worth it! The view you see there is amazing! There are no words to describe how beatiful it is!

reviews.author: Tomas
reviews.title: Amazing View
reviews.content: Once you begin walking from the automobile park, it's stunning, views from the past are amazing. The stairs are in pretty good condition but better to use closed shoes. Also, there's a hotel close to the automobile park you can purchase drinks from in case you forget to take some, but not sure in case they do food.

reviews.author: jeffery
reviews.title: Wonderful view
reviews.content: This's good activity on the day of yours of arrival within Ninh Binh, prior to seeing either Tam Coc or maybe Trang An early the following morning. There is a good small park, though the main appeal is a pagoda rather some steps up. From there you have a wonderful view over the place.

reviews.author: Megan Y
reviews.title: Worth the steps!
reviews.content: The 500 steps leading to the top of the Mua Cave mountains were worth the beautiful, scenic view once at the top! The view was amazing but watch out for the wild mountain goat poo during the climb. Also be careful and as some steps were narrow and difficult to climb, not recommended for young children.

reviews.author: katebui_97
reviews.title: Tiring, yet worth it
reviews.content: The road up the mountain is just so tiring that I fell breathless. But the view from the top is extraordinarily wonderful. The rice paddies are beautiful though it was not in the right season when we traveled. And the dragon statue looks perfect in photos

reviews.author: Xiao Huang
reviews.title: Spectacular View on the Top
reviews.content: Just spent 1 day with our traveller to explore Ninh Binh pro. It took us 2,5 hours to get there and more than hundreds steps by hiking. The sense is so beautiful and enjoy fresh air make us more healthy. Take a look panoramic view of Tam Coc in harvest is so peaceful and enjoyable. This destination is exclusive in daily trip for excursions and it is arranged by private tour.Highly recommend

reviews.author: Cyndy Weaver
reviews.title: Spectacular view
reviews.content: It was incredible we'd such a great view of Tam Coc as soon as the pleasure, climb up the steps. Practice you vocal with the echo wall out of the cliff across the climb. Greeting us further up is the couple of herds of colourful mountain goats at recesses within the cliffs. Prayed for earth peace at the sculpture at the summit

reviews.author: GK
reviews.title: The best view worth the climb
reviews.content: The climb is quite strainous but totally worth it for the views! There is a small shop with tables and chairs where you can rest on the way. Take plenty of water with you and go either early or late during the day to avoid the worst heat.When I visited the hotel at the entrance was being renovated. The path left for tourist going around the renovation area was unstable and quite unsafe so we quarrelled with the staff and walked straight through the construction ground instead of going around.

reviews.author: Gijs A
reviews.title: PARKING AT THE ENTRANCE IS FREE
