The cave at the bottom is a poor excuse for a cave. But the visit to the site is worth it just for the view from the top. Entry fee is 100000 Per person.

reviews.author: Małgorzata R
reviews.title: Nice top view of the region
reviews.content: Nice top view of the region and two caves (unfortunately flooded during our visit). The view is worth the tiring climb

reviews.author: Roni R
reviews.title: Beautiful view but expansive.
reviews.content: The view in the end of the 462 stairs (we counted...) Is amazing! You get 360° view and it is worth the climbing.The caves are poor. Dont even try...It is a little bit expansive but I think its a must!

reviews.author: Opuig
reviews.title: Awesome sightseeing!
reviews.content: Arriving to the top of the mountain has its rewards: the views are breathtaking. The cave is just irrelevant. 4$ is the price for the entrance.

reviews.author: arjun_stc
reviews.title: Good for a day trip if bundled with something else
reviews.content: We visited this place as part of a packaged tour, so I can't comment on the prices. You will probably see this place as part of a package (with some boat ride) too.The attraction is actually two "sites": a 500 steps climb to the top of a hill, and a cave at the base of the hill.The drive to the place is in itself enjoyable.The climb itself can be tough in the mid-day heat, so take along water.The cave is nothing spectacular - you get a better experience if you visit the caves at nearby Trang An (which we did as part of the tour).

reviews.author: havu
reviews.title: The view from the top is breath taking!
reviews.content: The climbing took us around 20'. Too bad it was so rainy so I couldn't take any good pictures. There is 1 small stop at the peak of the mountain. It is more interesting than the cave.

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: Spectacular views
reviews.content: A must see if you visit Ninh Binh. The views on top of the mountain are very impressive, great view of Tam Coc. The climb can be hard when it's hot, but it doesn't take you too long (I think like 30 minutes). The caves are not very impressive.

reviews.author: Albane D
reviews.title: The only interest is the great point of view
reviews.content: We went there just for the point of view . After climbing 500 stairs you discover a great panorama . But the caves seems to be abandoned , and the site too... It is quite expensive ... 4$ .

reviews.author: Anouk
reviews.title: Amazing view!
reviews.content: I was here in the morning at 7.30 to climb up the steps. I can recommend you to do it early otherwise the climb is tougher with a lot of sun...In 10 minutes you will be reach the top with amazing view. At that time I was the only one, so that was another plus to go early!

reviews.author: Rekha R
reviews.title: Great views of Tam Coc & surrounding
reviews.content: Views are worth it. Takes about 500-600 steps to climb up & it was hot..but the views and the scenery make up for it. Not a whole lot on top of the mountain other than that.

reviews.author: Kawin Prukwattanasiri
reviews.title: Mua Caves (Hang Mua)
reviews.content: The weather is so hot (I went there about 11AM) you should prepare some water because on the way to the top there don't have any shop.But there have a restaurant near the entrance ticket booth where you can eat delicious food with valuable price.the entrance fee is 100.000VND/ppparking fee is about 2.000VND/pp (Not sure I can't remember)

reviews.author: GemmaK123
reviews.title: Avatar views!
reviews.content: We completed the climb up several hundred steps or so at around 9.30am yesterday. It wasn't too hot by then so a good time to go! It's a great view and you can see part of the Tam Coc boat ride. Only takes about one hour in total and you need to pay 100vd pp at the bottom of the hill. Preferred this to Ha Long Bay, much quieter, cleaner and less touristy!

reviews.author: Martyn M
reviews.title: Steps make this...
reviews.content: Not sure why they concentrate so much on the caves as to be honest,  they weren't anything special.  However,  the steps to the top resulted in some stunning views and are worth the entrance fee. Avoid in mad heat, it's a killer!

reviews.author: nita g
reviews.title: Panoramic View From The Top of Mua Cave
reviews.content: I went from Trang An Scenic Complex and couldn't find this location easily. Got lost somewhere in the village. The entrance fee is quite expensive, vnd 100.000, considering they don't offer much attraction. The key is not to rush, step to the top slowly. It was an easy climb. As you reach the peak, you can get beautiful panoramic views. I enjoyed the stunning view of Tam Coc, paddy fields and towers from above. Overall, it's an interesting experience, one of my highlights of a day trip in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: alison
reviews.title: Loved it . If you want an authentic nature outing this is it .
reviews.content: We visited Van Long Nature Reserve early in the morning after our driver suggested it would be cooler and give us the best chance of spotting wildlife. We knew that seeing the endangered Delacour’s langur wasn’t guaranteed, and honestly, after gliding through the wetlands on the peaceful bamboo boat, we had already decided the trip was worthwhile regardless.The scenery was beautiful and incredibly calm, with towering limestone . Then our boat rower quietly pointed towards the rocks, and we were lucky enough to spot not just one langur, but a whole group of nine. It was a special moment and the icing on the cake of an already memorable visit.Van Long is a little further out than some of the more popular attractions around Ninh Binh, but that is part of its charm. It felt uncrowded, natural and unspoilt. If you’re looking for a quieter experience and appreciate nature, we would highly recommend making the effort to visit.

reviews.author: Meeling W
reviews.title: Peaceful Escape
reviews.content: Van Long Nature Reserve was one of the most peaceful and beautiful experiences of our trip. We went early in the morning, and the setting was absolutely stunning—calm water, dramatic limestone karsts, and a quiet stillness that made everything feel untouched.Our rower gently guided us through the reserve, taking her time and happily stopping whenever we wanted to take photos. She was warm and friendly, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Along the way, we were lucky enough to spot Delacour’s langurs, along with a variety of birds, fish, and other wildlife—such a special moment in such a serene environment.What really stood out was how quiet and uncrowded it was. We had done Tràng An a few days earlier, which was beautiful in its own way, but Van Long felt far more peaceful and authentic, with very few other boats around.We were staying nearby at a homestay and simply biked over, which made the whole experience feel even more relaxed and immersive. On the way back, we stopped at a close by open-air restaurant for a cold beer - a perfect way to end the morning.If you’re looking for a tranquil, less touristy alternative with incredible scenery and wildlife, Van Long Nature Reserve is absolutely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Cory V
reviews.title: Beautiful place to visit
reviews.content: Got to see the monkeys which is rare so we feel very privileged. Was a great experience.

reviews.author: Jackie O
reviews.title: Natural beauty
reviews.content: Pleasant, picturesque boat ride. No pressure from our guide who rowed the whole way, stopping for photos. A wonderful experience. Check in advance that you can get a return Grab. Luckily our driver waited for us. Tip the boat guide & your driver (100,000 each seems fair)

reviews.author: karin_caethoven
reviews.title: Beautiful nature!
reviews.content: Beautiful nature, much more authentic than Trang An, if you love natural beauty. Much smaller scale. Boat tour takes about 1.5 hours. White-rumped langurs: check!

reviews.author: ThomasPUK
reviews.title: Nice views with sunset.
reviews.content: No crowds. Ticket 100,000 per person. Only saw a few birds and no other while life but vet beautiful scenery. Our rower & the staff at the dock/pier, demand extra money/tips at the end of the trip and become agitated  if they don’t get what they want.

reviews.author: Josh G
reviews.title: Not the best reserve for wildlife watching
reviews.content: Went to the reserve in the hope for seeing some birds and/or monkeys.The entrance to the reserve is just an archway where the boat rides go from and it is not well signposted.The boat rides are ok going through the wetland, didn’t see many birds or no monkeys though.Lasts about an hour and after that there isn’t anything to do (you can walk along the perimeter which is on a busy road)Overall ok but underwhelming if you want to spend a while watching animals.

reviews.author: Jesper M
reviews.title: Wonderful experience, less tourists
reviews.content: We went there day after sailing at Thrang An. This experience was far better for us. - We were nearly alone, far less tourists, hence the water was absolutely calm- we had the boat for ourselves- it was cheaper- we also saw the monkeys*only note is that the ticket office is not really obvious to find*

reviews.author: Hugo L
reviews.title: The rower asks to row with him and no birds or monkeys seen.
reviews.content: The view is pretty, but no more than Trang An or Tam Coc. It's certainly cheaper, but it's also further from Ninh Binh and Tam Coc, what you save in entrance fees you'll pay for gasoline and scooter rental. Not all rowers speak English, ours did not speak English, so no explanation. We've only seen storks. No other birds and no monkeys. The rower asks us to help him row...

reviews.author: Duncan W
reviews.title: Quite and peaceful
reviews.content: We did the boat trip through the wetland with the primary purpose of seeing birds.  Despite the misty day, we did see quite a few (including many Storks/Openbill up on the cliffs).  We visited the cave.  Very scenic.  We started out alone but there were soon other boats on the water but these weren't a problem.  The only negative was that they seemed over keen for a big tip at the conclusion.

reviews.author: Lucy F
reviews.title: Beautiful and quiet
reviews.content: Beautiful quiet way to explore Ninh Binh. Stunning scenery. Very few boats in the water. Totally unspoilt.  Boats are east to hire

reviews.author: Fradj Did
reviews.title: Why choose Vietnam
reviews.content: We stayed 10 unforgettable days in Vietnam with the agency Authentik , we will not forget an exceptional and professional tour operator Mr Nguyen Thang Victor who prepared us a nature tour in the heart of large landscapes and without forgetting his team especially the Guide Nguyễn Minh Tuấn and his driver who accompanied us throughout the trip with care and kindness.

reviews.author: Andria F
reviews.title: So peaceful
reviews.content: Absolutely beautiful and so quiet after Trang  An. Only a few boats on the river so you could hear all the wildlife. Little cave at the end where you turn round and come back.  Lasts about an hour. Well worth doing if in the area.

reviews.author: Crumpled Nomad | Travel Intelligence
reviews.title: A scenic boat ride
reviews.content: Very leisure boat ride along the river. It was a pretty long journey as it took us around 1.5hrs to and fro sailing through the river. The boat lady was rowing the boat using her feet which was an amazing feat. Along the river, we passed by many scenic sites and paid fields. Do wear a hat if possible as it can get really hot in the summer. Thankfully the boat lady offered us an umbrella which was really useful. During the boat ride, we passed through some limestone caves as well. A must do in ninh binh.

reviews.author: Matthew L
reviews.title: Sit back and Chill
reviews.content: Expectations are funny things. If you were expecting to see monkeys or defined bird watching success by how many birds there were then you could easily be disappointed. We really enjoyed this boat trip. We heard the monkeys and might have seen the  tail of a departing one. The bird life was scarce but beautiful and what is not too like about being paddled around a wetland. The trip was a peaceful contrast to the Tràng An experience- we were almost the only boat  there. Coming across some locals diving for clams was a highlight. Tràng an was spectacular- this was quite beautiful in an understated way. I would go again.

reviews.author: Ellie M
reviews.title: Beat the crowds!
reviews.content: Van Long Wetland was an amazing boat trip, 1 hr for $100,000 each.Only 3-4 other boats on the water. Many times we were the only boat we could see. Felt like having a private tour of the beautiful rock formations and water.We did a similar boat tour at Trang An, where there were hundreds of boats and unfortunately it was not peaceful at all.I would recommend Van Long, for a more private & less touristy option!Apparently there are free walks you can do instead of the boat ride, but we couldn't find where to access those

reviews.author: ボボ
reviews.title: Touring the Wetlands
reviews.content: You can tour the wetlands on a bamboo boat. You can see many wild birds and strange rock formations. If you're lucky, you may see a mother and her baby monkeys.

reviews.author: jay w
reviews.title: Van Long nature reserve.
reviews.content: Van Long nature reserve is a less crowded option to explore near Ninh Binh very peaceful boat trip. An alternative to Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: Natural reserve
reviews.content: If you are interested in the natural world then this is a lovely experience. More rustic than the more commercial boat trips but the wildlife is better. Binoculars would be useful.

reviews.author: DaveO
reviews.title: Just Ok
reviews.content: Van Long wetlands boat trip didn't meet my expectations. One hour gentle row among the cliffs. You don't get far from the road - we were in sight of the road for half the time. Saw distant monkeys. The main impression of cranes were the industrial kind (pic). To avoid the crowds, i went late,  got started on rowboat at 16:10, one of the last boats out. We were always in sight of other boats, sometimes a mini armada. There was no feeling of remote jungle.  I thought the Tam Coc and Trang An boat trips were better - more crowded but better scenery. Boats cost minimum 200k, or 100k per person, whichever is greater. Plenty of boats carried 3 touristos.As a friendless solo it was thus, quite expensive for me. The location on google and maps.me is problematic. If going by scooter, aim for Gia Van: the dock is at the top (north) end of that village. Loads of restaurants, shops etc. Driving via Trang An is by far the most pleasant route. I wish I'd gone earlier in the day and driven more of the little roads heading in to the karst from around GV - they were more promising, as yoozh, than the tourist destination. I never seem to learn.

reviews.author: BellaDonna
reviews.title: Relax day
reviews.content: Lovely relaxed boat trip, but saw no monkeys and very few birds. Nice area for cycling and the food in the restaurant is excellent

reviews.author: Guide53752047682
reviews.title: Amazing time
reviews.content: We went here instead of Tam coc and Trang An as wildlife is more for us and we were not disappointed. Took a private car from Tam Coc.Our lady boat rower was lovely and when she knew we loved wildlife and were not there for Instagram selfies she slowed down and stopped at all the little animals and birds that we could see this included Langurs, we had them right next to the boat for about half an hour, we could not believe how lucky we were. She never rushed us to move on. She even got excited at seeing them so close.

reviews.author: seeking.4.endorphine
reviews.title: Fantastic bird watching and wildlife tour with Luc Nguyen
reviews.content: The Van Long Nature Reserve is part of the dry Halong Bay, but fortunately has not yet been discovered by mass tourism. We were here in the low season (beginning of November) and it was very quiet. We really enjoyed the boat trip. The landscape, the peace, the isolation, the wildlife make the trip a unique experience.We booked our tour through ecoguidevietnam. With the help of our tour guide, Luc, we were able to see the rare Delacour langurs of Vân Long Nature Reserve. Fortunately, Luc is also a professional birdwatcher/ornithologist, so we were able to do extensive bird watching (White-browed Crake, Cinnamon and Yellow Bittern, Black Bittern, Pheasant-tailed Jacana, Bonellii’s Eagle, Egrets, Herons, etc.).We tipped the rower after the trip, which she was very happy about.We also went to Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park with Luc. It was also a very nice tour.Thank you Luc, we will recommend you!

reviews.author: Bodil M
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: Peaceful paddle- boat tour through this rare and wonderful nature. Was lucky to see a monkey sitting anong the trees and also a little snake. But more than that was the peacefulnes gliding through the nature this way the best.  We only met a few other tourists here.

reviews.author: kenny.
reviews.title: Peaceful boat ride away from tourists
reviews.content: Brought here by Ninh bình private day trip from Ha Noi as alternative boat ride in Trang an. Very calm, peaceful wetland surrounded by huge mountain range. On the ride we saw varieties of birds. We only met 2 other boats on the way back. Our guide said as it located a bit far from all the main sights in Ninh Binh so no tourist buses around. We didn’t see the langurs here but we heard the sound of them. So if you have time, recommend do this boat tour.

reviews.author: sensable
reviews.title: Worth for the boat trip
reviews.content: This is a very unique place in the world. The boat trip to find the delacour langur is peaceful and very nice. The accommodations and food are limited but you can make the most of it.

reviews.author: Rahul K
reviews.title: Simply breathtaking natural beauty
reviews.content: We were lucky to stay near this place and we could simply go near the reserve in the morning for a walk and it’s breathtakingly beautiful…Whole road goes along the reserve for almost 16 kms and it’s sheer cliff side looks beautiful… It’s amazing how calms and beautiful it is…There are birds around and this is an ideal self space for anyone…Enjoy riding your cycle or have a good walk when you are here

reviews.author: Geraint L
reviews.title: Let your troubles drift away....
reviews.content: A great way to spend an hour in the peace & quiet of gently being rowed through the dramatic scenary.We were lucky enough to see a monkey, climbing uo one of the sheer cliffs & then a real treat, a kingfisher, we saw a flash of blue as it flew away & then were lucky that it landed close by to give us a photo to treasure.Be sure to tip your boat capt well, they earn their money thats for sure

reviews.author: Linda Khanh
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: Such a beautiful place! Thank Vietnam Escape Tours helping me get here. River is very clean and fresh air

reviews.author: lorenzocaratti
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.content: Looking up lonely island, we thought it would be a great place to visit. The price is ok but the experience left us bored. The boat lady asked us money at the end (no added stuff). We gave her a tip and she continued to ask for more. Lost its spirit... honestly, we've seen much more beautiful with identical landscapes in the northern-eastern parts of vietnam.

reviews.author: Alu-Poo
reviews.title: Not that many birds
reviews.content: We mainly went here to see birds. There were a few, but not many. The boat ride is very nice, ending in a cave. Beautiful landscape and once in a while a bird taking off (they are very shy). We haven't seen the monkeys. There are not many tourists here, making it a quiet experience. We were a couple and had our own boat. Tam Coc and Trang An are much busier. We spent three days in Ninh Binh and had the time to visit this. However, if you have only time for one boat ride, I would recommend Trang An or Tam Coc. On the Trang An boat ride we have seen about the same number of species of birds as here in Van Long.

reviews.author: aurelieche2016
reviews.title: Beautiful, relaxing experience
reviews.content: Definitely one of our highlights of the trip. I visited this place with my husband and during our visit to Van Long Nature Reserve we got to see beautiful reflections in the waters and the prettiest water lilies. Definitely a must for lovers of flowers :)

reviews.author: Jean D
reviews.title: Poetic Scenery
reviews.content: Perfect for a romantic couple getaway! My wife and I really enjoyed it, and we recommend to do this trip in the late afternoon for amazing sunset views

reviews.author: RG02
reviews.title: Well worth visiting and quieter than either Trang An or Tam Coc
reviews.content: It was a dull day when we visited but that didn’t spoil our enjoyment of Van Long. Our lady rower spoke a little English and took the time to explain much that we saw as we went around. Several boats overtook us as we were rowed at a more leisurely pace but this meant we could take in so much more. We came to what looked like the turning point in our journey, all of the boats ahead went briefly inside a cave before coming back out for the return journey. We entered the cave expecting to do the same but were told  ‘heads down’ as we ventured further in, soon we saw some light ahead, this was our ‘exit’. We had come through into a beautiful, quiet oasis, no other boats around us. A circular route through some lovely scenery brought us back to the point to re-enter the cave before continuing back to our starting point via a different waterway. The only disappointment was that we didn’t see any langur monkeys as we had been told they were in the area. A lovely different trip, do it if you can spare some time.

reviews.author: Henry_Chloe
reviews.title: Memorable moment...
reviews.content: Luckily we chose this place in the best season! Getting on the sampan, all we need to do was relaxing and admiring the scene along the river.We had wonderful time on the late Valentine’s Day...

reviews.author: Jacky R
reviews.title: Not many monkeys
reviews.content: Nice boat trip with nice scenery. The Langurs weren’t very accommodating as they were far away from the boat and there were only four of them but we also saw some interesting birds including a Kingfisher.

reviews.author: anikgupta_virgo
reviews.title: Average experience for me but maybe good for others.
reviews.content: I went to Van long Nature reserve with more expectations than what i had in reality. i already had similar experience hence it was not surprising or very good for me. but few fellow travellers enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Cameron Y
reviews.title: Peaceful ride thru the waterways
reviews.content: Shorter boat ride than the others in Tam Coc and Trang An. OK if you have spare time. Boat ride is about 1hr

reviews.author: Josefer M
reviews.title: The landscape Amazing
reviews.content: You will appreciate the most hiding gardens and wild treasures that one of the most beautiful areas of Vietnam give you to fulfil the senses. The have trails and hiking unforgettables the prices very reasonables and the culinary culture  wonderful.

reviews.author: Rico
reviews.title: Natural with Wildlife!
reviews.content: Of all the river rowboat rides that we took around Ninh Binh, we agreed that this one was our favorite because of the Wildlife and nature. We saw so many fish and snails in the water and it was truly a natural setting nothing manmade or built except of course the little rustic rowboats. We had a wonderful guide, she couldn’t speak to us but, she showed up the monkeys in the trees, the snails and their pink larvae, fishes and seaweeds. She took us through a very tight cave and around about back out. It was a very memorable trip. I think for that it was the best.

reviews.author: Oerderan
reviews.title: A place of extraordinary natural beauty
reviews.content: There are a few boat tours on offer in and around Ninh Binh, but as we had already explored the Phong Nha Cave by boat recently, we figured that it would be difficult to trump, so we were looking for something a bit different. The Ramsar listed Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve proved to be a wise choice. My 15 year old son and I did some reading up on the site and we were keen to see the critically endangered Delacour’s langurs in the wild. The spectacular backdrop and proximity to our accommodation was an added bonus.However, it wasn’t all smooth sailing. We specifically asked the tour operators on shore to see the monkeys, in the hope we would be assigned a guide with a talent for finding them. Amazingly, the various guides on the Wetland shore attempted to spot the monkeys by eye hundreds of metres away on their limestone karst homes.After launching into the wetlands, our guide, worryingly rowed directly toward an area where motorised equipment was being used to conduct weeding in the conservation area. I think it’s great that efforts are being made to prevent weeds from taking over the wetlands, but what hope would we have in spotting the langurs with all of this commotion? I’m not a monkey expert, but I was certain that the monkey spotting expedition was not going to reap any rewards for us. And that’s where this story takes a turn. Our guide seemed to be heading back toward our boat launch when he took a change in direction. We suddenly found ourselves alone in the wetlands and in relative tranquility despite only having left the noisy weeders 5-10 minutes earlier. And then suddenly a langur family appeared at the base of the limestone karst outcrop. After an initial flurry of amateur photographing, we sat back and watched the langur family slowly ascend the limestone cliff face foraging as they went, as the sun slowly set over the wetlands. Sheer beauty! It’s also worth mentioning here that tips are expected by the guides, which caught us off guard. It’s not in my homeland’s custom to give tips and I thought that of Vietnam as well, until we tried bidding farewell to our guide. I fumbled the tip giving process and was unable to appease my guide.Lastly, I wish there were an interpretation centre at the Van Long Wetland Nature Reserve. It’s natural assets definitely deserve it and may help bolster their conservation efforts.

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: A magical afternoon.
reviews.content: Three of us shared a rental car and driver to get here and we shared the same boat to explore the marshes. Arriving a little early, we took a walk along the levee from which we could look down on the wetland and see many of the birds. But when we got on the boat, our perspective changed and we saw new birds, some close up, which our boatwoman pointed out for us. What she lacked in English she made up for in good nature and sharp eyes. Having crossed the wetland she piloted us up a channel into the limestone massif. Suddenly she cried "Monkey!" and there they were, four rare and striking black and white Delacour langurs on the cliff face. She gave us plenty of time to watch before turning back. Even then we weren't finished; we saw another group of five adult and three young langurs on the way back. And we saw flights of egrets come in to the marsh to roost.We started our boat ride at 3.30 pm and saw the first langurs at 4 pm, just the time we had been told that they become active. Our smiling cheerful boat lady didn't even hint at the tip she so richly deserved.

reviews.author: Andrew_J_Berry
reviews.title: Get there early
reviews.content: A great place to visit, but go early to avoid the crowds. Small boats rowed by locals take you through a sample of the wetland reserve. Very peaceful as you listen to the gentle paddling and soak up the scenery.

reviews.author: srvctraveler
reviews.title: Fabulous natural area that remains only lightly discovered - A must see before others find it.
reviews.content: This is a beautiful nature preserve in Ninh Binh province that hasn't been discovered and over-run with tourists like Trang An and Tam Coc.  Similar natural features, but smaller scale, and the boat tours are still run by the locals on a small scale.  We went out in a small bamboo boat paddled by a friendly young woman who made conversation in her limited English and our limited vietnamese, but she taught us the names of birds, pulled snails out of the water to show us. We saw quite a few water birds, including storks, though we didn't get to see the Langurs who are native to the area (we think we heard some vocalizing however).  Most of the other visitors were Vietnamese families and groups on a sunday outing, all of whom, including the children, wanted to greet us.  Unlike Trang An and Tam Coc, we didn't feel pressured to buy anything or tip, though we were delighted to tip this young woman who had given us such a pleasurable visit.

reviews.author: snowkone007
reviews.title: Got followed to parking lot after
reviews.content: Zero stars. Boring tour, boat rower did not interact at all, was told after that I HAVE to tip, I did, was told it HAS to be atleast 50,000d. I have NO problem tipping (I am a waitress) but a tip is given for good service, experience, etc which I did not have. Was then followed to the parking lot by lady. If I HAVE to tip, include it in the price because I only tip when tipping is appropriate.

reviews.author: Neil R
reviews.title: Canoeing in the w ilderness
reviews.content: Probably the best thing we did in Ninh Binh. Hire the local boatsmen to take a trip within the reserve and explore caves and nature in all its glory. wonderful way to spend a morning

reviews.author: thong pham
reviews.title: It was a great place that really happen with ecotourism. The place combining of the water, limestone like a paiting
reviews.content: Van Long NR is a place that you can see Delacour langur - an endemic species which is only 250 individuals left in the world. Enjoying with the water, limestone on a very simple boat that for sure you never experience before.

reviews.author: Zuzka123
reviews.title: Spectacular views without hordes of tourists
reviews.content: Possibly not as picturesque as the nearby Trang An reserve…but also not with gazillions of tourists. It was around 40 degrees when we visited with our seven year old son, so a 90mins boat trip instead of 3 to 4 hours at Trang An was far more manageable. Van Long reserve gave us a good peek into this world of narrow waterways and floating mountains.We didn’t see any monkeys, which was a shame, but the tranquility and peacefulness of this spectacular place were worth it. I felt really bad for the woman rowing our boat, she was quite old and it was so hot I worried she might just have a heart attack...

reviews.author: khoalegend
reviews.title: It take a lot of time but useless
reviews.content: If you had visit all the site of ninh binh & want to discover, Van Long is the last scene. Its popular after king kong film. The price of ticket is 2$ for 1 hour boat trip. If you had seen Trang An sightseeing, van long cant compared with it

reviews.author: vocalisa
reviews.title: still a hidden gem
reviews.content: a natural habitat of the endangered Delacour langurs, a species of primates you find in the North East just outside the UNESCO landscape complex. An ensemble of rocks surrounded by water which is declared a wetland nature reserve, home of rare species of birds and other animals. Especially in the mornings and sunny afternoons you can very often watch the monkeys climbing on the rocks searching for their diet of leaves.  A visit in the late afternoon will often reward you with an impressive sunset and the view onto the storks and egrets returning to their sleeping places on the trees near the rocks. Recently a new hotel with restaurant opened opposite the ticket booth, otherwise the setting is still modest and simple and just adorable and different every time and every season. My favourite. Try to avoid grumpy looking rowers. Tip the friendly ones with 50 k per boat.

reviews.author: DiNg|photographer
reviews.title: It's good for a day out of city
reviews.content: We went to Van Long last week. The tickets were 100k vnd for 2 people. The tour is 1 hour with boat (2 people 1 bat) among the Van Long natures. The sightseeing is ok but not as great as Trang An or Tam Coc, however, with people who like things be more natured would love this place. The boater suggested us to take another 1 hour tour (he said new tour) to a quite area (good view) with charge 100k vnd. We were ok. The view looks very good. It looks like a small valley compare to Nho Que (in Ha Giang). Everything is ok until the boater charged us 250k vnd. He said 200k vnd for the tour and 50k it is for the tips. We sai we bought tickets for 100k and we gave him 200k. He looks not so happy. And at the beginning, he looks surprise when we gave him the tickets. So I am not sure, will the tickets are paid for the services or not.

reviews.author: LinhVu
reviews.title: Yes - Yes - Yes
reviews.content: Unlike the very crowded Trang An, at Van Long Nature Reserve we can have more time for ourselves to enjoy the nature, the quietness & if we’re lucky enough we can see langurs in the nature by our own eyes. The area has 3 different routes 1-2-3 hours depends on our time availability, we choose the 1-hour route & it covered an appropriate scale. Do give some tips to the boat ladies/men, about US$2/passenger (or VND50k)

reviews.author: Irish_Food_Dude
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: We did this tour with 3 small kids (3, 5 & 8), we took 2 boats so the overall cost was 100k VND per boat. We tipped 50k per boat as the rowers were so good with the kids - they gave them turns rowing, went to the banks to pick flowers, took photos of our family & taught us how to sing Happy Birthday in Vietnamese!!Scenery is nothing like Trang An, much more simple, but we went first thing in the morning (around 9am) and had the river to ourselves so it was perfectly quiet except for the wildlife.The cave was really cool but luckily we did this tour before Trang An so we didn’t have a benchmark for cool caves!If you’re selecting just one boat tour I’d recommend Trang An as the preferred one but I’m glad we did both.

reviews.author: winter
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.content: Little bit disappointed in this area where i expect it will be nice trip. Ticket is 60,000 vnd for boat trip and 20,000 vnd for sightseeing. boat trip is quite short and not much to see on the side of the river, the  cave is tiny and look average. The rower did their job but keep pushy about tips. Overall I wont be back.

reviews.author: Bill Rogers
reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.content: Another amazing place to visit.So beautiful and tranquil.Another of nature's wonders for everyone.

reviews.author: Varun_723
reviews.title: 1 Hour Of Relaxation
reviews.content: My wife and I spent an hour being rowed around the Van Long Nature Reserve. This boat ride is much shorter than the one in Trang An, with the latter being closer to 3 hours. If you're planning on visiting both places, I recommend you do Van Long first, and then Trang An so you don't set the bar too high. Van Long doesn't have an awful lot to look at, whereas Trang An does. If you're looking for a scenic ride, this probably isn't the one for you. It's still worth checking out as you get to see storks up close (depending on the time of the day). Just buy a drink or some snacks from the shops nearby and make the best of the trip. The rower will ask you for a tip upon completion of the ride, but considering the exchange rate, a tip doesn't cost much. My tour guide recommended a tip of no more than 100,000 dong. If they ask for more, refuse.

reviews.author: suzieslapcabbage
reviews.title: A tranquil piece of paradise
reviews.content: A great value excursion throughout a beautiful wetland. Our boat rower took us on what looked like one of the less used waterways, meaning we were the only boat (just the two of us and the rower) most of the time; it was so quiet, tranquil and beautiful. The scenery is amazing with the beautiful limestone mountains, caves, birds, fish, baby snails, and flora. We we’re very lucky to see the rare (endangered) Delacour’s Langur, 5 in fact. Our rower stopped the boat and we sat for 10+ minutes watching these beautiful monkeys jump, swing and move around in front of us (wish we had our binoculars). Van Long Nature Reserve was more than we expected, so glad we went there.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.title: Nice and a bit off the track
reviews.content: Beautiful views and is probably less busy compared to Trang An and Tam Coc boat trips. BUT you should still go on a boat trip in Trang An, too! Did both and preferred Trang An. But I think I only preferred Trang An because the scenery is nicer and because I was lucky that my boat was the only one at the time (which is absolutely unbelieveable but true). At peak time Trang An and Tam Coc boat tours are soooo crowded that for those who are crowd-o-phobic travellers might prefer Van Long which is beautiful as well.

reviews.author: Albywon
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: Despite the large number of other boats near you it is still possible to enjoy this landscape. We managed to find peace and it was a beautiful day to float through the area.

reviews.author: Susan L
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.content: We decided to take this day trip from Hanoi in conjunction with a trip to Trang An/Bai Dinh and am so glad we did. The largest temple and pagoda in Vietnam as well as the beautiful natural surroundings make this destination not to be missed. I would say it is easily on par with Halong Bay!

reviews.author: Lya_amar
reviews.title: Hidden Gem of Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Far far away from city, crowds, pollution. Great way to connect your soul with nature.. :) About 30min motorbike ride from Ninh Binh to Van Long Nature Reserve.. 100k dong for 1 hour boat ride.. Love this place :)

reviews.author: Mark C
reviews.title: Peaceful Boat Trip to Enjoy Nature Reserve
reviews.content: Took the boat trip to observe the langur primates and watch birds. Very worthwhile visit.Beautiful scenery.

reviews.author: E J J
reviews.title: Ethereal Wonder
reviews.content: This boat ride definitely has that other worldly feel to it. Such beauty in silence and nature. Spotted many water birds and monkeys. Loved the majesty of the place, and the lack of crowds jostling for position. A moment of peace and tranquillity.

reviews.author: Naestchen
reviews.title: Wonderful boat trip through the reserve
reviews.content: We were staying at the Emeralda Hotel and booked a trip with them to go on a bike and a boat tour. We cycled a lot through the area next to the Van Long Nature Reserve and enjoyed the beautiful view. After having visited a temple we went back to the starting point of the boat trips and took a one hour long trip on a wooden boat. The lady who navigated us was nice although she did not really speak English. The landscape consisting of the mountains, the water and the cage is amazing! We'd definitely recommend the trip!

reviews.author: boscobobbie
reviews.title: Peaceful, otherworldly, beautiful
reviews.content: Much quieter than the Trang An Grottoes, Cranes, frogs, monkeys on the hillsides. Bullrushes and caves, misty mountains and birdsong. An enchanting boat ride, guides responsive and helpful. Evening ride recommended.

reviews.author: Coco
reviews.title: SO quiet and nice
reviews.content: SO quiet and nice whereas the other places are crowded! Views are beautiful and we saw monkeys on the rocks...and birds! Perfect

reviews.author: Lee A D
reviews.title: Second best thing to do in Bình Minh
reviews.content: We loved Trang An but also really enjoyed this Nature Preserve.  Long path beside it as well that we used with a tandem. Highly recommend the peace and raw nature of this large place.

reviews.author: Lee Đặng
reviews.title: Traveling to Van Long swamp in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Van Long natural reservation area is away from Ha Noi about 80km, which is located at the Northeast, Gia Vien district, Ninh Bình Province. This is the most abundant place for ecosystem that is the residence of many flora and fauna such as: Fish, Bird, stork and more than 40 kinds of Delacour’s Langur.Besides, Van Long ecotourism destination has great scene of mountain and river, tourists can sit on the old bamboo boat and enjoy the simple and peaceful view.After traveling through the mountain, tourists can visit the Fish Cave, which is one of the most beautiful cave here with the romantic scene, small valley and the mountain surround. If lucky, tourists can see some langurs sitting on the trees.

reviews.author: Kassa
reviews.title: spotted 8 langur in the wild!
reviews.content: lovely boat ride, quiet, beautiful waterways and we were very lucky to see the Langur.  Tickets for the boat are inexpensive but the boat driver will hassle for the same again in a cash tip at the end!

reviews.author: youbloodytourist
reviews.title: Less crowds, more atmosphere!
reviews.content: Out of all three of the 'boat' experiences in Ninh Binh province (Tam Coc and Trang An) being the other two, this one was the quietest. That alone makes it worthwhile! Less to see than Trang An, but less commercial / more authentic.

reviews.author: Wanderlustsimone
reviews.title: The scenery is stunning!
reviews.content: That's one thing you can't deny, how incredibly beautiful your surroundings are, and for me, that made the trip worth it, that's why I was there! however, I thought we would get to stop off at some of the pagodas, like others did, but we didn't stop once. We were taking it in turns rowing between my partner and I and the couple sat behind us. The lady rowing at the back gave us questionnaires about half way through which gave me a red flag, because it said 'did your guide ask for a tip?' to which we put no at the time. I knew that If a company thought to give a questionnaire on a small BOAT trip. Something dodgy was happening. The woman proceeded towards the end of the tour to point at her hands and ask for a tip. If it wasn't for the fact she'd conned us into filling that questionnaire out before she asks for a tip which I presume isn't allowed, I would have gladly tipped without being asked. Still go, just be aware!

reviews.author: LA4man
reviews.title: Get up early and look for Delacour's Langur
reviews.content: I had the privilege of visiting Van Long twice in 2018.  The first time we woke up very early and did a boat ride at Van Long. The cost is about $2 for an hour of rigorous paddling by the boatsman (or woman as is often the case).  We were the first people out for the day, and were fortunate to see three (3!!) of the very endangered Delacour's Langur (white bottomed monkey) eating in the trees on the cliffs and running along  the cliff tops.  Stunning!  The second time I took the boat later in the morning and was not so lucky to see the monkeys.  However, the next day I got up early, took a bike from the hotel, and rode along the levy (to the left as you face the river once you ride up the street from the small town).  Voila! I was able to see one monkey running along the cliff, and the bike ride was AMAZING.   If you turn right at the river you'll see a monstrous building in the distance which is a mega-cathedral being built by a very rich local businessman.  While it's still a nice ride, I prefer the left and more of natural view.  Enjoy!

reviews.author: matamatablondie
reviews.title: No monkeys!
reviews.content: If you are expecting to see monkeys you will be disappointed - not sure if this is promoted officially, however the map provided by our homestay states this had wild monkeys.  It was a beautiful scenic boat ride however you do not get off the boat unlike Trang An boat tour which I would recommend over this even at 4 times the price. Very authentic - be ready for a sore butt. You will be expected to tip 50,000 VND.

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.title: Not bad but...
reviews.content: We were the first customers of the day, nice and early to try to spot the birds. We saw a few, but not as many as we'd hoped. The scenery was beautiful, however, I was almost constantly tapped on my shoulder by the lady rowing the boat, to let me know how hard she was working and that her hands were calloused. We gave her 20k Dong  tip (over 50% of the price of the ride) and she gave it back, saying it wasn't enough. This is totally unacceptable in my opinion. She even got a friend of hers to run after us, asking for more money!Sadly, that ruined the trip for us.

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: Good place for bird watching
reviews.content: Although this place is a bit of a drive from Ninh Binh, it's worth a visit if you're interested in wetlands habitat. Upon arrival I paid 10k to park my motor bike and 60k for entrance fee/boat ticket. It's a bit confusing, but you have to walk across the road and down some steps to reach the boats. Boats are meant for 2 adults, no more. The early part of the paddle is where we saw the most birds, in the open area before we reached the cliffs. The portion adjacent to the cliffs offered beautiful views of the sheer limestone cliffs. Very peaceful, as we paddled along, just the swish of the oars. We went through one short and very dark cave (with low headroom!) then paddled around in a big arc and back through the cave. Overall the trip was about 90 minutes.

reviews.author: Wandering_Ozzie
reviews.title: A bit disappointing
reviews.content: The only real positive of this trip is that it's a lot cheaper than the other boat rides but you have to pay to get there and there is a lot less to see.  However i did go in the morning, perhaps there would be more wildlife in the evening?

reviews.author: Gratadour D
reviews.title: Comfortable the view nice
reviews.content: it is gorgeous. It's a colony of wild critically endangered Delacour Langurs plus is an incredible area for a birdwatchers.I've been a couple of times and I believe it is truly at it is perfect when it's somewhat overcast. You've a much better possibility of seeing the wildlife and it's an eerie calm which is enchanting. The simplest way to check out the reserve is taking a slow boat ride. It is lovely and relaxing and also will be a highlight of anyone's drive to the place.

reviews.author: Gommycmbn
reviews.title: Magic place
reviews.content: We went to Van long reserve early in the morning so we were alone on the river, It was very quiet, with amazing views A very good moment

reviews.author: jose
reviews.title: Beautiful boat trip
reviews.content: Experience that is amazing, a lovely landscape, allthough cave is remarkable plus they're satisfied with each tip you provide, here there have been pleased and requested for the double!

reviews.author: Michel W
reviews.title: Very nice nature, but...
reviews.content: We booked the trip trough our Hotel. We enjoyed the tour itself a lot. We've seen approximately 10 monkeys, which is very rare, and a lot of white birds. It was 4.30 p.m. when we started the boat trip. That's why we haven't met many tourists on our way and we could enjoy the sunset. At the end of the boat trip we were very disappointed by the behaviour of the driver because he asked for a tip and after we gave him 30k VND he asked impolite for 50k VND. That's a no-go!

reviews.author: Lou F
reviews.title: Very Tranquil and not busy
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed this quiet peaceful tour.  It was about 1 1/2 hrs in a small bamboo boat.  We were lucky to see 4 or 5 monkeys jumping from tree to tree.Very relaxing!

reviews.author: Journoud
reviews.title: In touch with nature
reviews.content: Van Long is a renowned land, a gorgeous place as well as the largest natural reserve of wetlands. You will find has mountain ranges creates an all natural wall surrounded a great expanse of water. In case you fortunate you are able to envision the monkey on the mountain.The boatman really amusing, they'll be proven to help you little fish on the river, additionally, they really clever when to make use of leg for rowing boat. Place that is beautiful to check out.

reviews.author: Arcady Travel
reviews.title: leave the modern life behind
reviews.content: I got Van Long by a scooter we took from the hotel. Just 30 mins from the center, through the highway 1. Van Long seem a rare beautiful place was forgotten by the commercialize of the city. We took a boat trip in 1 hour to visit Van Long Nature Reserve, very quiet and humid. Ticket around 3 usd, and tip for the rower 2 usd at the end. Very good price for a nice experience.

reviews.author: tsvyatko
reviews.title: Peaceful trip
reviews.content: The reserve is 30min by taxi from Ninh  Binh train station. It is very peaceful and not so crowded compared to Tam Coc and Trang An. During the boat trip we saw some animals (blue birds, some fish, insects...). There was a cave which was a bit dark and scary but it’s worth it. We can easily take pictures. It is very quite at the and of the afternoon around 4-5pm.

reviews.author: Настенька Б
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: Nevertheless, the wonderful experience of ours on the Van Long preserve was totally different. We got right into a boat near the conclusion of the day, and also for the following hour were rowed by a pleasing female through this incredibly scenic mountain and marsh preserve. We watched a large number of birds as well as the peaceful calmness of the marsh was a nice respite and also reward from touring the bumpy and hectic roads of Vietnam. Although there was absolutely no tunnels to row through, we'd gladly return here for such an excellent backyard experience.

reviews.author: Carl R
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.content: Beautiful experience, such a peaceful and quiet surrounding, and our guide James, always there to make us feel safe and well, made it an unforgettable trip!!!

reviews.author: liefie73
reviews.title: Very beautiful
reviews.content: It’s about a 1 hour tour on a Vietnamese rowing boat through a calm and well-preserved swamp (1.30m deep max) where you can see a myriad of birds, insects, fishes, monkeys (on the Ridge of the mountain) - inexpensive - friendly service- great experience

reviews.author: DavidPham
reviews.title: Very peaceful but it depends on our luck.
reviews.content: This place is not far from Hanoi which takes us 1.5 hours only to go to here from Hanoi!This place is less touristic and the boat men or boat women are more friendly!The boat trip lasts around 1 hour so that we could go around a swamp established in 1962 by building a dyke system along!if we are lucky we see white-short langur(rarest langur in vn).Boat ticket is 60.000 dong per boat.Entrance fee is 20.000 dong per person!

reviews.author: Annie Ad
reviews.title: Very peaceful!
reviews.content: Very peaceful! relaxing. Enjoy natural and landscape, limestone , mountain, lake and river, all wonderfull!

reviews.author: Son D
reviews.title: Nature reserve
reviews.content: Great landscapes with open atmosphere, quiet and pure atmosphere. Felt quite organically and superbly with the incredible landscape, The journey was really worth of value which created by Customized Tour, Mr Tin that was very valuable by organizing us the fantastic drive to Van Long Nature Reserve

reviews.author: Judas
reviews.title: Quiet nature reserve
reviews.content: We have gone to the reserve in the morning, the light was ideal to have photographs as well as we actually enjoyed the visit of ours here. It was serene and quiet, very, just a couple of boats in the bath. This particular place is very gorgeous!

reviews.author: Gavin C
reviews.title: Langur monkeys!
reviews.content: We took note of previous reviews and went later in they day (arrived at 4pm) and it ticked all the boxes. Saw plenty of bird life, insects and best of all langur monkeys climbing the rock face near the entrance to the cave - counted at least a dozen and even a baby. Our rower (man) was excellent and waited patiently until they had all disappeared, in fact was almost as excited as we were at seeing them so we tipped him 100,000 as he also slowed the boat when nearing birds so as not to scare them. He seemed very happy with the tip and no scowls at all   We went on a Sunday which is when all the bridal couples seem to go as well which is quite hilarious with all the poses and shouting cameramen. This was only at the end , the rest of the ride was extremely peaceful with only one other boat sighted.

reviews.author: Suz
reviews.title: Very quiet place
reviews.content: It was a less tourist area and the boat ride was quiet and has beautiful view. Unfortunately, could not catch the monkey in action. Probably will be good to go in the early morning.

reviews.author: cherry_streets
reviews.title: beautiful, peaceful place for walking and birdwatching
reviews.content: What struck us about this place was that it was huge and there were very few tourists! We weren't planning on spending too much time here as we had already done so many activities in the morning. If we hadn't been exhausted, we could have easily spend the large part of the day here. Make sure you wear footwear that can get wet, as going into the caves, you walk on these bamboo paths that sink into the water. Maintenance of these could be better.We saw beautiful births and the thousand year old tree. Very unique!

reviews.author: Stuart
reviews.title: Explore the animals in Van Long Nature Reserve
reviews.content: We went late evening on a weekday and this was extremely quiet with not many boats out. We watched a number of waterbirds, but what made it really memorable was watching a troop of endangered langurs. We saw aproximatelly eight, together with some young ones. We could view them for ten minutes leaping across rocks and descending from trees. The boatman was extremely helpful, and also when we asked in case there was monkeys, he loked for a couple of mins and spotted them for us. At the turnaround point within the cave, the boatman requested for the camera of ours plus required many pictures for us. In case you're staying at Emerald you do not have to book their bike tour in case you do not wish to as it's just a short hike. We feel this's an interesting spot to visit

reviews.author: Joseph P
reviews.title: Misty day boat ride with the parents
reviews.content: The boat ride was nice through the Van Long reserve. It wasn't too long of a trip and the old lady paddling was friendly and would point to different birds and say their names in Vietnamese. It's usual custom to give a tip at the end say ~100K. We ended up winding back into the mouth of a small cave and double-backed. Overall, it was about an hour long trip.I would NOT recommend motorbiking or going around Van Long though, as the truth is a sad reality. In the front is this beautiful facade of nature and wildlife but behind is just trash mounds and industrial plants, lumber yards, massive mining pits, construction and polluted landfills.

reviews.author: On dreams
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: This is mostly a motorboat ride by using wetlands. The scenery is beautiful. We noticed many birds and monkeys. The boat ride will last for one hour and half ours swung around in the cave according to several of the reviews it sounds as if it is able to go more. I suppose it depends whom you get. We then went for a long, smooth walk next towards the wetlands this's an excellent 2 3hr trip could be easily put together with anything different.

reviews.author: Hurryup2011
reviews.title: Not crowded
reviews.content: Nice place . Not to much tourist for visit at that time. Clean water boat service also very good but little bit expensive. We enjoyed very much. We are happy . You can visit this palace .

reviews.author: Tam Le Vietnam
reviews.title: Not too much tourists
reviews.content: In the region having some wellknown places (quite similar) Tam Coc or Trang an. That's why at these places so crowded, full of tourist. If wanna looking for a non-touristic place, come here. 10km from central city.

reviews.author: Terrell D
reviews.title: Less tourists, quieter
reviews.content: You can't claim that this particular location is much less appealing compared to Tam Coc or maybe Trang A, though it's surely much less touristy and much more tranquil. The boat trip takes approximately 1.5 hours and would have been ideal in case we would have spotted a few languages in the process.

reviews.author: Blue Dude
reviews.title: Beautiful, cheap
reviews.content: After touring Tam Coc in Ninh Binh Provence, my two photography associates have taken me to Van Long. Only approximately five boats had been out, late evening, not so popular weather wise. I'd a solo boat, the finale was incredible rolling the reserve. We did find the endanger monkey, seven of them emerge from the mountain side. Cheap to visit below. Generally provide the females that perform the rolling and tip. Just go, silent, beautiful and peaceful. Just complete a blog and guide of the trip of mine here.

reviews.author: Zea D
reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.content: The location is very tranquil, especially in the late evening when less guest plus quite around. This location now rare of guests so we are able to appreciate the best pure dynamics here without the contact of folk influence as in Trang an or maybe Tam coc.

reviews.author: Lucas
reviews.title: Very interesting to explore this place
reviews.content: This particular location is massive gorgeous swamp, the beauty functions are increased by limestone, villages as well as rice filed surround uniquely the dike is bearing a common picture of Vietnamese culture. situated alongside it's actually great resort, from below you are able to use to Cuc Phuong national park, Bai Dinh pagoda, and then to Hanoi easily. whether any travelers would love to extend an adventure drive to northwest or maybe northeast of Vietnam, it's certainly feasible, typically this's recommended spot to come for sightseeing, tradition exploration and calming combine.

reviews.author: Sheelah
reviews.title: A place for nature lovers
reviews.content: I've been there sometime with co-workers for inspection, but only recently, I took the family of mine there. This time is ideal for going to the region due to the attractiveness of the weather conditions of Autumn. We had taken a boat ride in a clean organic atmosphere, cheerful boat rowers, beautiful landscape, clear water, breathtaking surrounding. It it an unforgettable experience for the kids of mine. Recommend this particular journey for natural lovers.

reviews.author: Oconell Rhianna
reviews.title: Oasis
reviews.content: We walked the 500 m through our resort on the "tourist marina". You are able to purchase tickets for the boat excursion. Do not buy the journey through hotels or even tour operators as they ask more. We have towards the marina, at 8am and also had the entire boat ride, one along with a half time without seeing another motorboat. We went through a gorgeous cave, lotus flower plant beds and the most peaceful scenery. The dragonflies were stunning.

reviews.author: Jiar K
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.content: Get the boat trip which required approximately 1and a half hour along the river. During the early morning with sunrise or even sun set. The landscaping is exactly the same as Ha Long Bay, sea glass with a lot of storks, so when you lucky, you are able to discover wild monkey.

reviews.author: Godsell E
reviews.title: Great destination
reviews.content: Very peaceful this specific part of natural beauty. The lady rowing had extremely minimal English, but was excited about mentioning things of interest. We spent about a half and an hour in the bath, but neither heard nor saw some monkeys. The rowing person appeared to be fighting to obtain the task done so we attempted to assist that she seemed to appreciate..... or perhaps she was angling for an honest tip... which she got as well as was obviously very happy.

reviews.author: Doralynne
reviews.title: Gorgeous place
reviews.content: Nature Reserve of Van Long Wetland is but one appeal for individuals that wish to immerse in the world rather compared to tourist atmosphere. The boat trip takes much more than a single hour and only cover a tiny portion of the wetland. Unfortunately, I visited the location on a cold morning languors; so you guys must think about the weather conditions before the visit.

reviews.author: melin0a
reviews.title: A must trip
reviews.content: So peaceful and the scenery amazing, watch out for the rare Delacouri Langour or White Shorts Monkeys high on the Karsts, and the many Grebes and Chinese Herons.

reviews.author: Vietnam1988
reviews.country: Phong Nha-Ke Bang National Park, Vietnam
reviews.title: Boat Trip
reviews.content: Beautiful boat trip through this peaceful nature reserve. Great value for money. Much more so than Tam Coc & Trang An. Friendly boat staff who pointed out various animals including Langurs

reviews.author: Diva Vo
reviews.title: Peaceful tour
reviews.content: The drive to here was not the most scenic but the moment you cross where you obtain on the boat, it had been gorgeous for the whole journey. I got there earlier and was the only individual out of the bath for rather some time on a peaceful sunny day. Saw several fishermen out, but otherwise did not see a great deal of wildlife apart from the bats within the cave. We rowed by cave as well as around a tiny cove on the other side, quite a cool small tour.

reviews.author: Louise C
reviews.title: VERY under-rated - so glad our guide recommended this to us
reviews.content: We were meant to go to bird valley, but our guide advised that during summer this is not a good idea, so said he would take us to Van Long instead. SO glad he suggested this. We had already been to Trang An and Tam Coc, but this one had hardly anybody there and was exquisitely beautiful. We were able to get lots of photos without a bunch of boats in the background, it was quiet, peaceful and we even saw local monkeys playing in the mountains. Worth the 20-25 minute drive, absolutely.

reviews.author: Delgado
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: Compared to Tehran An Grottoes, this's a lot smaller and even further away. though there were many fewer visitors, although boat paddlers are usually more demanding of a suggestion. They need US dollars, rather compared to dong. A much quieter trip. though one cave going through then they wish to switch back, but you are able to ask for a complete turn around among the taller grass. But be well prepared to tip for which. I went earlier and the birds were continually sitting on the roof of the hills. It was really quite a sight.

reviews.author: Chloe_Nguyen83
reviews.title: A large wetland
reviews.content: We had a interesting journey from Hanoi to Ninh Binh by motorbike. I has fell in love with it in the first time, it's as beautiful as painting. The locals people said that we should take tour early in the morning and the later in the afternoon when the flocks and stocks returning to their nest. Therefore, i recommend that you should visit it in the end of your day tour. Beside, I think that apart from admiring the fresh water and air, magnificent landscape, you will have a chance to see the Delacour's langur on the mountains with your naked eye. Good price and beautiful view, impressive trip.

reviews.author: Gus
reviews.title: Quiet, feel the nature
reviews.content: We frequented Van Long on how returned through Cuc Phuong National Park. We were fortunate enough to see two groups on the endangered Delancours Langurs along the mountain sides of the paper, as well as numerous birds like herons, storks, kingfishers and bitterns. It's a beautiful boat ride and much quieter compared to Tam Coc or maybe Trang An. Highly advised!

reviews.author: Barton
reviews.title: Relax with nature
reviews.content: We had taken one day journey coming from Hanoi to Van Long then on to the warm springs at giving Kenh Ga. It was a long drive over a short distance, but the hour long row boat drive within the nature reserve was extremely calming and scenic. We really observed one Langur monkey, that made it well worth it. A relaxing drive after the stress of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Daoni Nguyen
reviews.title: Ninh Binh’s beauty
reviews.content: Worth a detour around here. The nature here is beautiful in it’s own way. A different side of Ninh Binh’s beauty. Slightly inconvenient, just like Tam Coc, staff insist to much on tips...

reviews.author: Lenore
reviews.title: Good!
reviews.content: This an impressive place to be, at all well worth seeing it when inside Vietnam, or at the very least when in North Vietnam

reviews.author: Jan-Olof O
reviews.title: Well worth a visit!
reviews.content: The manager at Vancouver hotel arranged for a private car to Van Long Nature reserve. I did go to see the Delacour langur in Van Long Nature reserve. There is an entrance of 60 000 Dong and a fee for the boat as well, I paid 100 000 Dong for the boat! You step into a small bamboo boat and a woman rows you into the reserve. You will follow a water canal into the mountains, at the mountains there is a 180 degree bend and a new canal behind the mountains you see from the entrance to the reserve. The journey will end up at a small cave maybe fifty meters deep which will be visited! When returning out from the cave we did see langurs up in the mountains on the left hind side of the boat. This is a little bit far away so look carefully and you might spot the Delacour langurs. There are also different kind of birds in this reserve.

reviews.author: ginsengNewYork
reviews.title: TOURIST TRAP, NOT WORTH IT
reviews.content: A real waste of time: you sit on a boat for 1 and 1/2 hr under scorching sun while an old Vietnamese lady rows and points at rocks far away shouting "monkey. monkey" which, of course you cannot distinguish...The sceney is not spectacular and you are also surrounded by many other such boats. After a while you arrive at a cave where you can cool down, then back to departure point. We were glad we had taken water and an umbrella as the pace is excruciatingly slow, and the sun very hot!  Did not see any birds, just some dragonflies!Would not do it again!And yes, the rower expects a nice tip at the end, the ride being so cheap. Who can blame them?

reviews.author: Wags1963
reviews.title: Great and so Scenic
reviews.content: This was a great boat tour along the river taking in the scenic surrounds.  We did a long tour about 2.5 hours but it was so relaxing to sit back and be rowed around.  The scenery was amazing and beautiful and I loved every minute of it.

reviews.author: Stove W
reviews.title: A must do
reviews.content: We went for a boat ride and this was completely mesmerising. Definitely taken by surprise just how picturesque and un spoilt this place was. The individuals rowing the boat were superb. Quietly went about the jobs of theirs and did not ask for any hints.

reviews.author: Leomahughley
reviews.title: Serene and Beautiful
reviews.content: We did the boat trip at the start of the early morning, remained at Emeralda Resort so it was a quick hike to capture the boat. It was very peaceful and stunning, and we just saw one additional boat the entire time we had been away, much somewhat more enjoying ready than the traveler areas. Took several great photo 's.

reviews.author: Jacqulynshow
reviews.title: Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Did the journey on 2nd day of drive to Ninh Binh. We'd gone to Tam Coc last day and discovered Van Long equally as gorgeous without any commercialism. There was also no many other tourists. Boats are a bit of uneasy for one hour though you overlook that when admiring the pure splendor of the school. Take an umbrella and a lot of water because while at 9am it was sexy.

reviews.author: Lulusurfdog
reviews.title: Beautiful Spot
reviews.content: We went there twice. One time we walked through; the second we biked. It is beautiful. I can't remember the name but the cove in the back filled with birds is one of the most beautiful places I've ever seen.

reviews.author: 795suzie
reviews.title: Peaceful Ride UNTIL the end
reviews.content: We were lucky to be the first boat on the water for the morning. It was very peaceful and we did get to see some monkeys in the trees. We had just come back from a 4 day trek further north where the scenery was spectacular, so the scenery was ok in comparison. What really ruined it was when the lady began continually saying, "souvenir, souvenir," as we neared the end of the ride (we weren't sure what she meant). The ride was only 50 000 VND per person and we were prepared to give a 75,000 tip but once we handed it to her we soon realised it was not enough. Her tone became hostile and then a male who worked for this organisation came over on his sampan and started shouting aggressively at us and held out 100 000 VND. I felt if we didn't give more we would continue to be harassed. We had wished we hadn't taken this sampan cruise,it was the worst experience we had on our three week tour of Vietnam. This was the only time during the three weeks we felt harassed and expected to tip an amount that matched the price for the cruise. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: john2146
reviews.title: Picturesque and calm
reviews.content: Much more relaxing and peaceful than the Tam Coc boat ride. Only 100k VND per boat. Saw monkeys on the cliff tops

reviews.author: DRGilbert
reviews.title: An idyllic cruise through a peaceful setting with monkeys to boot
reviews.content: It was late afternoon when we boarded our sampan for a leisurely cruise through the Van Long Nature Reserve. It was very peaceful as our oarsman pushed us along flooded rice fields beside rocky peaks. He stopped once, pointing excitedly toward the summit where we spotted a large Vietnamese monkey scampering along the rocks. A little further down the stream we entered the mouth of a small cave and then did a u-turn to return to the vanishing daylight. Soon we were back where we started. A an hour-long trip, well worthwhile.

reviews.author: RONIETAMI
reviews.title: This is a nature reserve.
reviews.content: This is a nature reserve. There are so many monkeys. We want to explore this reserve by boat. Van Long Nature Reserve is a worthy one of the ideal eco-tourism.

reviews.author: Steffen K
reviews.title: Nice scenery, annoying boat ladies.
reviews.content: We looked forward to this trip and hoped to see some monkeys. However, our boat ride (100k for two people) started of with the boat woman asking "Tip tip tip". At first we didn't understand, then we realized she asked for some additional money. Yes, it is quite cheap compared to Trang An, but this still shouldn't happen. It is a nice and quiet scenery if you are not surrounded by hundreds of koreans/Chinese, but we also weren't impressed too much. I think we should have chosen Trang An over Van Long...

reviews.author: Eric M
reviews.title: Air pollution in the area is hazardous to health
reviews.content: There are numerous cement factories that can be clearly seen from the reserve. These factories are sending clouds of silica dust into the air and the Nature Reserve is perpetually shrouded in a silica dust cloud. So bad is this that everything is covered in a layer of fine dust, from stall displays, coffee shop tables etc.This is a "dead" reserve. Riding out on the row boat, you can clearly see a suspension of fine dust on the surface and in the water itself. Not surprising, there are no fish or any living creatures alive in the water. In fact, in almost 2 hours spent on the row boat, we only spotted one fish. I photograph wildlife, and given the abundant flora in this swampy ecosystem, there should be an abundance of birds and other wildlife, but in truth, we only say 2-3 birds. And this is all the wildlife we saw throughout the boat trip.Sad to say, the ecosystem of Van Long is long destroyed. You risk your health being here.

reviews.author: engrob84
reviews.title: Serene
reviews.content: This place totally exceeded expectations. It’s so peaceful. It’s very cheap and there are so few visitors.

reviews.author: Expl0rer007
reviews.title: DELIGHTFUL
reviews.content: Van Long is a real delight.  Slipping gently along the waterways between the reed beds is restful and tranquil as the oarsman dips his oars into the reflective waters and nudges the sampan along.  Soaring limestone peaks brood like sentinels, keeping a watchful eye on your progress as the landscape changes by the minute.  Seeing a fish eagle and two Delacour's Langur were added bonuses.  The trip on the water is justification itself.  Highly recommended.  Go early, though, especially in the summer, when it can get very busy and noisy.

reviews.author: tonytD9568SZ
reviews.title: Beautiful river ride in a nature preserve
reviews.content: Preserve is located next to a canal and on the other side of a dike .most views will be of Karsts but building cranes can be seen in the distance on other side of canal so no total feeling of nature. 50.000VND/PPBoat trip is about an hour. If you have to choose between this  and Trang An. It depends...I'd say the latter. Yes this is less crowded and yes you'll see some birds and maybe a monkey or two but as far as total experience of boating the cavesI'd say Trang An.

reviews.author: varun_mukthi
reviews.title: An absolute must-do
reviews.content: This was a complete surprise. We went for a boat ride and it was completely mesmerising. Absolutely taken by surprise how picturesque and un-spoilt this place was. The people rowing the boat were excellent. Quietly went about their jobs and didn't ask for any tips. Off the beaten track and highly recommend it.

reviews.author: exquisitektc
reviews.title: Comparable to Trang An but Still Different
reviews.content: We started off the day by going for a quiet boat ride here. Our tour guide said that he pays the boat operators to go left while everyone else goes right but we are not certain that this is accurate information. Our two boats were the only boats out that day but probably because it was Tet. At any rate, the scenery here is different from Trang An. Whereas Trang An offered multiple cave experiences, this offered a gorgeous view of the lush waterscape and landscape, complete with beautiful white crane-looking birds, rare monkeys, and the peace and quiet that Trang An did not quite offer. If you only have time for one boat ride, it would be tough to choose. Van Long is surely a snippet and mere fraction of what Trang An offers. Either way, if you have time for both then we recommend touring both. If you have a little time on your hands, then Van Long is pleasing. If you have about three or more hours to spare then Trang An is worth the time. If peace and quiet is not your thing then this experience might not be for you.Also, make sure your tour guide doesn't jump on the boat with you. The nature reserve is best observed with two per boat, not including the boat operator of course.The negative part of this experience is that tipping our boat operator 50,000 was not enough. He literally stalked us to the car talking to our tour guide in Vietnamese with a tone that sounded like he was upset. Eventually, our tour guide pulled out 100,000 and gave it to him then he went away.Also, the two vendors near the parking lot sell cotton table covers that cannot be found elsewhere in NB. If you are looking for nice cotton gifts, these might certainly be for you. Our friend negotiated 800,000 for three. Great deal!

reviews.author: P F
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape!
reviews.content: Great spot that is well worth the visit. Rent the row boats and travel the river to experience the natural caves, wildlife and newly built temples. Go on a day when it’s not crowded for a truly peaceful nature experience. You’ll take a ton of photos of the beautiful mountains.

reviews.author: Marla R
reviews.title: Family trip 2018
reviews.content: You can get on a boat and have a rower take you through the wetlands/reserve. So beautiful to get up close to the mountains.

reviews.author: jaypep1
reviews.title: Lots of Nature
reviews.content: This is a stunning Wetlands Nature Reserve. All year round there is wildlife. The boat tours last about 1 hour and cost 80,000₫. Feb.2018. You buy the tickets from across the road on Gia Van Street at the ticket booth in the car park, behind the souvenir shops. Parking was free. If your into wildlife or just great scenery then it's well worth a visit. There is also a very large old Cathedral near by. The best photos I save for myself.

reviews.author: sanu
reviews.title: Better than trang ah, quite secluded and peaceful boating.
reviews.content: We skipped trang ah boating and came here and didn’t regret. The 1 hour boating was great with lot of birds, the view was not good for being a rainy day.

reviews.author: duncan_KS
reviews.title: Scenic and serene
reviews.content: When we planned to include this place as part of our private day trip, the tour operator told us this will be repetition as we will also cover Trang An boat trip in the same day, but we insisted. Glad that we made the decision as Van Long gave very different favour if compare with Trang An.We went to Van Long around 4pm, the atmosphere was very serene and reflection from the water was very clear to give many photograph opportunities.  We saw a lots of birds and impressive sunset. However, we couldn't witness the rare monkey species that we looked forward in Van Long. The boat ride was very relax. It will be great if the boatman doesn't ask us to give him specific amount of tip at the end of boat ride.

reviews.author: Dieset
reviews.title: The boat trip is a must
reviews.content: Just enjoy the fantastic boat trip through the caves and along the river. Amazing to see the way people were rowining the boats.

reviews.author: Raaj1976
reviews.title: Beautiful place with awesome views
reviews.content: This location is peaceful and mesmerizing. We enjoyed the journey and had all the fun with beautiful weather and joyful family time.

reviews.author: Adventure beyond imagination
reviews.title: Unforgettable experience
reviews.content: We decided to go there in order to avoid the crowds. While we arrived there nobody else was around. The boat trip was so fantastic and we were literally alone in the middle of the wonderful scenery.

reviews.author: amclean2016
reviews.title: Pouring with rain
reviews.content: The fact hat we were caught in the tail end of a typhoon and torrential rains did not deter us to take the boat trip at Van Long Nature Reserve. Now and again the rain let up a bit and we managed to get some pictures of the beautiful surroundings.  Well worth going.

reviews.author: Hayles7
reviews.title: Pleasant my way to spend an hour
reviews.content: And that’s about it.  We walked up from our hotel and got our tickets (50,000 dang a head) and stepped into the small wooden boat.  Our rower skulled her way thru the reed lined waterway to a cave and back. Whilst it was relaxing we did not see that much of particular interest. Took about a hour. Our rower added nothing to our trip.All in all pretty much a do about nothing - until we got back to the dock and they wanted tipped. One lady actually asked for 1.0m dang and we chased her.Hopefully tomorrow we see something more impressive.

reviews.author: kyy0te
reviews.title: A pleasant evening boat ride looking for endangered langurs
