reviews.content: Great experience, learn about how they rescue bears and take care of them. Staff are friendly and welcoming and willing to share knowledge about what they do. Bears are fed around 1pm so good to time for that

reviews.author: Inspire40202899371
reviews.title: Incredible Experience and Must Do in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Incredible experience and so uplifting to see all of the hard work they are doing and the thoughtfulness they put into the enclosures and the day to day lives of the bears to give them enrichment and a better life.

reviews.author: Laura L
reviews.title: An extraordinary experience, to do absolutely!
reviews.content: A wonderful experience, it was very exciting visit this center and see with how much love and dedication these suffering animals are cared for and protected. I chose the "immerse" program in order to have a complete information about this activity. The ideal time of visit is 9 am, book before you go. The center is a bit isolated and there are no buses, from Ninh Binh you can reach in an hour by taxi.agree with the driver also the return because you will not find transport in that area.

reviews.author: MathildaS
reviews.title: Recommended. Should not be missing from the Vietnam trip!
reviews.content: The facility was very professional, the leadership great. Definitely worth a visit even with children. Keep it up!!!

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: This is an amazing sanctuary! The bears have a lot of space and are very well taken care of. You can really tell all the love and affection the staff has for them. You get a great view of the bears from the Skywalk, but if you want more information and support the sanctuary even more, I highly recommend booking the guided tour for 250.000 VD. You can just book the tour when you arrive, no need to book it in advance. The best time to see them is after they had their food (8am, 1pm, and in the evening) There is also a nice vegetarian bistro onsite for a delicious snack.Thank you to the lovely staff for giving these bears a new life!

reviews.author: Bauerin
reviews.title: The bears' past gets under their skin
reviews.content: We had booked a tour for the late morning and a good English speaking lady told us about the bears whose background can impart a lot of knowledge.Because of the heat we hardly saw bears, but for us the visit was worth it. The bears have a terrible past and are cared for here in very large natural enclosures.Finally, there was a movie to watch.Something is really being done here for animal welfare by Western standards, and a visit helps maintain the station.Card payment is possible and a vegetarian restaurant is also on site.

reviews.author: tomerw94
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: We took the guided tour and the lady explained us widely about the place and answered our questions. She and the rest of the staff were nice and easy the understand.It seem like they really give the bears the best condition possible. We been there on a day woth good weather. They can give you umbrellas for the tour if you need.We were lucky to see many bears from a short distance through the fence. At 1 place we saw 8 of them at the same time, but we were told it is considered really lucky.

reviews.author: Navigate544160
reviews.title: Great place - make time to visit
reviews.content: We visited July 24 after reading reviews on TripAdvisor and so glad we did, this is a beautiful place, spotlessly clean and well maintained doing great work for the 45 bears they have rescued. Lovely staff who are really knowledgeable about the bears and the bile trade. We are so glad we came to visit and see the work Four Paws is doing here.

reviews.author: Trail56165823723
reviews.title: A true sanctuary for these beautiful bears
reviews.content: This is a true sanctuary. You can feel the love and care for these bears from all of the staff. Their work and advocacy for protecting bears from bile farming is inspiring. The skywalk is an incredible way to view the enclosures - with the enclosures so big it can be hard to spot the bears. I recommend doing the full guided tour for behind the scenes viewing and different angles to view the enclosures and bears. Come later in the day when it’s not so hot for the bears or they’ll mostly be hiding in the bushes and hard to see

reviews.author: bobby
reviews.title: Life changing experience
reviews.content: We visited a bear sanctuary 🐻 which I have to say is the most ethical sanctuary I’ve ever been to. The list of rules and regulations were long and rightly so, in fact it was a privilege and not a given right to see any bears at all. No loud noises. No calling their names. No strong fragrances.No touching the fences. The lists went on, and I couldn’t have been happier for it. The enclosures are built for them and their comfort not tourists and bratty children smashing on glass walls that you’d typically see at a zoo. In fact out of 47 bears we only managed to see 3 as they roam freely as they please. The footage and facts we were shown on each bear was absolutely heart breaking, in fact I cried so hard a volunteer even offered me a hug.  Honestly if you have the chance to go. GO and support the work they do

reviews.author: Daydream4444
reviews.title: Beautiful sanctuary
reviews.content: Such a wonderful place for the bears with a cruel, sad past. The Sanctuary is has quite great enclosures. The bears are doing very well. The guides are very professional and very informative. With admission the sanctuary supported and therefore highly recommended. These bears desperately need our support.

reviews.author: Wim V
reviews.title: Suporting a good foundation
reviews.content: Very nice experience, you have 3 options i will recomand the option with a guide. The passion of everybody that works here Day and night is incredible. It gives a very good feeling to suport a foundation like this. Also the bears are super cute, definitely when you see where they came from.

reviews.author: Darin Merchant
reviews.title: Inspiring and absolutely worth it
reviews.content: We traveled to the sanctuary with a Grab from Ninh Binh. When we arrived there were very few people there and we decided to book the full tour which included watching a movie, visiting the sanctuary and doing the skywalk. Our guide was very passionate about the bears and their rescue and she could answer any and all questions we had. After the tour we had a delicious meal and finished it off with a fresh coconut coffee :) Absolutely worth it - they do such inspiring work!!

reviews.author: zahra
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.content: Such a heart warming experience! They take care of the bears very well - The tour was great and well organized. Walking around the sanctuary felt peaceful and inspiring. Do visit the sanctuary if you have the chance.The food there is very yummy as well!

reviews.author: Paul D
reviews.title: A great place, a passionate team and beautiful creatures
reviews.content: Managed to get up to the Bear Sanctuary today, an amazing place full of passionate and dedicated people all trying their best to protect these beautiful creatures.The pre tour video almost brought me to tears but seeing the success and heart warming stories throughout my time there feeled me with hope and confidence for the future. A big shout out to our guide Nim, an absolute angel ❤️🙏Take the time out of your day to visit, a great place and an even better cause.

reviews.author: tess
reviews.title: Nice experience!!
reviews.content: I really enjoyed seeing how they take care of the bears at this bear sanctuary!! It is very interesting and certainly not a tourist attraction

reviews.author: David W
reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.content: This place was amazing in size & the care they give these rescued bears is outstanding would recommend this for anyone. The drive getting there is half the fun.

reviews.author: charbar93
reviews.title: Must visit for animal welfare lovers
reviews.content: This was such an incredible place. You can really see how well they take care of the bears, and do this in a very respectful way with the visitors. There is a lot of educational information which helped guests understand why this sanctuary is necessary. The scenery is also very beautiful. I would highly recommend visiting here and donating even a small amount to the sanctuary if you can! :)

reviews.author: Taïna R
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: We loved the experience! Such a good cause and caring team! We strongly recommend to visit the sanctuary! We need more sanctuaries like that to protect animals from abuses!

reviews.author: Christine K
reviews.title: Watching the bears at play
reviews.content: We arrived at 9.30 am and the sanctuary was very quiet. Bears had been fed, so they were active in their enclosures. Walked the skywalk with a guide and had some great views of the bears playing, swimming, and resting. All the guides are very passionate about the bears having a better life now. Watched a 30 minute film that documents how they were treated whilst having bile collected. So cruel. But now they are being treated with love and respect. We highly recommend visiting Four Paws Bear Sanctuary.

reviews.author: Oscardog16
reviews.title: Well worth a visit.
reviews.content: Very nice sanctuary environment to care for bears who were so cruelly treated when being used for bile milking.The enclosures were full of trees and tall grass as well as enrichment structures. The bears were fed 3 times a day and were free to roam their area or go into their buildings.We rode a motorbike from Tam Coc, and it was easy to find.  It took approximately 50 minutes. A taxi from Tam Coc would have been about US$10 each way.We were shown an introductory video before being guided around the perimeter of some of the enclosures. We were then able to walk along the skywalk and could see into several of the enclosures. The cost was 250k VND and it appears there are no fixed times for tours, they are on demand.  We emailed the sanctuary enquiring about tour times, but we did not receive a reply. We arrived at about 1pm watched the video and joined a tour at 1.30 p.m.It was well worth the travel time to visit, and we will return when the Tiger sanctuary is opened. It is now under construction and is expected to finished by the end of 2024.

reviews.author: Edwina
reviews.title: Wonderful sanctuary doing very good rehab work with the bears
reviews.content: Fantastic experience to see the good work being done to rescue bears from bile farming. We did the guided tour for 250k VND and well worth it. There is also a cheaper option to self tour for 50k. The sanctuary has a great vegetarian restaurant. Plan your visit to allow for lunch to support the cause. The mango smoothies are like gelato. So yummy.

reviews.author: maryjan2015
reviews.title: Such amazing work done here
reviews.content: They are doing such great work here.  It was a very touching experience to visit and hear how the bears are rescued and rehabilitated.  It was well worth the hour drive from Tam Coc.  If you’re looking for something different to do while in the area, I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jacky Chen
reviews.title: Suitable for children
reviews.content: Suitable for families taking young children out to play. A bit far from the center, not many activities. Easy to find location.........:::::::..........

reviews.author: Pathfinder674120
reviews.title: Great experience to see these wonderful bears.
reviews.content: What a great experience to see these gorgeous bears in person, so happy to see them finally living their best lives. We were given a welcome drink on arrival, then a guided tour of the facility to see the bears up close, wonderful to see how well the bears are cared for 🫶 highly recommended 👍

reviews.author: Sophia
reviews.title: Very great facility! Anytime again!
reviews.content: Absolutely recommended! A total of 45 bears are housed in the rescue center. Due to time constraints, we only did the skywalk (50,000 vnd) and still saw about 8 bears. There is also the option of taking a tour (1.5 hours). The entrance fee supports the facility. We were very impressed:)

reviews.author: Meg H
reviews.title: Bear Sanctuary Nimh Bin
reviews.content: Definitely take the guided tour, you get to see behind the scenes and the antics of the bears. The staff are very caring and are doing important work.

reviews.author: Marshall Presnick
reviews.title: Four Paws Bear Sanctuary
reviews.content: I was really happy to discover this place after living in Ninh Binh for a year. I've lived in Vietnam since 2011 and had heard only of the bear rescue in Tam Dao, so I was surprised to see signs for this bear sanctuary when I moved to Ninh Binh. When they recently updated their signs, I knew it was still a going concern and took my mom there when she was visiting. We had a great time, and a great tour. The facilities are very impressive - turns out the bears that are rescued and sent to Tam Dao then come and spend the rest of their lives in the comfort of the facilities here. The installations do a good job of educating visitors about the immoral and damaging trade in bear bile - and even more importantly, give the bears who have been caught up in this nefarious practice by poachers and trappers a place to live out their days in peace. We saw a ton of bears on our tour and they all seem happy to be safe and well-fed. I recommend for all ages, a great cause well executed.

reviews.author: Linda S
reviews.title: Stop the mistreatment of black bears !
reviews.content: Inspiring to learn of the great work being done to help these Black Bears  and yet so sad to know there are still thousands out there being treated so cruelly.

reviews.author: Ellen C
reviews.title: Heartwarming and confronting but the love for the animals is incredible
reviews.content: This place does the most amazing bear protection work, the care they afforded the animals was such a joy to see Learned so much about the vile bear bile industryWell worth a visit, only small but for me this experience packed a punch

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: Great experince, great course
reviews.content: This is highly recommended. Great course, kind and knowingly staff and a great experiance. If your near Ninh Binh go visit the center

reviews.author: Nils D
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Such an amazing place, they do great work with the rescue bears - also their vegetarian restaurant was a really good lunch spot

reviews.author: andreiaklee
reviews.title: Great place to visit for families and animal lovers
reviews.content: Great place to visit for family. Bears seem very happy there and it is great to see that something is done to rescue bears from bile farms and that, as individuals, we are able to help by supporting « 4 Paws » the organization behind this project.

reviews.author: wtpgrant
reviews.title: Visit to the Moon Bear Sanctuary
reviews.content: 4 paws do a great job looking after the moon bears. Some heart breaking video. enclosures are really well done. Really well worth the visit.Need to look at topping up t-shirt sizes to allow to make purchase to go towards 4 paws income

reviews.author: Extraordinary505840
reviews.title: Wonderful sanctuary for abused bears just a few miles out of Ninh Binh
reviews.content: I absolutely love this place. Besides the obvious reason, that it provides sanctuary to abused animals, something that is much needed in a country where animal rights are practically nonexistent, it is staffed by friendly, English-speaking folks, it is clean and organized, and as a bonus, it offers a vegan cafe.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.content: Amazing and eye opening experience seeing all the bears and information on bile farming. Employs and invests in local people as well as rescuing and rehabilitating sun and moon bears. Would recommend the full guided tour, Nzan was awesome and super lovely!

reviews.author: smppainting
reviews.title: Nice afternoon
reviews.content: We went to the sanctuary today, the tour was very informative.  The sky walk was also very good.  Tripadvisor said it was free entry and this is not correct, but it was well worth the money

reviews.author: Susan K
reviews.title: Fantastic place.
reviews.content: This is a definite place to visit while in ninh binh.There are 47 Asiatic bears here that have been rescued from a life of pain and suffering at the hands of those in the bile trade. They are brought to the sanctuary with many illnesses, lost limbs and are very traumatized, but what we saw were happy, content bears, lots of them playing together in small social groups. The work they do here to help give these beautiful animals a safe and loving environment is beyond anything we have seen before.Take the full tour, it is so worth it.

reviews.author: Meaghan S
reviews.title: Unforgettable bear experience with a wonderful organisation
reviews.content: The Ninh Binh Bear Sanctuary is doing incredible work to educate and stop bear bile farming while rescuing the bears themselves. We took part in the guided tour experience which involved watching a very moving, short documentary on the work the Four Paws organisation does and the bear bile trade. After this, we were shown around the site and were lucky enough to see several bears very close up as they snuffled around in their enclosures. Our guide told us all about the bears, their tragic experiences and the amazing work the sanctuary is doing to rehabilitate them. We enjoyed a lovely lunch before watching the bears head in for their own meals from the skywalk. The whole experience was wonderful and every staff member we met was clearly passionate about the bears they care for and keen to share more about their cause. This is a must visit for those passing through Ninh Binh or even visiting from further afield - we used a private car (more reasonably priced than expected!) from Hanoi and it's been a highlight of our whole Vietnam trip.

reviews.author: Natasha
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: A must do! This place is amazing. They are doing vital work to rescue and support exploited animals. We had a great visit. Educational and informative

reviews.author: Felix9SVA
reviews.title: a MUST DO when in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: The Bear Sanctuary is a wonderful place to visit and we would recommend everyone to do the guided tour with one of the super passionated workers of the Sanctuary. It was so nice to see the Bears from close distance, getting to know insights about their crucial past and learn a lot about their behaviour. If everyone was like the Bear Sanctuary Workers, the world would be a better Place

reviews.author: maren a
reviews.title: Recommended!
reviews.content: You will be received by pleasant people and a reserve in natural surroundings. We chose a guided tour and while we waited for it to start we walked around to have a look. You will get an explanation about how bears have been exploited by humans and see that they are looked after here in a good way. Highly recommended if you want a slightly different activity in the Ninh Binh area!

reviews.author: Lily W
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.content: Staff were very friendly and informative about the bears, you could tell that they all really loved their jobs! I would recommend that you get a guided tour around the enclosures as you get much closer to the bears, you also get to see where they prepare the bears’ food and also where they would receive treatment. The tour was very insightful and educational which ended with watching a very impactful short film about the process of why and how they are there. The whole experience has left us with an appreciation for the work that is being done to prevent bear bile farms. Would definitely if you are in Ning Binh!

reviews.author: Alberte Ø
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: I will definitely recommend visiting the bear sanctuary! It’s a very educational experience with passionated guides!

reviews.author: Poppy
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: An amazing place! Our tour guide was lovely and shared lots of information about the bears and the sanctuary. There was also a lot of information boards (with English) for those who opted not to have a guide.We saw about 10 bears overall, 4 very close up munching on pumpkin.

reviews.author: Celin
reviews.title: Must Do when in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Amazing experience!! Such nice area for the bears, you can have a guided walk where everything is explained to you! The skywalk is really nice and you can see bears acting naturally. I can highly recommend visiting!

reviews.author: wiltshiredorney
reviews.title: Fantastic bear sanctuary exceptionally run
reviews.content: Ninh Binh Bear Sanctuary is a fantastic place ran by Four Paws who are an international animal welfare charity.I visited with my wife on a Wednesday in November and it was really quiet.We had the place pretty much to ourselves and paid only 250,000 dong (~£8.30) for a tour around the complex, a welcome drink, a 30 minute video showing the reasons for the sanctuary and access to the amazing skywalk. We were lucky enough to see two cubs play fighting and multiple adult bears all just roaming around their enclosures finding scattered food. This isn’t a zoo so don’t expect to get up close, but that’s the point. After hearing what the bears have been through you’ll be pleased of the space they have. Overall I’d say this is a really under-visited, excellent place doing fantastic work for an important cause.

reviews.author: Cara P
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.content: The Bears are loved and well cared for and staff are so incredibly passionate about the bears.We went on the immerse tour to learn as much as we could and our tour guide was absolutely amazing. You can see the real and genuine care, passional and love they have for the bears in the sanctuary but also all animals in general.An eye opening, educational but also fun experience. A must do while you’re in Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Sarah Percival
reviews.title: Don’t miss this amazing place!
reviews.content: We came today and found this to be a fantastic project. I would recommend paying 250,000 vd for a guided tour of the bear sanctuary, a video and the skywalk. All proceeds from the tickets, restaurant and shop go directly to the sanctuary! Yes it is upsetting to hear about the bile trade and the conditions that the bears have been rescued from, but the work that is done to rehabilitate the bears and ensure they can have happy lives is outstanding and needs to be supported. We arrived at about 10am and had enough time for the tour, lunch and then to stand on the skywalk and watch as the bears were called in, the rangers hid the food in the enclosures and the bears then reentered the enclosure to find the food. Some very lucky bears 🐻 Thank you for a wonderful day x

reviews.author: Emily P
reviews.title: Unforgettable and uplifting experience
reviews.content: The sanctuary does incredible work with the bears to give them a second chance at a good life and I would 100% recommend a visit to support their effort. Our guide was very knowledgeable and passionate, and we were able to watch funny bear antics from a safe distance. Staff even helped to call us a taxi when we found ourselves outside of the range of any Grab drivers.

reviews.author: malnatt666
reviews.title: Super nice people who make the world a little better
reviews.content: We visited spontaneously and got a lot of information and were able to observe the bears in their protected habitat

reviews.author: christina c
reviews.title: A beautiful experience
reviews.content: Ninh Binh Bear sanctuary was an amazing experience. We did the 250 000 dong tour which included a tour with a guide who was informative and passionate. They've created a great balance of the truth and horror of bear bile farming and the love and care that the bears now receive. As it wasn't a very hot day, we saw lots of bears feeding, climbing and exploring, all with lots of room to hide if they want. The guide told us about each bear we saw and their specialised diets. A very special experience. Visiting here supports the bears to be in a safe environment. We had a driver from our homestay (about 40 mins drive) and allocated 2 hours thinking it would be enough. 3 hours would be best. This was one of our highlights of visiting Vietnam

reviews.author: Fleur C
reviews.title: Bear sanctuary- please visit!!!
reviews.content: We have such a special time at the bear sanctuary! The staff are so so helpful friendly and kind! They gave us a tour around and talked us through each individual bears story and how they were rescued. Very sad but so informative, but also so amazing to see the way they love and care for these bears! They even get to know their individual likes and dislikes. The staff care so much about them, and you can they are emotional about talking about their life before being rescued! I would highly recommend visiting, and to support the work they do!!

reviews.author: arual1301
reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit and a donation!
reviews.content: Sanctuary that cares a lot about animal welfare. Very interesting and informative tour. The animals are doing well considering their past circumstances. However, you can see that some of them have been traumatized in the past and are behaving accordingly. It is clear how important this facility is and how important it is to support it with visits and donations! You are not even asked to donate, which is very pleasantly unobtrusive. I hope they can save many more bears from the torture on farms.

reviews.author: Antonia C
reviews.title: Must-do in Northern Vietnam
reviews.content: The highlight of my trip to Vietnam, and absolutely worth a day trip from Hanoi. I've been supporting Four Paws for years but to see their work in action, rescuing bears in desperate need from the bear bile industry, is something truly moving and awe-inspiring. The sanctuary itself is incredible, with large enclosures tailored perfectly to meet the needs of the rescued bears, informative educational facilities and a lovely restaurant serving great-value vegetarian food and drink for visitors. The staff are so friendly, dedicated and passionate, with a clear love for the bears and the critical work they do. There are a few options for how to spend your visit, ranging in price from 50K VND to 250K VND, with the latter package including a 45- minute guided sanctuary tour, self-guided skywalk experience (there are informative boards, videos and interactive activities throughout, as well as a gorgeous view over the enclosures and sanctuary) and viewing of a beautiful 30-minute film about the bears and sanctuary life in the air-conditioned presentation room. If making the trip from Hanoi, I'd strongly advise taking advantage of the centre's recommended driving service, Quang Anh Limosine. I arranged my own means of transport on the way there, being a bus company to Ninh Binh and a taxi for the remainder of my journey, but used Quang Anh's transportation service on the way back to Hanoi. This was a much better option, not only being more efficient and well organised but also much cheaper (200K VND, compared to the 750K VND I paid for the bus and taxi). If you're in Northern Vietnam, don't miss the chance to visit and support the work of this wonderful sanctuary. I won't be forgetting the incredible impact my visit had upon me anytime soon.

reviews.author: Buccaneer W
reviews.title: Brilliant, welcoming and insightful experience
reviews.content: I first heard of Four Paws Bear Sanctuary in Ninh Binh through a recommendation of a local who works at Save Vietnams Wildlife (another great place to visit!) I went alone, as a solo traveler, and was warmly welcomed at the front gate. Staff spoke good English and were absolutely lovely. I did a guided tour, which lasted about 45mins for 150.000 VND (about £5 in the UK). My guide was super knowledgeable and took me on a whole journey of how Four Paws has grown and it’s mission to protect and rescue bears in Vietnam from bile farming (a horrible practise I didn’t know about till my visit at the sanctuary). I was taken around al the enclosures and told stories about the individuals and general information about the bear species. As well as a look into the kitchen space and enrichment area where they create toys for the bears to encourage natural behaviours and improve welfare. The Sky walk gives you a whole other perspective of the sanctuary with a Birds Eye view of the enclosures. A great way to see the bears hidden from ground view. I would highly recommend visiting Ninh Binh Bear Sanctuary! 😊

reviews.author: Sally B
reviews.title: Amazing and beautiful experience
reviews.content: We did a bit of research before we went, as we wanted to check the ethics. Having researched, and having been, I can say that this is a beautiful charity and really well run. The bears are very well cared for, and the facility is not aimed towards tourists, but foremost towards caring for the bears. I would definitely recommend going with the guide, as they are a fountain of knowledge and you can also get closer to the bears. Beautiful day, so glad we went.

reviews.author: Jacqueline1109
reviews.title: Hug to the heart
reviews.content: It is very worth visiting this sanctuary, it is very sad to know everything that these bears have suffered but it is a hug to the heart to know that there are people who are not going to continue allowing it and really do something to help. Our guide was Trang, we loved her, she was very sweet and explained perfectly how the sanctuary works, she told us the stories of some of the bears and we could see the pain in her eyes when she told us how horrible they had been, she told us that The sanctuary, in addition to rescuing the bears and giving them a dignified and pain-free life, rehabilitates them since they are left with the trauma, encourages them to look for their food and although they are bears that will no longer be able to return to their habitat because of everything they have suffered They keep them active so they don't get bored and stressed, it is highly recommended to visit, bring cash if you want to buy something in the store (everything goes to the bears) we couldn't buy anything since there was a problem with the terminal to pay our entrance and we had We had to use the cash we had, souvenirs must be paid in cash, at least that's what I understood.Go and donate or buy things to help the bears.

reviews.author: Mika S
reviews.title: Very special experience, would recommend to anyone going to Ninh Binh
reviews.content: What a special experience! I am obsessed with bears, so this was a necessary stop for me. It was 150k for a tour and access to the sky walk. We learned so much about the horrible conditions these bears are rescued from, and about their rehabilitation. They are adorable and we got to see them run out for mealtime just after 4pm. I would highly recommend this for animal lovers and bear lovers. The staff were all super friendly, and the mushroom pizza at the bistro was really good as well. Apparently they don’t get many visitors and all of the money goes towards the sanctuary, so please visit when in Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Mackenzie J
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: Very high quality breed specific enrichment and care for these bears, doing important work and the tour guide was very informative. Highly recommend. Run by four paws organisation

reviews.author: Silvan D
reviews.title: Nice place for the sad bears
reviews.content: A really beautiful place for all the sad bears. Here they are well cared for and looked after. It is cruel and arrogant how people disregard the animals. This must stop worldwide.

reviews.author: 35vickyv
reviews.title: Nice project with beautiful moon bears
reviews.content: Great guided tour, the bears are free so you need to be lucky. But with the guide, we saw several bears from up close. Nice explanation and also nice vegetarian food in restaurant.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.title: Save the bears! Fund the revolution!
reviews.content: The bear sanctuary is such a great cause; protecting bears from the awful bile trade. The bears welfare is at the forefront of their attention. We learnt so much about how they care for the bears and are so appreciative of the work they do. We payed 150,000 pp for a guided and insightful guided tour of the sanctuary from the extremely friendly and knowledgeable Trang. Highly recommend a visit here!!

reviews.author: jodiesward
reviews.title: A must visit !!
reviews.content: This is a must, we came to stay in Tam Coc, just to visit the bear sanctuary, but we discovered one of our most favourite destinations in Vietnam. The sanctuary is an eye opener to the bear bial industry , it’s cruel and unwarranted with herbal alternatives available . The bears truely look at peace here and will live the rest of theirs lives without any more human cruelty , just love and respect . My husband tagged along just because, but he’s the one wearing a new bear “love me” T-shirt ! Go meet the bears and help put a stop to this unnecessary.  cruelty. Tam Coc is a place to unwind and enjoy some amazingly stunning natural sites

reviews.author: Teresa B
reviews.title: Thank you Four Paws
reviews.content: We are so glad we got to see the wonderful work Four Paws do to rescue Moon Bears throughout Vietnam. Our knowledgeable guide was able to educate us on the strategies used to protect bears from cruel practices. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Sandra P
reviews.title: Worth the drive!
reviews.content: Sweet and welcoming staff who welcomed us.We bought a guided tour which is worth recommending. Good guide, where you could clearly sense that this park is run by people with ultimate love for the bears and their well-being.

reviews.author: Rosalie S
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.content: Great place! No zoo! Take good care of their animals. Highly recommend taking the tour! I loved it, my boyfriend not so much. If happy animals make you smile, go here. Also, yummy lunch!

reviews.author: charlesdownie
reviews.title: Great sanctuary and highly recommended.
reviews.content: Great sanctuary and highly recommended a visit if your in Tam Coc or Ninh Binh.   Was a bit disappionted that they didn't reply when messaged a number of times from their website, to get the time of the guided tour.  Got a driver to take us before 12 and was told a tour was at 2 pm that day but was moved to later so I didn't manage to get on it.   The sanctuary does great work and cafe is nice.  Hope they can improve their comms.

reviews.author: AresG22
reviews.title: Somewhat of a hidden gem
reviews.content: Enjoy an interesting trip trough this sanctuary, learn something about bears and, on top of that, support a good cause (rescue of abused bears).

reviews.author: Vicki R
reviews.title: A moving experience. 100% recommend
reviews.content: We visited today and I 100% recommend you to visit. We arrived around 13:00, the guide suggested we wait till 13:30 as the bears would be more active for a tour. There is a lovely little cafe there so we got a drink before starting. The Skywalk is 50VND. The tour is 150VND and includes the skywalk.. again 100% worth it. You get to get closer to the bears. We saw around 15 bears and got told the history behind some of them. They were playing in the water, climbing up trees etc. You also get told specific details about some of the bears and reasons why they are there. The guide spoke very good English and was able to answer all our questions. It is not expensive and all money goes back into helping the sanctuary. Along with proceeds of the shop.. the items in the shop are such a good price!Just a note I never leave reviews to tours etc. But I felt for this I really had to. It was an amazing experience.

reviews.author: Ethan J
reviews.title: Amazing business
reviews.content: Amazing business. We went at 11:30 but unfortunately the next tour wasn’t till 15:00 so we were limited with the amount of the sanctuary we saw as there wasn’t enough to keep up busy for that long. However, we had a wonderful time. We also had lunch here which was very tasty and good value for money. I’d strongly recommend calling ahead in order to make sure you can do a tour to experience the whole sanctuary.

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: bear sanctuary
reviews.content: the tour guides were friendly and we saw loads of bearsall for a good cause to aid in saving more sun bears from illegal trading

reviews.author: Jason P
reviews.title: A must visit
reviews.content: This was a really wonderful and informative experience. I strongly recommend the guided tour - come for around 1.30.Everything you spend here goes back to looking after the bears.

reviews.author: Danny C
reviews.title: Ethical sanctuary for bears!
reviews.content: Such an incredible sanctuary for bears! Our tour guide Trung (sorry not sure on spelling!) was very informative and super passionate about the conservation of the moon bears. The sanctuary itself has large enclosures with plenty of enrichment for the bears and definitely puts animal welfare as it’s priority. Would definitely recommend visiting!

reviews.author: Aoife
reviews.title: a bear necessity
reviews.content: This experience was both heart warming and breaking. The information on bear bile they provided was enlightening, but it pleased all of us to know our tickets funded the bettering of bear life. Seeing the bears was also nothing short of spectacular! They were adorable, very visible and easily photographable. Overall a wonderful experience that my friends and I have not stop talking about since!!

reviews.author: Cesar R
reviews.title: Bear sanctuary
reviews.content: The program is very interesting. I found out about the sanctuary by chance when I was in Ninh Bihn and I'm glad I went to visit it. The exploitation of bears for the bile is still a serious topic in Vietnam and they do a wonderful job giving these animals a second chance.

reviews.author: Shelley M
reviews.title: Love the bears
reviews.content: A highlight to our trip.  The sanctuary is 45 minutes from Tam Coc, we got taken on the back of scooters which was really cool as we saw a lot on the way.  Had a guided tour behind the scenes, the food and history of the place and what they are trying to achieve.  Loved everything about this place.  The moon bears are beautiful and have had a horrible life till they come here.  Loved the skywalk and watched 2 moon bears play flighting in a water hole, could have watched for ages.  They are well looked after and educating the people on the revolting process of bile farming.  Great to see Vietnam step up with these animals and make changes.  Has a gift store and cafe to go towards the costs involved with the sanctuary.  Well worth the effort.  My family really enjoyed our visit.

reviews.author: Jaroslav Nečas
reviews.title: Worth the visit
reviews.content: Modern looking and equipped sanctuary is middle of nowhere, road leading to it is not good one. But it's still worth the visit, place is not crowded and you can see few bears but unfortunately from far distance.

reviews.author: adventurediscover
reviews.title: Visit and support the bears not the bile farming
reviews.content: Cannot recommend a visit here enough! $50 to view the bears from the sky walk ( which is not too high if you don't like heights!) $150 to have guided tour- definitely advised to do this! You see around food prep area, baby cub area, enclosures and get info on the bears and what the sanctuary actually does! Please support this cause and learn about these gorgeous bears. Watch them play, and try to find their hidden food. The sanctuary is located a little way out from Ninh Binh but a taxi took us, waited for approx an hour and returned us(organized by hotel). We would have preferred a bit longer at the sanctuary but were limited by the driver. Happily made a donation to the charity.

reviews.author: lbonshek
reviews.title: Amazing - don’t miss this special experience! Educational and inspiring
reviews.content: Only 45 mins from Tam Coc by car. We arrived and our guide greeted us in fluent English - she guided us around the sanctuary (which was in great condition and very clean). We were there for about 1.5 hours and she knew all about each of the 42 moon bears rescued and living there. She taught us all about the horrible animal welfare experiences and how they rehabilitate the bears. We got up close to one bear, Loulou - which was just amazing. They also have a sky walk overlooking the bear’s outdoor enclosures so we’re able to see them acting naturally. Very informative and heart warming experience. Would highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Gee
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Please visit this sanctuary if you can! We could have spent so, so many hours here enjoying watching the bears and just being in surroundings. We did the sky walk and went to the restaurant and loved our every minute spent here. Im in awe of the work done here that help these wonderful animals. Visit, donate and share.

reviews.author: TrailsWeBlaze
reviews.title: Guided tour
reviews.content: We did the guided tour and the skywalk during our time here. Definitely recommend upgrading to the guided tour if you can because you get to learn a lot about what the sanctuary is doing and why they are doing it. Also, you get to see more bears from another perspective!

reviews.author: Cjl6
reviews.title: A visit is highly recommended
reviews.content: Take a guided tour then take some great photos from the raised walkway. This place should be better known for the good work that it does and is is probably your only chance to see moon bears in Vietnam because they are now so rare in the wild. The sanctuary is fairly easily reached by taxi or motorbike from Tam Coc. There is a good restaurant there.

reviews.author: Alex H
reviews.title: An enlightening and interesting visit
reviews.content: You can pay 50,000 for entry to just the skywalk or 150,000 for this plus a guide. Highly recommend taking the guide - it only takes an hour or so and they are really passionate about their work and their role. They gave some interesting and harrowing stories about a number of the bears which we found very insightful.The sanctuary itself is very well kept and seems ethically sound, as the enclosures for the bears are very large, and the way they are treated appears very good.Highly recommend visiting despite being a little far out of town.

reviews.author: Harriet
reviews.title: Wonderful day out at fantastically run bear sanctuary.
reviews.content: Such a wonderful day out at a beautiful and quiet location. The Ninh Binh bear sanctuary rescues Asian Black Bears from captivity, illegal trade and bile farming. There are currently 46 bears here that you can see living freely in their large enriched enclosure. We went on the skyline walk and had a really informative (if sad!) tour which was excellently done! Also wonderful veggie food at fantastic prices!! Definitely reccommend!!

reviews.author: annabellewp
reviews.title: An eye opening wholesome experience! A must visit when in Ninh Binh 🤍
reviews.content: A must visit when going to Ninh Binh! I’m so glad we made the journey a little further out from where we were staying to visit this place. Our guide was SO passionate about the bears and rescuing them it really made the whole experience that much more enjoyable being guided around by someone who clearly cares so much about them. Such an interesting, heartbreaking, wholesome and eye opening day! Thank you ☺️

reviews.author: BikergirlzRock
reviews.title: Moon bears💖
reviews.content: We enjoyed our stop at the bear sanctuary.  Do the tour. You will learn a lot about the traditions that put moon bears at risk.  We really enjoyed our time!

reviews.author: madebooCalifornia
reviews.title: An absolute must-see!
reviews.content: This sanctuary is a hidden gem in the Ninh Binh area. It doesn’t get the attention it richly deserves. The facility is first rate, and they are doing amazing work to rescue moon bears from the cruel and disgusting bile trade. Be sure to do the guided tour. It’s well worth the minimal cost and the proceeds support the important work they’re doing. A++++

reviews.author: Tiara S
reviews.title: A must visit in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: We got the tour option which gave us an insight to how the bears were taken care of and the kinds of conditions they were rescued from. Recommend visiting here as they are doing great work and all the staff are very passionate about the work they do!

reviews.author: Laura M
reviews.title: Perfect day out
reviews.content: Paid for the guided tour was 150k and worth every Dong. Enjoyed learning about the bears and their history. Also enjoyed a vegetarian lunch which I would recommend!

reviews.author: Leannie
reviews.title: Make time for the guided tour to not be disappointed
reviews.content: We were a bit pressed for time when we got here and so opted for the self guided tour as the assisted tour was another hour wait. It was a very short tour where you can go up the skywalk and look down on where some of the bears are but the self guided tour meant you were unable to walk around the perimeter and therefore probably have seen more bears.The other thing that was not great was the skywalk is one of the selling points but a good deal of the view is obscured by trees and overgrown bushes, I think they could be kept better maintained to aid the viewing.

reviews.author: Lisette W
reviews.title: Please visit!
reviews.content: We found this sanctuary through Tripadvisor and were very happy we went. When we got there we were very surprised by how well it all looks and how friendly the people are. It’s still not very known by visitors of the area. We got a wonderful private tour and a lot of interesting information about Moon bears. It’s also a reality check on how terrible these animals can be treated. Wonderful how they dedicate themselves to the welfare of Moon bears and the education on how these animals should be treated.

reviews.author: Jolu T
reviews.title: No.1 place to go in Ninh Binh!!!!!
reviews.content: No.1 place to go when traveling to Ninh Binh!🖤 More people need to know about this wonderful place! We had a full tour (which was only 150,000d, basically £5, per person!!) of the sanctuary, learning everything there is to know about the bears that have been saved, their backgrounds and how they are given the best quality of life now.Our tour guide was so knowledgeable, giving us an intimate tour and showing us behind the scenes including the food preparation and quarantine area housing two young cubs (the latter from a distance of course!). We saw many bears during our tour, they were playing together and climbing trees in their big enclosures; it was such a special experience to be able to see these abused animals living naturally and in a way as close to wild as can be. The skywalk adds another level to the experience, and we watched as the bears were fed in the evening, which was fantastic!The reception/restaurant/gift shop/bathroom areas were all 5 star, with excellent cleanliness and service levels. If you’re travelling anywhere near Ninh Binh, take the short drive out to this sanctuary, it’ll be the best and most rewarding thing you’ll do here!P.S A note to the South African guy visiting the sanctuary from Germany, representing Four Paws, while we were there - Please be more respectful to the staff at the sanctuary, and if you are talking about business, best not to do it in front of paying customers!

reviews.author: Nippi0815
reviews.title: Worth to visit
reviews.content: Very nice institution.It was very interesting.The people there are very passionated.The work they do is really important.I would recommend it 😉

reviews.author: Jasmina A
reviews.title: Amazing place!!!
reviews.content: This place is amazing!!! You have to visit! They Care so so much for the Beats and the food and drinks are great aß Well. Please Go and give Them a little Tip. All the Money is for the Beats!!

reviews.author: Mai Le
reviews.title: A wonderful trip
reviews.content: I had no idea of how crude the bears were treated in Vietnam untill I went to this Sanctuary.  Seeing the violence those bears suffered have made my heart broken. Therefore, I feel heartwarming when I know they are safed and happy now in this sanctuary. You guys had done a wonderful job!! Keep it going!!!

reviews.author: Brigid W
reviews.title: Bears!
reviews.content: After a disappointing morning trying to see the animals at Cuc Phuong and failing, it was lovely to come here and see these absolutely stunning animals being so well cared for after having such horrible lives. I appreciate how much effort they put in to ensure that the bears have the best life from now on and I LOVE that the sanctuary creates employment for local people too! Keep doing what you're doing! I loved visiting and will be back next weekend with a friend!!

reviews.author: Brigitte G
reviews.title: A MUST-VISIT attraction near Cuc Phuong National Park
reviews.content: Visiting the FOUR PAWS Bear Sanctuary Ninh Binh was one of the highlights of our two-week trip to Vietnam. The facility is nothing short of marvellous and the people there work SO HARD to ensure a good experience for the bears and visitors alike. Our guide there was by far one of the most knowledgeable we have encountered in all of Vietnam, and she provided a rich description of the bear bile situation in Asia, and a heart-warming (yet realistic) tour of the sanctuary. Also, the food in the restaurant was SO GOOD! Our tour guide ordered for us ahead of our arrival and I think we basically had one of each dish on the menu, and some off-menu dishes too. Everything was so delicious and fresh, and vegan, too. One of the best meals we had in the country - surprising as this is quite a remote area! The gift shop features local artists and original crafts you won't find elsewhere. Perfect for authentic souvenirs. If you are planning on visiting Cuc Phuong National Park, I strongly recommend you stop here as well. The tour is free and it will help you understand an important part of the wildlife conservation movement in Vietnam. THANK YOU to all volunteers and workers of the sanctuary. Your efforts are noticed and appreciated all around the world.

reviews.author: Odyssey06307974425
reviews.title: Ninh Binh Bear Sanctuary
reviews.content: We had visited other sanctuarys in the area earlier in the day and were left a little disappointed.We arrived at the Bear Sanctuary later in the afternoon and were welcomed by very friendly and knowledgeable staff. We did the tour (parts very sad hearing about the bears previous treatment but life so much better for them now). So pleased that we stopped and did tour - the highlight of our Ninh Binh stay. Late afternoon a good time as feeding time and able to see bears foraging for food their keepers had hidden around the grounds. Thank you to the sanctuary for the wonderful work you do.  Garry & Anne Adcock. Australia

reviews.author: chris-dusty
reviews.title: Great New Bear Sanctuary
reviews.content: Very well set up facilities for both bears and visitors. Lovely food (for the humans) and interesting tour. Well worth the visit.

reviews.author: Florian K
reviews.title: Must visit if you are around Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Really worth the visit :) Definitely take a scooter to get there as the landscape on the way is beautiful. The Bear Sanctuary is really interesting, the guides are very helpful and tell you a lot of information about the bears. Their English is also great!

reviews.author: villytod
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.content: We had a fun day out visiting the Bear Sanctuary. We went around feeding time (1:30 pm) so got to see all the bears outside. It was also sad to learn about bile production, but necessary to understand why this sanctuary is doing such good work!

reviews.author: Sophie lovell
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Absolutely incredible! We loved every second! They do amazing work, and the bears look very happy with their new lives :)

reviews.author: Jakub D
reviews.title: A nice place to visit
reviews.content: Me and my girlfriend Miška made a motorbike trip there from Cosy Son hotel near Ninh Bình.. though it seems like far place to go and no worth visiting from there I must say that THIS really touched me in possitive  way and it was definitely one our best experience around Ninh Bình.I did not know what to expect how we were getting closer and closer - it is cut off the city, but when we arrived I understood why and was glad for it. When we arrived a really kind young lady told us what’s going on this place, showed us interesting videos of bears and stuff. Our guide tour started after 1:00 pm so we had some time to take a lunch. Food you can choose from menu there is not overpriced at all how would you expect. We both love meat meals but we tried a vegetarian meals and it was amazing ! Nice and kind service.Our lady guide took us around pavilions and showed us bears and how they care about them. And one would never say that it’s not a simple thing. You can also buy some nice environment-friendly-made souvenirs to support this organisation.I really appreciate what these guys are doing for these poor animals and I recommend everyone to visit this Sanctuary and support it. Thanks a lot guys, wish you all the best !

reviews.author: Tony S
reviews.title: A meaningful experience
reviews.content: We went to visit the sanctuary for half a day.  We were shown the videos about the bears suffered in bear farms then they were rescued to live a happy life. Then your heart will move with happiness witnessing the bears playing happily in the natural area. Had an absolutely delicious vegan meal with fried tofu, fried sweet potato, fried mungbean pancake (highly recommend). Very interesting souvenir shops with many affordable items that are local produced.  It is a must destination when you are in Ninh Binh. Compared to Cuc Phuong national park, this place is more peaceful and it is better organized to prioritize the wellness of the bears. Four Paws org. did a well done job here!

reviews.author: Trang Peji
reviews.title: The best bear sanctuary i've ever seen before.
reviews.content: The staff are extremely friendly. Those bears look so free and happy.I had a great experience. I will visit again.

reviews.author: JLM41
reviews.title: Amazing place, doing amazing work
reviews.content: Visited the sanctuary in Ninh Binh today as we are on vacation in Vietnam and we donate to Four Paws. What a fantastic place and amazing people. we were so touched by the incredible stories about the bears.   I am so proud to support this worthy cause. Keep up the good work and thanks for the tour you gave us. ❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Adamjanis
reviews.title: Be Bear Aware 🐻
reviews.content: We saw the signs for the bear sanctuary while riding around Ninh Binh on a motorbike, and followed our guts to check it out... We're really glad we did! You can watch the bears for free from an informational viewing deck, but I would highly recommend the tour. The wonderful guide took us to the 4 different bear enclosures and the bear kitchen where they  prepare all of the food. There's a lot of information about how they are mistreated and the efforts to save them... They're doing some great work there! And the food (for humans) is delicious. Hands down, the best coffee we had in Vietnam!

reviews.author: Josephineburrows
reviews.title: Must see, beautiful rescue bears
reviews.content: We had an amazing time here!! We scooted out from our accomodation in Trang An and it was a lovely scenic ride. We ate lunch at the Bear Sanctuary (delicious, recommend sesame cake for dessert!). We had a guided tour of the bear sanctuary at 1.30pm (recommend going 9-10.30 or 1-2.30 as that is feeding time). Our tour guide was brilliant and is involved in rescuing the bears. She explained the bile extraction and gave lots of information on the individual characteristics of the bears (like favourite food, their bear friends).The people here do amazing work! I recommend visiting and doing the tour, eating lunch and buying souvenirs to support them :)

reviews.author: Patty041994
reviews.title: Great place for all animal lovers!
reviews.content: We visited the sanctuary during our stay in Ninh Binh. It’s easy to go there by scooter. I would really recommend to book a tour to learn more about the bears and the sanctuary. The staff was awesome and we had some delicious vegan lunch there. It was a great visit and I would definitely go there again.Keep up the good work! :-)

reviews.author: Misst
reviews.title: Excellent - very informative and nice to see bears
reviews.content: We enjoyed our time at the sanctuary for bears who were used to extract bike. It was very educational but also we walked around and saw the bears playing and eating, heard about their stories and saw their food being made. It was really enjoyed by the teens. Good cafe/gift shop too.

reviews.author: Dirk H v
reviews.title: Sustainable sanctuary with friendly staff
reviews.content: Very good, informative and attractive spot. Well organised.Good restaurant.Sustainable premisses.Lots of information in the situation of bile bears.

reviews.author: ND
reviews.title: Amazing place with beautiful bears
reviews.content: The bear sanctuary is a must see if you're in Vietnam. Not only is it educational , but it also has the most beautiful rescue bears of all ages ,with incredible stories. It was so lovely to see the bears being able to just be bears again, playing and swimming etc.. I could spend all day watching them! There's also a restaurant with delicious food and friendly staff working at the sanctuary, who are happy to answer any questions. I would love to go again if I am ever back in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Rose
reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.content: Everything about this place is good. Staff, facilities for bears, ability to see the day to day life of both bears and humans, food in their cafe and goods in their shop.I would recommend anyone to go there whether or not you have children. The staff are so lovely and informative and very happy to show you around. I enjoyed this much more than the Ninh Binh caves.

reviews.author: Paula P
reviews.title: A must: Rescued bears and beautiful scenery!
reviews.content: A visit to BEAR SANCTUARY Ninh Binh is not only educational but also emotional to see former bile bears finally enjoying their life. It was great to see the bears frolicking in their huge natural enclosures with great care of the amazing FP Viet team. I would highly recommend a visit! P.S: the restaurant has extremely yummy food.

reviews.author: Joost
reviews.title: Beautiful sanctuary with helpfull people
reviews.content: It is a beautiful place and the people are willing to give you all the information you need. Big facility with a lot of bear and there is also a restaurant.

reviews.author: Marie P
reviews.title: Great visit to a worthy cause
reviews.content: We added our visit to the Bear Sanctuary after a day at Cuc Phuong National Park. We received a warm welcome to the centre, which has free entry and were given excellent explanations from Hang (we hope we've remembered your name correctly) who obviously really cared about the bears and our visit. We didn't eat anything at the centre (but the food looked great, especially as it is all vegetarian) but did have a delicious coffee.The bears have huge enclosures and are well looked after.I recommend spending around an hour here to find out about the work they are doing and support the cause.

reviews.author: ChiaraBren
reviews.title: Good cause, good people
reviews.content: I didn't even know about the problem of bile bears still being kept at farms around Vietnam. It was grueling to see the fate of so many bears that are being kept in this small cages for all their life!Saving them is an important act of humanity. The Bear sanctuary in Ninh Binh does an amazing job, the bears are really happy in their new home! Thanks for the tour and the great gift shop!

reviews.author: Erik A
reviews.title: Very interesting and important!
reviews.content: It was such an interesting visit with loads of information. We had no clue this was a thing in Vietnam, they are doing a great job!

reviews.author: ogg16
reviews.title: Bears like Pumpkin ~ Who Knew?!
reviews.content: Four Paws was quite difficult to find but I’m so glad we persevered. The life stories of the bears are utterly heartbreaking but now they are living their best bear lives. The staff are so friendly and seemed genuinely pleased to see us. The full tour (please take it and please spend the money) was informative and full of surprises and my guide spoke perfect English. The cafe is new, spotless and very reasonable. They are looking to rescue 100 bears. I hope they get to this number as soon as they can.

reviews.author: petervM2898HG
reviews.title: Great initiative tonsave these beautifull bears
reviews.content: Great people that trying to save these beautifull bears from extinction in Vietnam. Go visit them so they get supported in changing the way the Vietnamese people think about these bears

reviews.author: F.C./SUI
reviews.title: Fantastic work for the animals
reviews.content: We visited the new and very beautiful bear sanctuary in this very big and natural area. The staff there is so very friendly and we really felt that they work with passion for giving the bears a better life. They informed us about their area, the rescued bears with their horrible histories and the work they do in this sanctuary.In addition, the shop and the restaurant were so very nice. Many handcraft souvenirs - local made staff are there to sell. The food is delicious and vegetarian for sure. We are so happy that we saw their work. Please donate for this company, every cent helps to give the animals a better life.

reviews.author: SH Seah
reviews.title: Great place to observe bears and support the cause!!
reviews.content: We stumbled onto this sanctuary after seeing a sign " Bear Sanctuary 29km this way". When we arrived, we had to wait awhile (there's a vegan cafe so pretty good place to chill) before the tour started. The tour was really educational, even my guide and driver came along to learn more about the bear bile industry and why these bears needed to be rescued. The bears were allowed to forage and exhibit natural behaviours in their sanctuary, and the staff and volunteers really cared for them. Highly recommended!PS: There is a primate sanctuary and a tortoise sanctuary nearby in the national park as well and you can complete all of them in about half day.

reviews.author: Dan G
reviews.title: Fascinating, heartbreaking and uplifting
reviews.content: I went to the Sanctuary with some friends while we were staying in the nearby Cuc Phuong National Park. We had a great, detailed tour of the centre, where we got to see the bears in their enclosures, see where they get medical care and meet the dedicated staff who look after them. We had a fascinating tour of the kitchens where teams of people prepare the huge quantities of food the animals need. I found the story of how the bears were treated by bile farmers heartbreaking - it brought tears to my eyes just thinking about how anyone could treat animals like that - one bear had had her paws chopped off to be used in a traditional medicine! However, it was so great to see the rescued bears relaxing in the sun and enjoying being outside - sometimes for the first time in their lives. We saw one bear who, the keepers said, would stay outside even when it was pouring with rain, just because he had spent his whole life in a cage in a dark room and wanted to stay in the light.There was a great little shop where I got some souvenirs and a journal, and I left the sanctuary feeling very glad that there were dedicated, passionate people in the world trying to help these animals and stop this horrible practice - a bright light of compassion amidst the gloom.I would totally recommend making a visit if you're in the area, and supporting the Four Paws charity in this important, valuable work. Five stars from me!

reviews.author: FloatIntoTheMystic
reviews.title: Animal Lovers: Don’t Miss Out!
reviews.content: My friend and I visited Four Paws Bear Sanctuary in Ninh Binh and were very surprised to learn about the horrific conditions these bile bears were living in before they were rescued. Our guide was very informative and answered all our questions with integrity and passion for animal welfare. I’ll admit I held back tears several times hearing stories of individual bears and how they live in a vegetative state. However, it was wonderful to see these rescued bears out roaming in their enclosures, living the beat possible life they can. They looked very happy at the sanctuary. We were guided throughout the facility and even got to see the kitchen where staff was preparing meals for the bears. This was my favorite activity we did in the area as I found it eye-opening and inspirational to help organizations like Four Paws.

reviews.author: Ashley H
reviews.title: Incredible place!
reviews.content: Went here with a friend and learned about the sad truth of what happens everyday in a life of a bile bear. I left in tears wishing I could do more for these bears who are tortured every day just for bile that apparently is believed to be medicinal. This is a place where the bears get a second chance to live a normal life. Amazing bears! Amazing staff! Thank you for all you do!!

reviews.author: frangipansi91
reviews.title: Remember it's not a zoo
reviews.content: Our visit to the Bear Sanctuary in Ninh Binh was beautiful. They are doing a great job fighting everyday to rescue all the bears that are still in captivity. We were lucky to see three of the bears playing aroung in the pool and climbing trees. Please remember it is not a zoo, so don't expect to find the bears showing off for you. Thanfully in this place they have a home where they can enjoy life with no pressure at all, that meaning among other things "being ready" for human visitors ;)

reviews.author: Helen
reviews.title: Important bear rescue centre
reviews.content: The sanctuary rescues bears who have been taken and kept in captivity, and abused for use in traditional medicine.We had a very interesting and informative tour of the sanctuary - very sad to hear of what the bears have been through during their lives, but lovely to see them being well looked after now.

reviews.author: Jean Gaetan G
reviews.title: Great! Hard to find though, on maps, look for "Four Paws Viet"
reviews.content: Not easy to find, so on your phone, look for "Four Paws Viet"The initiative is heart-warming, the staff so nice, the place is cozy and also nice to take a break/coffee/lunch. Everything is done with care and affection, and you can sense a very heartfelt initiative. A must in Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: MaximeLecl
reviews.title: Fantastic and informative visit thanks to the staff !
reviews.content: First let me say that this is place is for rescued bears and is nothing like a zoo.The staff of the bear sanctuary is not only doing a great job guiding in the sanctuary and educating the people about the bear situation in Vietnam but they also study the behavior of the bears, establish the right diet for them, improve their ability to walk, and make them progressively reuse their claws, tooth and sense of smell (I'm not saying how so you can discover it during your visit).The stories of the bears are frankly depressing but that's the sad reality.Also, they will never be released back in the wild but this sanctuary is a true chance for them to now live a peaceful life.The staff is passionate about what they do and it's fair to say that the bears look happy and relaxed. They are really charming!They love sunny weather but even on a rainy day we were lucky to spot them.Feeding times are 8am, 1pm and 4pm.If you plan to visit, it's best to give a quick call to check if they have a guide available.The sanctuary is very close to Cuc Phuong National Park so if you are visiting the national park you can stop for 1-2hrs there.To the team working there: keep up with the great work!

reviews.author: jasanna2019
reviews.title: Such an important place!
reviews.content: We didn’t know about the sanctuary but it was suggested and I’m so glad we went. Our 3 children especially learnt so much and were shocked by what happens to bears. Our 10 year old decided straight away that we had to spend money on souvenirs so we could support your work. It really had an impact. We loved our lunch and were very impressed with your facilities. A great experience and one that we hope more can see and learn from.

reviews.author: Tara Q
reviews.title: Learned a lot!
reviews.content: One of The very kind employees walked us around and gave us a ton of information on the bears, was very interesting and I learned a lot! Had no idea about the bear situation in SE Asia.

reviews.author: jennA
reviews.title: Wonderful Visit
reviews.content: We visited the Bear Sanctuary yesterday and had not booked a tour but the staff were great and accommodating. Our tour guide (we did not get her name unfortunately) was very knowledgable and passionate about the plight of the bears. Very sad the damage humans do to these magnificent creatures.We need to apply pressure to Governments in Asian countries to make this practice illegal. It is illegal to draw bile from bears in Vietnam but not illegal to keep bears in tiny horrid cages. And Ofcourse why else to keep a bear without taking bile. China as always has no animal welfare laws and still legal to abuse all animals. We must continue pressure for change.

reviews.author: O L
reviews.title: Unique and important
reviews.content: This sanctuary is so important. We learned that there are still more then 1000 bears captured and abused in Vietnam. The place is new and and built in such quality we never witnessed in vietnam! The staff is very knowledgeable and the tour we had was eye opening and interesting. You get to see the bears (which are so cute) and hear about their sad stories. You also got to visit the kitchen (which is cleaner than most of the restaurants kitchens we saw in Vietnam!) and learn what the bears eat and how to make soup for them :) There’s also a cute and cheap gift shop and a really (really!) tasty vegetarian restaurant inside. This is still an unknown place as it opened its gates to tourists only a few months ago. Go visit!

reviews.author: Seana07
reviews.title: Amazing work rescuing bears, great place to visit
reviews.content: Located near the entrance to the national Park Four Paws bear sanctuary is doing amazing work in offering refuge to bear’s that were rescued from the abhorrent bear bile farming industry.   He’s beers are now allowed to roam free and act like bears. Tour was great and informative. The staff there is very kind and truly do seem to enjoy the work, giving great stories of the Bears background. Great for solo travelers or traveling with families.
